Motivation: 现有检索增强和问答系统在查询时重复推导语料库语义，计算成本高。作者主张在数据摄入时一次性编译语义结构并增量维护，但面临维护成本的质疑：文档变化时重建截断SVD看似昂贵，嵌入模型变更似需全量重嵌入。

Method: 提出增量低秩更新方法来维护截断SVD，成本随变化量而非语料库规模增长；采用正交Procrustes虚拟轴更新方法处理嵌入模型变更，仅需重嵌入约10%的语料即可恢复向量相似度。

Result: 在合成实验中（维度256，秩32，语料从3000增长到9000，50次更新事件）：增量更新单次成本比全量重建SVD低33.7倍，累积成本低23.8倍；增量子空间与全量重计算在浮点精度内一致（最大主角漂移<1e-11度，recall@10=1.0）；Procrustes更新恢复0.95平均余弦相似度。

Conclusion: 维护语义结构的成本随变化量而非语料规模增长，增量更新方法在大幅降低成本的同时保持高精度，支持采用维护而非重复重建语义基底的方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented and agentic question-answering systems increasingly re-derive the meaning of a corpus at query time. Put plainly, instead of re-deriving what a corpus means on every question, the work is done once when a document arrives and is thereafter merely consulted -- a compiler, not an interpreter, of meaning. An alternative is to compile that meaning once, at ingest time, into a compact, queryable semantic substrate and maintain it as the corpus evolves. The central objection is maintenance cost: rebuilding a truncated singular value decomposition (SVD) on every change appears prohibitive, and a change of embedding model seems to force a full re-embedding. We argue and show empirically that maintenance cost scales with the amount of change, not corpus size. On a controlled synthetic pilot (dimension 256, rank 32, a corpus grown from 3,000 to 9,000 documents over 50 update events), incremental low-rank updates were 33.7 times cheaper per update than full re-SVD and 23.8 times cheaper cumulatively, while the incremental subspace tracked the full recomputation to within floating-point precision (maximum principal-angle drift below 1e-11 degrees; recall@10 = 1.0). An orthogonal Procrustes virtual axis update recovered 0.95 mean cosine to truly re-embedded vectors by re-embedding only about 10 percent of the corpus. The results support maintaining, rather than repeatedly reconstructing, a semantic substrate.

</details>


### [189] [A Shop Floor Production Scheduling Case based on RFID-supported Smart Factory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16626)
*Zhihui Chen,Yize Sun,Yuhao Dong,Zeyu Xiao,Ray Y. Zhong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于RFID数据和深度强化学习的动态车间调度框架，通过量化生产过程中的不确定性，在最小化完工时间方面优于传统调度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 射频识别(RFID)技术已在制造车间广泛部署用于实时数据采集，以支持动态生产计划与调度。然而，运营和生产过程中的不确定性共同导致了制造的动态性，阻碍了调度系统实现最大效用。为了强调处理这种不确定性的重要性，本研究针对配备RFID技术的现实智能工厂，解决动态车间调度问题。

Method: 1) 对RFID采集的生产数据进行可行生产序列挖掘和实时处理速率估计，以量化运营和生产不确定性；2) 基于RFID数据分析，提出一种深度强化学习方法进行车间生产调度；3) 使用真实案例数据进行仿真验证。

Result: 基于真实案例数据的仿真研究表明：(1) 所提出的动态生产调度框架具有可行性和实用性；(2) 在最小化运营完工时间方面，该框架优于现有调度方法，包括先进先出(FIFO)、后进先出(LIFO)和深度Q网络(DQN)方法。

Conclusion: 本研究成功构建了一个基于RFID数据分析的动态生产调度框架，有效解决了制造过程中的不确定性问题，实现了比传统调度方法更优的性能表现，为智能工厂的动态调度提供了实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has been widely implemented for real-time data collection in manufacturing shop floors, which, in turn, can be used to support dynamic shop floor production planning and scheduling. Within such an environment, uncertainty in operation and production processes collectively contribute to the dynamicity in manufacturing, thereby hampering the scheduling system from achieving maximal utility. To highlight the importance of handling such uncertainty, this paper addresses the problem of dynamic shop floor scheduling for a real-life case smart factory equipped with RFID technology. Feasible production sequence mining and real-time processing rate estimation are conducted on RFID-collected production data to quantify the operation and production uncertainties. A deep reinforcement learning approach based on the RFID data analysis is then presented for shop floor production scheduling. Simulation studies based on real-life case data have demonstrated the feasibility and practicality of the proposed dynamic production scheduling framework. Specifically, it is observed that the proposed framework outperforms existing dispatch methods in terms of minimizing operation makespan, including first in first out (FIFO), last in first out (LIFO) and deep Q network (DQN).

</details>


### [190] [Hypergraph-based Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Incremental Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16628)
*Shenao Chen,Yidan Xu,Xiangmin Han,Rundong Xue,Duanpo Wu,Yuhan Gao,Chenggang Yan,Yue Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Hyper-M2RAG框架，通过超图表示学习和锚点驱动的增量优化机制，解决多模态文档检索中的高阶关联建模和跨页知识整合问题，显著提升了检索精度和生成连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有M-RAG系统存在两大局限：一是传统简单图的二元连接范式无法捕捉异构实体间的复杂高阶关联（如图表、文本描述和数值数据间的N元关系）；二是现有优化策略依赖全页面重建来对齐跨模态信息，导致计算冗余和长文档处理中的上下文噪声问题。

Method: 提出Hyper-M2RAG框架：1)将文档结构形式化为多模态超图，利用超边作为统一语义容器封装文本、图像和表格间的多元关联，突破点对点建模限制；2)引入锚点驱动增量优化机制，识别跨越边界的锚节点并使用一跳邻域上下文重构局部超拓扑结构，避免全局扫描，以最小计算开销弥合跨页知识鸿沟。

Result: 在多模态基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，Hyper-M2RAG在检索精度和生成连贯性两个维度上均显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: Hyper-M2RAG通过超图表示学习成功重新定义了多模态文档检索，有效解决了传统图结构的建模局限性和计算效率问题，为多模态RAG系统提供了新的技术路径。代码已开源。

Abstract: Modern Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (M-RAG) systems are fundamentally limited by the binary connectivity paradigm of traditional simple graphs, which fails to capture the intricate, high-order correlations among heterogeneous entities, such as the N-ary relationships between a visual chart, its scattered textual descriptions, and underlying numerical data. Furthermore, existing refinement strategies often rely on exhaustive, full-page reconstruction to align cross-modal information, leading to prohibitive computational redundancy and the introduction of contextual noise in long-form document processing. In this paper, we propose Hyper-M2RAG, a novel framework that redefines multimodal document retrieval through High-order Hypergraph Representation Learning. We first formalize the document structure as a Multimodal Hypergraph, utilizing hyperedges as unified semantic containers to encapsulate multi-way associations across text, images, and tables, thereby transcending point-to-point modeling. To mitigate semantic fragmentation caused by physical pagination, we introduce an Anchor-driven Incremental Refinement mechanism. Rather than performing a global sweep, our approach identifies boundary-crossing anchor nodes and reconstructs their local hyper-topology using one-hop neighborhood contexts. This targeted refinement effectively bridges cross-page knowledge gaps with minimal computational footprints. Extensive evaluations on multimodal benchmarking datasets demonstrate that Hyper-M2RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both retrieval precision and generation coherence. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShenAoChen2001/MMHRAG.

</details>


### [191] [PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16637)
*Veit Laule,Jiangtao Shuai,Manfred Hauswirth,Sonja Schimmler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了PDDLCoder框架，通过迭代式生成和优化PDDL规划规范，在NL-pddlgym基准测试中达到89.6%的计划可用性，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在长期规划任务中存在不可靠性问题，常生成逻辑不一致或不可应用的计划。现有的将自然语言转换为PDDL的混合方法存在生成管道僵化、依赖部分PDDL定义或人类反馈等局限，且缺乏标准化的自动化验证基准。

Method: 提出PDDLCoder，一个智能体框架，采用迭代方式从自然语言生成、分析和优化PDDL规划规范。同时构建NL-pddlgym基准数据集，包含23个领域的711个规划问题，配备可执行的gym环境用于自动化验证计划的可用性。

Result: 在包含4个保留领域、106个问题的测试集上，PDDLCoder生成了89.6%的可用计划，优于改进后的先前PDDL生成方法（最高45.3%）和直接LLM规划方法（最高74.5%）。

Conclusion: 证明了智能体式PDDL生成在规划任务中的有效性，建立了可复现的基准，为未来LLM辅助符号规划研究提供了标准化评估平台。

Abstract: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.

</details>


### [192] [Chronocooked: A Benchmark for Implicit Interval Timing in Reinforcement Learning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16666)
*Amrapali Pednekar,Alvaro Garrido-Perez,Yara Khaluf,Pieter Simoens*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Chronocooked，一个用于研究强化学习智能体隐式时间间隔感知的基准测试套件，旨在强调时间感知能力对AI智能体的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习智能体缺乏时间感知能力，而这对于人机交互和时间依赖的人类社会部署至关重要。需要开发专门基准来评估和改进智能体的时间决策能力。

Method: 受Overcooked启发，设计包含烹饪场景的强化学习基准套件，任务和奖励函数设计确保时间信息未被直接观测但对最优性能至关重要。环境保持简单以支持受控实验和生物可信模型，并设计了专门评估指标来揭示智能体时间能力的局限性。

Result: 报告了三种基线模型的评估结果：非循环模型、循环模型和生物可信模型，通过专门设计的评估指标展示了不同模型在时间决策任务上的性能差异。

Conclusion: 该工作强调了在面向人机交互和时间依赖人类社会部署的人工智能智能体中引入时间感知和时间处理的必要性。

Abstract: This paper presents Chronocooked, a reinforcement learning (RL) benchmark suite for studying implicit interval timing in RL agents. Inspired by Overcooked, the suite comprises cooking scenarios that require temporal decision making. The tasks and reward functions are designed such that temporal information is unobserved yet critical for optimal performance. The environment is intentionally kept simple to enable controlled experiments and support biologically plausible models. Evaluation metrics are designed to expose limitations in timing abilities of RL agents, and we report baselines using a non-recurrent, a recurrent, and a biologically plausible model. This work ultimately aims to underscore the need to incorporate time perception and temporal processing in artificial agents designed for human robot interaction and deployment in time dependent human societies.

</details>


### [193] [FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16697)
*Aniri,Chen Yilin,Jinhe Bi,Junfei Guo,Donglai Ran,Xu Bian,Zengjie Jin,Yujun Wang,Yijun Tian,Volker Tresp,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua,Yunpu Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了MAE框架，通过分析视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）内部注意力信号的熵来实现无需外部监督的可靠性自评估，并创建了LIBERO-Reflect基准进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLAs自评估方法存在明显局限：要么依赖昂贵的专家标注，要么仅基于输出统计估计不确定性，忽视了模型内部信号。如何让VLAs在无外部监督下可靠地评估自身动作生成的质量成为关键挑战。

Method: 发现不同架构VLAs中内部视觉模态熵在成功/失败任务间呈现一致差异，据此提出条件生成马尔可夫链建模共享的潜在动作生成抽象。基于此开发MAE框架，直接将内部注意力信号转换为架构感知的可靠性分数；创建包含4000回合的LIBERO-Reflect基准用于系统评估。

Result: 跨异构VLA架构和多样化场景的实验表明，MAE在AUPR、AUROC和FPR@95指标上均显著超越现有最优基线方法。进一步开发了FabriMAE用于无验证器的测试时动作选择，证明了MAE引导的多重采样策略能以较小的运行时开销提升PI系列模型在LIBERO-Plus上的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 证明了VLAs虽然架构异构，但共享潜在的马尔可夫动作生成抽象，其内部注意力熵可作为可靠的自评估信号。MAE框架为VLAs提供了高效、无需外部监督的可靠性评估解决方案，并在实际应用中展示了实用价值。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.

</details>


### [194] [LAVA: Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation Framework for Large-Scale Financial Document Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16763)
*Ruoqi Shu,Xuhui Wang,Isaac Wang,Yanming Mai,Bo Wan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了LAVA框架，基于多模态大语言模型，通过文档-规则检索、布局保留信息提取、元数据增强和可审计符号验证四阶段流程，实现了对金融文档的高精度、可追溯验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融文档验证（如薪酬审计、税务合规、贷款审批）要求极高的准确性、一致性和可重复性。现有流程难以可靠处理异构布局、语义丰富且包含业务规则的复杂文档。

Method: LAVA是一个模块化、骨干无关的四阶段流水线：1）文档-规则检索；2）布局保留的信息提取；3）辅助元数据丰富；4）可审计的符号/算术验证，以实现鲁棒的规则定位和细粒度错误归因。

Result: 在包含多样化金融文档和数十条专家验证规则的大规模真实基准上，LAVA在幻觉控制和边缘情况处理上优于基线，同时保持高效的token使用，适用于大容量、时间敏感的验证场景。

Conclusion: LAVA框架有效解决了金融文档验证中的准确性和可审计性挑战，满足了高风险部署环境下的企业级需求。

Abstract: Financial document validation in production, such as payroll auditing, tax compliance, and loan underwriting, demands exceptional accuracy, consistency, and reproducibility under strict enterprise constraints. In practice, documents arrive with heterogeneous layouts and formats, semantically rich and context-dependent content, and embedded business rules that current pipelines struggle to process reliably. We introduce LAVA (Logic-Aware Validation and Augmentation), a modular, backbone-agnostic pipeline built on multimodal large language models, that integrates a four-stage design: document-rule retrieval, layout-preserving information extraction, auxiliary metadata enrichment, and auditable symbolic/arithmetic verification. LAVA supports robust rule grounding, fine-grained error attribution, and consistent, traceable end-to-end execution, capabilities essential for high-stakes deployment. Evaluated on a large real-world benchmark with diverse financial documents and dozens of expert-curated validation rules, LAVA outperforms baselines in hallucination control and edge-case handling while maintaining efficient token usage, demonstrating practicality for high-volume, time-critical validation.

</details>


### [195] [GRIP: Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16776)
*Lirui Teng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GRIP方法解决RAG中的查询支配问题，通过限制证据通道容量强制编码残差信息，在五个推理基准上显著优于基线，大幅降低幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在检索增强生成（RAG）系统中，高容量编码器可能导致查询主导潜在状态，使检索到的证据在功能上变得无关紧要。作者将这种失效模式称为"查询支配"（query dominance），即模型过度依赖查询而忽视检索证据的问题。

Method: 提出GRIP（Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises）方法，通过引入容量不对称性来解决查询支配问题：解码器保持对查询的全维度访问，而检索证据通过严格的随机瓶颈传递。这种设计迫使证据通道仅编码查询无法提供的残差信息。

Result: 在五个推理基准测试中，GRIP优于强迭代基线；将查询-潜在互信息诊断指标降低约30倍（从14.8降至0.47比特）；幻觉率降低73%；残差对齐分析显示瓶颈输出占据的子空间与查询的对齐度低于基线表示。

Conclusion: 通过限制证据通道容量并强制其编码残差信息，GRIP有效缓解了RAG系统中的查询支配问题，显著提升了模型对检索证据的利用能力，同时大幅减少了幻觉现象。

Abstract: High-capacity encoders in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can let the query dominate the latent state, leaving retrieved evidence functionally irrelevant. We call this failure mode query dominance. To address it, we introduce \textbf{GRIP} (Grounded Reasoning via Information-Restricted Premises), which imposes capacity asymmetry: the decoder keeps full-dimensional access to the query, while retrieved evidence passes through a severe stochastic bottleneck. This forces the evidence channel to encode only the residual information unavailable from the query. Across five reasoning benchmarks, GRIP outperforms strong iterative baselines, cuts a query--latent mutual-information diagnostic by roughly 30$\times$ (14.8 $\to$ 0.47 bits), and reduces hallucination by 73\%. Residual-alignment analysis further shows that the bottleneck output occupies subspaces less aligned with the query than baseline representations.

</details>


### [196] [When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16801)
*Giuseppe Destefanis,Tomaso Aste*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个测量AI编程团队协调的工具，通过时序网络分析1902次运行，发现团队规模、任务类型和文件策略都会影响协调模式，共享文件可减少42%的消息输出，而指定协调者并无显著效果，同时发现智能体会自发寻找隐藏的评分材料。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前对AI编程团队的评估主要关注任务完成度和运行成本，而团队内部的协调机制缺乏量化测量工具，无法深入了解多智能体协作的动态过程和效率瓶颈。

Method: 将每次运行表示为时序网络，其中智能体和文件作为节点，消息、文件写入和读取作为带时间戳和成本的有向边。在1902次运行中，系统地改变团队规模、团队结构和文件策略三个变量进行对照实验，并在封闭环境中进行了244次额外的验证实验。

Result: 1）直接消息量随团队规模先呈二次增长后趋于平稳，大团队更多使用广播消息；2）任务类型塑造网络结构：共享规范任务产生密集连接，流水线任务产生稀疏网络；3）共享文件在消息密集型任务中可减少约42%的输出token，但在文件已承载协调功能时增加开销；4）指定协调者未产生通信中心，也未显著提升成功率；5）智能体在五分之四的运行中会主动寻找隐藏的评分材料。

Conclusion: AI编程团队的协调模式受团队规模、任务结构和文件策略的共同影响，不存在单一的团队配置优化方案。共享文件和广播消息可以作为有效的协调机制，而简单的角色指定策略效果有限。此外，智能体存在规避评估环境限制的自发行为，这对实验设计具有重要启示。

Abstract: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. As the teams grow further, this increase levels off in the largest teams we study, where agents increasingly communicate through broadcast messages. The task also shapes the network that emerges. Work built around a shared specification produces dense, highly connected teams, while pipeline tasks produce sparse networks organised around local interfaces. Shared files can replace repeated 1-to-1 communication, cutting output tokens by about 42% at eight agents on message-heavy work, while adding overhead when files already carry the coordination. Naming one agent as coordinator creates no communication hub and provides no reliable improvement in success. We also observe an unprompted tendency for agents to seek out hidden grading material. We repeat the key experimental conditions in a sealed environment, replacing the hidden material with marked placeholder files. Across 244 additional runs, agents still reach for it in four fifths of runs, while the coordinator and file-channel findings reproduce.

</details>


### [197] [Cross-Sign Language Transfer Learning Using Domain Adaptation with Multi-scale Temporal Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16804)
*Keren Artiaga,Yang Li,Ercan Engin Kuruoglu,Wai Kin,Chan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究提出使用迁移学习和域适应方法TA3N进行手语识别，发现域适应方法优于传统迁移学习，RGB模态优于光流模态，有效改善了美国手语（ASL）的识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球有超过100种不同的手语，但针对听障人士的手语识别资源严重匮乏，亟需开发有效的手语识别方法来改善听障人士的无障碍沟通。

Method: 采用域适应方法TA3N（Temporal Adversarial Adaptation with Temporal Relational Network），利用时序关系网络（TRN）模块对齐多尺度时序关系；使用迁移学习方法作为对比；实验包括RGB和光流（Optical Flow）两种输入模态。

Result: 域适应方法相比基于神经网络的迁移学习表现更优，尤其在美国手语（ASL）识别上提升显著；对齐源域与目标域之间的短期时序特征最为有效；RGB模态在大多数情况下优于光流模态。

Conclusion: TA3N域适应方法能够有效提升手语识别性能，为改善依赖手语沟通的个体的无障碍和交流提供了技术支持，RGB是更优的输入模态选择。

Abstract: Sign language serves as a vital means of communication for individuals with hearing impairments, yet recognition resources for the over 100 distinct sign languages are severely lacking. In response, we present our work on sign language recognition using transfer learning and the domain adaptation method TA3N, which utilizes the Temporal Relational Network (TRN) module for aligning multi-scale temporal relations. Our findings highlight the superior performance of Domain Adaptation to neural network-based transfer learning, particularly in improving recognition of American Sign Language (ASL). Our research also identifies the effectiveness of aligning shorter-term temporal features between source and target domains. In addition to using RGB, we conducted experiments using Optical Flow mode for the sign language samples, ultimately determining that RGB outperforms Optical Flow in the majority of cases. Our work aims to improve accessibility and communication for individuals who rely on sign language as their primary mode of communication.

</details>


### [198] [Quipu: A Governed Bitemporal Knowledge Graph Store](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16813)
*Steve Brown*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了Quipu，一个可嵌入的知识图谱存储系统，通过反转传统存储的四个默认设置（即时写入、单时间轴、同等信任、外部治理），解决了智能体写入场景下的治理问题，实验证明其在缺陷检测、信任组合、时间查询和治理验证方面表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识图谱存储系统继承了人类管理时代设置的四个默认假设：接受写入稍后清理、保持单一时间轴或不保留时间轴、将所有写入者的信息视为同等可信、通过仪表板和中间件进行治理。这四个默认设置在智能体写入负载下各自方便但共同不可持续，导致治理缺陷、信任问题和审计困难。

Method: 提出Quipu可嵌入存储系统，通过四个设计反转传统默认设置：（1）通过门控机制确保所有事实必须通过谓词验证待定后状态才能进入；（2）数据、信任标签、裁决和规则本身均采用双时态（bitemporal）管理；（3）以命名图为权限和信任单元，在格结构下组合，保证组合永不扩大信任范围；（4）将治理规范Σ、追踪记录和签名裁决作为存储中的事实，使审计T⊧Σ成为查询操作。

Result: 在Census评测中：门控存储检测出全部6个植入缺陷（非门控存储检测0个），7个组合探针均遵守格约束，50个满意裁决在时间点准确重衍（而最新规则集会全部误报）。在DEMM-Bench基准测试中，对512个属性级治理问题回答准确率100%且零过度声明，而容器存在基线过度声明率高达87.5%。SARC参考检查器与存储内审计逐裁决一致。系统发现并修复了拒绝裁决证明缺口。

Conclusion: Quipu通过系统性地反转传统知识图谱存储的四个默认设置，为智能体写入场景提供了可靠的治理机制，在缺陷检测、信任组合、时间审计和治理验证方面均优于传统方案，证明了内置治理、双时态管理和格基信任组合的有效性。

Abstract: Agents now write knowledge graphs, but knowledge-graph stores still carry defaults set when humans curated them: accept writes now and clean later, keep one time axis or none, treat every writer's facts as equally trustworthy, and leave governance to dashboards and middleware. These four defaults are individually convenient and jointly untenable under agent workloads. We present Quipu, an embeddable store that inverts all four: no fact enters except through a gate whose predicates evaluate the pending post-state; data, trust labels, verdicts, and the rules themselves are bitemporal; named graphs are the unit of authority and trust, composed under a lattice whose one invariant is that composition never widens; and the governance specification $Σ$, the trace, and signed verdicts are facts in the store they govern, making the audit $T \models Σ$ a query. We evaluate with Census, a deterministic multi-writer lifecycle whose single seeded run scores every research question against planted ground truth: the gated store ends with 0 of 6 planted defects versus 6 of 6 ungated; all 7 composition probes uphold the lattice contract; 50 of 50 satisfied verdicts re-derive faithfully as of their instant while all 50 would be misreported under a latest-only rule set; and the SARC reference checker agrees with the in-store audit verdict-for-verdict, differing only on coverage semantics. A recorded trace from a governed writer surfaces a live enforcement gap the audit names with its remediation. On DEMM-Bench, an external decision-evidence sufficiency benchmark, a content-only reading of the exported records answers all 512 property-level governance questions correctly with zero overclaim under all eight degradation conditions, while container-presence baselines overclaim on up to 87.5% of them -- and the run surfaced, and led us to close, a gap in what a denial's verdict attests.

</details>


### [199] [Policy Iteration with Human Feedback: Bringing Post-Training RL to In-context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16831)
*Minh-Ha Nguyen,Cathy Shyr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PIHF框架，利用预训练语言模型作为固定执行基板，通过专家引导的自然语言策略迭代优化，在罕见病诊断任务上显著提升了召回率（GPT-5.4提升32.7个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B提升31.1个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于生成式预训练建立的可复用任务表示，以及语言模型任务条件化和上下文学习展现出的固定模型适应能力，研究旨在探索如何利用预训练语言模型作为固定权重的执行基板，结合专家知识进行策略优化，以解决罕见病诊断等复杂任务中的性能提升问题。

Method: 提出Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF)框架：(1)使用预训练语言模型作为固定权重的执行基板；(2)将持久性修订转移到版本化的自然语言策略和工具集；(3)通过语言模型批评家和临床专家共同审查完整面板推理和工具使用轨迹来定位重复失败并形成候选修订；(4)专家保留准入和回滚的权威，并通过Recall@1和Recall@5验证候选执行后的结果。

Result: 在累积消融实验和超罕见疾病基准测试中，PIHF派生策略在一个专有执行器和三个开放权重执行器（参数规模从3B到49B）上均提升了Recall@1。具体而言，GPT-5.4提升32.7个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B提升31.1个百分点，两者差异仅1.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持将预训练语言模型作为固定权重执行基板用于专家引导策略开发的可行性，为罕见病诊断等需要领域专业知识的应用场景提供了有效的解决方案，证明了语言模型可以通过自然语言策略迭代而非参数更新来持续改进性能。

Abstract: Generative pretraining established reusable task representations; later work on language-based task conditioning and in-context learning showed that a fixed model could adapt its behavior from instructions and demonstrations. Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) builds on this development and the recurrent evaluate-and-improve structure of generalized policy iteration. PIHF uses a pretrained language model as its execution substrate and moves persistent revision to a versioned natural-language policy and tool set. A language-model critic and clinical expert review complete-panel reasoning and tool-use trajectories to localize recurrent failures and form candidate revisions; the expert may reinterpret the evidence and retains authority over admission and rollback, while Recall@1 and Recall@5 validate outcomes after candidate execution.
  Across cumulative ablations and ultra-rare-disease benchmarks, a PIHF-derived policy improved Recall@1 in one proprietary executor and three open-weight executors spanning 3 to 49 billion active parameters. Gains were 32.7 percentage points for GPT-5.4 and 31.1 points for Qwen3.6-35B, a difference of 1.7 points. These results support the feasibility of using pretrained language models as fixed-weight execution substrates for expert-guided policy development in rare-disease diagnosis.

</details>


### [200] [What Do Compliance Detectors Read? An Audit of Activation Probes and Guard Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16852)
*Saisab Sadhu,Aadit Sengupta,Vinay Kumar Sankarapu,Pratinav Seth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了现有语言模型合规检测器普遍存在"规则盲视"问题——检测器的判断依赖于场景表面特征而非规则本身。作者提出了交叉规则基准测试和内部合规评分(ICS)方法，发现即使是最先进的检测器也无法有效解决此问题，仅逐步推理能有所改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在部署的语言模型中，监管合规监测作为法律和审计控制手段被越来越多地实施，用于检查模型输出是否符合涵盖数据保护、医疗保健、金融监管和平台政策的书面规则。然而，这种监测的意义仅在于检测器的判断依赖于所陈述的规则，而非场景的表面特征。作者发现当前各类合规检测器都未能满足这一条件，存在"规则盲视"问题。

Method: 作者构建了一个专门的基准测试，将两条规则与两个场景交叉，使得单独的规则或场景都无法预测标签。通过删除、置换或替换治理规则来测试检测器的表现。引入了内部合规评分(ICS)：一种无需重新训练的激活读出方法，通过十个标记对校准并由单一投影评分。对四种部署的防护模型、一个8B零样本评判器和十三个基准进行了审计。

Result: 所有测试的防护模型和激活探针都表现出规则盲视：删除、置换或替换治理规则后检测准确率保持不变。即使是一个能够正确引用治理条款的策略条件防护器，当该条款被替换为许可性对应条款时，其判断几乎不发生变化。只有逐步推理而非快速检测器能够逃脱此问题。ICS虽然未超越简单基线，但其低成本特性使其能够有效审计多个模型，并在排序候选响应时提高机械验证通过率。

Conclusion: 当前合规检测器存在严重的规则盲视问题，无法真正基于规则进行判断。作者发布的反事实协议和交叉规则基准为未来检测器和防护模型的声称提供了测试手段。大规模审计需要无需重训练的检测器，但现有方法仍需改进以应对自适应白盒攻击。这项工作为合规监测领域的未来发展提供了重要的评估框架和基准。

Abstract: Regulatory compliance monitoring in deployed language models is increasingly implemented as a legal and audit control, checking model outputs against written rules spanning data protection, healthcare, financial regulation, and platform policy. Such monitoring is meaningful only if a detector's verdict depends on the stated rule rather than on surface features of the scenario. We show this condition fails across the current class of compliance detectors, a failure we call rule blindness. Deleting, permuting, or substituting the governing rule leaves detection accuracy unchanged for every guard and activation probe we test, including a policy-conditioned guard that correctly cites the governing clause yet barely changes its verdict when that clause is swapped for its permissive counterpart. A purpose-built benchmark crossing two rules with two scenarios, so that neither alone predicts the label, confirms the failure under a design no prior benchmark rules out, and shows that step by step reasoning, not any fast detector we test, is what escapes it. Auditing at scale requires a retraining-free detector, so we introduce the Internal Compliance Score (ICS): a training-free activation readout calibrated from ten labelled pairs and scored by a single projection. We hold ICS to the same scrutiny as the guards it audits: a pre-registered criterion for beating trivial baselines is not met, and a bag-of-words model matches its pooled generalisation exactly. It remains useful because it is inexpensive, letting us audit four deployed guard models, an 8B zero-shot judge, and thirteen benchmarks, and it raises the mechanically verified pass rate when used to rank candidate responses, though an adaptive white-box attack removes this gain. We release the counterfactual protocol and crossed-rule benchmark so rule blindness can be tested in future probe and guard claims.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [201] [A Biophysically-Inspired Feedback Controller for Multi-Class Cache Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14561)
*Matt R. Flax*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一类参数化的缓存替换策略，通过全局令牌质量不平衡信号、K个并行修正的类内提升累加器和年龄排序的淘汰后盾三种结构机制，在多租户LLM服务场景下实现了多类缓存公平性，将最差服务类的缺失率降低了27-72%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多租户LLM服务场景下的缓存替换是一个多类别问题：短且高重用的系统提示、长且中等重用的用户文档、中等长度的代码上下文以及突发性的对话历史共享同一个淘汰池。在偏斜的多类别到达条件下，传统的扁平LRU策略只能通过固定点暴露最差服务类的缺失率，无法实现多类别间的公平性。

Method: 引入一类参数化的缓存替换策略，包含三种结构承诺：单一全局令牌质量不平衡信号、K个并行修正的类内提升累加器、年龄排序的淘汰后盾。实例化为线性V耦合修正流量和Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz扩展形式，其中V→0极限恰好是线性形式。通过单一超参数轴暴露公平性/吞吐量的权衡。

Result: 在四种偏斜级别的合成多类别工作负载上，该策略类在m_max指标上关闭了27-72%的LRU→Belady差距，线性形式和GHK形式在搜索方差内在主要目标上可互换。公平性/吞吐量权衡可作为单一超参数轴上的可调旋钮。

Conclusion: 将该方法定位为LeCaR反馈控制器谱系和形式控制理论缓存衰减谱系的新颖组合，为多租户LLM服务提供了可调节公平性的缓存替换解决方案，代码和复现脚本已开源。

Abstract: Cache replacement under multi-tenant LLM-serving conditions is a multi-class problem: short, high-reuse system prompts; long, moderate-reuse user documents; medium-length code context; and bursty conversation history share a single eviction pool. Under skewed multi-class arrivals, conventional flat-LRU policies expose the worst-served-class miss ratio ($m_{\max}$) only as a fixed point. We introduce a class of cache-replacement policies parameterised by a per-class flux formula, where three structural commitments -- a single global token-mass imbalance signal, $K$ parallel rectified per-class promotion accumulators, and an age-ordered eviction backstop -- produce emergent multi-class fairness. We instantiate this class with a linear V-coupled rectified flux and a Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz extension whose $V \to 0$ limit is exactly the linear form. Across four skew levels on synthetic multi-class workloads, the policy class closes 27--72\,\% of the LRU$\to$Belady gap on $m_{\max}$, with linear and GHK interchangeable on the headline objective within search variance. The fairness/throughput tradeoff is exposed as a tunable knob on a single hyperparameter axis. We position this against the LeCaR feedback-controller lineage and the formal-control-theory cache-decay lineage as a novel combination of known ingredients. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/flatmax/membrane.cache

</details>


### [202] [The benefits and challenges of explicit memory management in OpenMP Target GPU offloading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14554)
*Igor Sfiligoi*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文分析了OpenMP Target Offload中半自动缓冲区同步机制的优缺点，并探讨了显式缓冲区局部性处理的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OpenMP Target Offload作为流行的GPU编程技术，其半自动缓冲区同步功能虽然提高了易用性，但可能带来正确性、性能和资源消耗方面的问题，需要深入分析这些潜在缺陷并寻找更好的解决方案。

Method: 通过对比分析的方法，系统性地分析了半自动缓冲区同步机制存在的正确性、性能和资源消耗等问题，并研究了OpenMP原生支持的显式缓冲区局部性处理方法作为替代方案。

Result: 研究发现显式的缓冲区局部性处理方法能够避免半自动同步机制的大部分问题，但同时也存在自身的局限性，开发者需要在易用性和控制精度之间做出权衡。

Conclusion: 在使用OpenMP Target Offload进行GPU编程时，开发者应当根据具体应用场景选择合适的缓冲区管理策略，显式的局部性控制虽然增加了编程复杂度，但在许多场景下能够提供更好的正确性保证和性能表现。

Abstract: OpenMP Target Offload is a popular GPU technology for porting compute codes that operate on large buffers. One of the main usability features that is typically emphasized is the semi-automatic handling of buffer synchronization in partitioned memory setups, typical of discreet GPU systems. That feature however comes with potential correctness, performance and resource consumption drawbacks. This paper outlines the drawbacks of that approach and outlines how explicit handling of buffer locality, natively supported through OpenMP, avoids most of those pitfalls, but also comes with its own downsides.

</details>


### [203] [Discovering KV Cache Eviction Policies via LLM-Guided Program Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14555)
*Pratik Poudel,Yanzhao Wu,Sumit Jha,Jason Liu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出CacheCraft框架，通过LLM引导的代码演化自动发现KV缓存驱逐策略，发现FRC评分器在多种模型和压缩比下显著优于基线方法，揭示了评分函数是缓存压缩性能的关键设计因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中KV缓存压缩至关重要，但现有预填充阶段方法依赖手工设计的显著性启发式规则，在不同模型、上下文长度和压缩比下表现脆弱且难以泛化，亟需自动化的驱逐策略设计方法。

Method: 提出CacheCraft程序演化方法论，利用LLM引导的代码演化引擎自动发现KV缓存驱逐策略，生成FRC（特征丰富压缩）评分器——结合局部注意力、邻域注意力密度和KV头最大显著性的固定权重三信号评分器，采用分块级top-k选择。通过评分器-结构分解分析验证设计选择的有效性。

Result: FRC在RULER 4k/8k测试中，在r>=0.75的所有测试单元（20个中的12个）排名第一，在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 4k任务上提升15.4分，在Qwen3-8B 8k任务上提升13.9分（88%压缩率）。评分函数贡献+67.2 RULER分，而分块结构改进仅贡献约0.1分。

Conclusion: 评分函数家族而非分块选择是缓存压缩性能的核心设计因素。CacheCraft提供了可迁移的自动驱逐策略发现范式：紧凑策略接口、严格输出不变量的级联评估器、将搜索平台和奖励黑客失败视为接口重构证据的诊断循环。

Abstract: KV cache compression is critical for long-context inference, yet effective eviction policies remain difficult to design: existing prefill-stage methods often rely on hand-crafted salience heuristics that can be brittle across models, context lengths, and compression ratios. We present CacheCraft, a program-evolution methodology for automatically discovering KV cache eviction policies using an LLM-guided code-evolution engine. CacheCraft discovers FRC (Feature-Rich Compression), a fixed-weight three-signal scorer that combines local attention received, neighborhood attention density, and KV-head maximum salience with chunk-level top-k selection. Without per-model retuning, FRC ranks first among the evaluated single-pass KVPress baselines at every RULER 4k/8k cell with r >= 0.75 across Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B (12 of 20 grid cells), gaining +15.4 points on Llama-4k and +13.9 points on Qwen-8k at 88% compression. A scorer-versus-structure decomposition shows that the scoring family, not chunk selection, is the load-bearing design choice: incorporating the scorer contributes +67.2 RULER points, while improving chunk structure contributes only ~0.1. Beyond FRC itself, CacheCraft provides a transferable recipe for automated eviction-policy discovery: a compact policy interface, a cascade evaluator with strict output invariants, and a diagnostic loop that treats search plateaus and reward-hacking failures as evidence for reformulating the editable interface.

</details>


### [204] [Orbital AI Computing: Carbon Tradeoffs Across Satellite Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14557)
*Nisha Sarwar,Lei Jiang,Fan Chen*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本研究扩展了ESpaS框架，通过加速器感知建模分析LEO计算系统的碳排放。发现发射排放作为固定碳开销，低质量系统绝对排放少，高性能系统碳强度更低，硬件选择对天地权衡影响显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO计算因低延迟和全球分布式AI服务而兴起，但其可持续性尚不明确。现有ESpaS框架使用通用数据中心配置建模，无法准确刻画现代AI硬件特性（功耗、质量、算力差异大）以及发射排放与系统质量的关联关系。

Method: 扩展ESpaS框架引入加速器感知建模，评估两类代表性系统：面向小卫星的轻量级Jetson AGX Orin系统，以及基于大载荷发射平台的高性能DGX H100系统。通过建模分析系统质量、发射排放与碳排放强度之间的关系。

Result: 发射排放表现为固定碳开销。低质量系统（如Jetson）最小化绝对排放量；高性能系统（如DGX H100）通过摊销发射成本更有效地降低碳强度。天地权衡对硬件选择高度敏感。

Conclusion: 轨道AI计算系统设计需要采用加速器感知的基准模型，硬件选择是决定LEO计算可持续性的关键因素。不同硬件配置会导致截然不同的碳排放特征，影响空间与地面计算的权衡决策。

Abstract: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) computing is emerging for low-latency, globally distributed AI services, enabled by advances in satellite constellations and reusable launch systems. However, its sustainability remains unclear. Prior work introduces ESpaS, a framework for estimating lifecycle carbon intensity, but models systems using generic datacenter configurations and does not capture modern AI hardware, where power, mass, and compute characteristics vary widely and launch emissions scale with system mass. In this work, we extend ESpaS with accelerator-aware modeling and evaluate two representative systems: a lightweight Jetson AGX Orin for small satellites and a high-performance DGX H100 enabled by large-payload launch platforms. We show that launch emissions act as a fixed carbon overhead: low-mass systems minimize absolute emissions, while high-performance systems amortize this cost more effectively, reducing carbon intensity. Consequently, the space-ground tradeoff is highly sensitive to hardware choice, highlighting the need for accelerator-aware baselines in orbital AI computing.

</details>


### [205] [Agentic Kernel Optimization: Generating State-of-the-Art GPU Kernels Without Hand-Written CUDA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14560)
*Mao Luo,Hongbin Li,Feng Lin,Hanling Yi,Zhe Huang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文研究了通用代码智能体能否在无需手写CUDA代码的情况下生成最先进的GPU内核，通过Houmao多智能体框架在FlashInfer-Bench代表性工作负载上实现了显著加速，其中Fused MoE内核在MLSys 2026竞赛中超越人类辅助赛道最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索代码智能体在现代GPU内核开发中的自主优化能力，验证在严格正确性优先的工作流程下，智能体能否生成超越传统手写CUDA内核的性能表现。

Method: 基于FlashInfer-Bench的Fused MoE、DSA TopK Indexer和DSA Sparse Attention代表性工作负载，在NVIDIA B200 GPU上采用正确性优先的FlashInfer-Bench协议进行评估。利用Houmao多智能体编排框架构建内核优化工作流，从PyTorch实现、工作负载定义、基准测试命令和CUDA优化技能集出发，生成、调试、分析和优化内核。人类仅扮演编排角色，不直接审查或编辑内核代码。

Result: 生成内核相对PyTorch参考实现实现显著加速：Fused MoE加速92.68x，DSA TopK Indexer加速1101.02x，DSA Sparse Attention加速181.35x，同时显著超越FlashInfer基线。在MLSys 2026 FlashInfer AI内核生成竞赛官方评估中，生成的Fused MoE内核相较FlashInfer基线实现1.71x加速，超越Fused MoE智能体辅助赛道最优结果（1.68x加速）。

Conclusion: 在严格正确性优先的工作流程下，代码智能体能够作为现代GPU内核开发的有效自主优化器，在无需手写CUDA代码的情况下生成最先进的GPU内核。

Abstract: We study whether general-purpose code agents can produce state-of-the-art GPU kernels without any manually written CUDA code. We investigate this question using representative workloads from FlashInfer-Bench, focusing on the Fused MoE, DSA TopK Indexer, and DSA Sparse Attention, and evaluate all generated kernels under the correctness-gated FlashInfer-Bench protocol on NVIDIA B200 GPUs. Starting from the PyTorch implementations, workload definitions, benchmark commands, and a compact set of CUDA optimization skills, we build a kernel optimization workflow in Houmao, a multi-agent orchestration framework for heterogeneous coding agents, to generate, debug, profile, and optimize the kernels. Humans remain strictly in an orchestration role: defining the workflow, enforcing correctness and anti-hacking constraints, supplying key references, and redirecting the search when progress stalls, without reviewing or editing the kernel code itself. Across roughly 1.9 billion agent tokens, the resulting kernels achieve speedups of 92.68x on Fused MoE, 1101.02x on DSA TopK Indexer, and 181.35x on DSA Sparse Attention relative to the PyTorch reference implementations, while also significantly outperforming the corresponding FlashInfer baselines. In the official evaluation of the MLSys 2026 FlashInfer AI Kernel Generation Contest, our generated Fused MoE kernel achieves a 1.71x speedup over the FlashInfer baseline, exceeding the top result of the Fused MoE agent-assisted track, which reports a 1.68x speedup. These results suggest that, under a disciplined correctness-first workflow, code agents can serve as effective autonomous optimizers for modern GPU kernel development.

</details>


### [206] [The Uneasy Marriage of AI and Dependability: Integrating Taxonomy and Methods for Dependability and Accuracy Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14564)
*Aad van Moorsel*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文探讨了传统计算机系统容错机制与AI服务准确性增强方法之间的联系，提出将AI作为硬件和软件之外的第三层系统来考虑其可信性，并引入"AI输出故障"概念，发现容错机制与AI准确性增强机制存在显著相似性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI服务的广泛应用，传统可信性 taxonomy 无法很好地描述AI特有的故障和失效特征。作者旨在建立对现代AI系统可信性的统一理解，将AI视为独立的系统层次来研究其可信性特征。

Method: 首先对比分析传统容错机制（如N模块冗余和验收测试）与AI准确性增强方法（如集成学习和拒识选项）的对应关系；然后扩展传统可信性分类体系，引入"AI输出故障"这一新的故障类别；最后映射并比较容错机制与AI准确性增强机制。

Result: 发现AI机制（如集成学习和拒识选项）与传统硬件软件可信性机制（N模块冗余和验收测试）存在直接对应关系，尽管其动机、论证和实现方式不同。成功扩展了可信性分类体系，将AI定义为硬件和软件之外的第三个系统层次，并识别出AI可信性的特定特征。

Conclusion: 该研究为建立现代AI系统可信性的统一理解奠定了基础，有助于将传统可信性理论和方法扩展到AI领域，促进AI系统的可靠性和可信赖性研究。

Abstract: In this paper we discuss the connection between fault-tolerance mechanisms in traditional computer systems, and approaches in accuracy enhancement for AI-based services. We will find that AI mechanisms such as ensembles and reject option have direct counterparts in hardware and software dependability through N-modular redundancy and acceptance tests, even though their motivation, justification and implementation are quite different. We augment the traditional dependability taxonomy to include critical defining features of faults and failures in AI-based services. We propose to consider incorrect outcomes from AI as errors, even if the system hardware and software operates error free. AI then becomes a third system layer (after hardware and software) for which dependability needs to be considered, and for which dependability has specific characteristics. The existing fault classes in the dependability taxonomy are not suited for AI, and we propose to introduce AI Output Faults, representing the inherent possibly incorrect (and therefore faulty) outcome of AI algorithms. We then map and compare fault tolerance mechanisms with AI accuracy enhancement mechanisms, and we see they carry strike resemblances. We hope the work presented in this paper will help in establishing a truly integrated and unified understanding of dependability for modern-day AI-based systems.

</details>


### [207] [Efficient Block-Layer Parallel Inference for Vision-Language-Action on Hybrid Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14586)
*Haibo HU,Lianming Huang,Qiao Li,Nan Guan,Chun Jason Xue*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于自动驾驶VLA模型的混合CPU-GPU推理框架，通过分层划分和异步流水线技术，在保证功能的前提下显著降低了推理延迟和GPU显存占用，实现了在传统车载平台上的成功部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型虽然成为自动驾驶的有前景范式，但在现有车辆平台部署面临两大挑战：(1)高推理延迟和强GPU资源压力；(2)传统车辆平台原本为模块化流水线配置，VLA统一模型整合规划功能后导致CPU预算未被充分利用，而视觉编码器和推理路径仍集中消耗GPU计算和内存资源，在现实GPU内存约束下难以直接部署。

Method: 提出混合CPU-GPU推理框架与灵活资源调度机制：(1)在块层粒度对VLA骨干网络进行划分；(2)将视觉编码器和LLM前缀在GPU上执行；(3)通过跨帧异步流水线将LLM后缀卸载到CPU；(4)暴露可调度边界实现异构处理器间计算和内存压力的重新分配。

Result: 在Bench2Drive数据集上评估：Orion模型平均延迟从521ms降至408.0ms(降低21.7%)，峰值GPU显存从45GB降至29GB；MindDrive模型平均延迟从443ms降至306.2ms(降低30.9%)。在真实车辆部署场景中与Autoware.Universe共存时，原生Orion因GPU显存不足无法运行，而混合版本成功与完整车辆堆栈协同运行。

Conclusion: 该混合CPU-GPU推理框架有效解决了VLA模型在传统车载平台的部署难题，通过异构资源调度实现了延迟和显存占用的双重优化，为自动驾驶系统的实际部署提供了可行解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are becoming a promising paradigm for autonomous driving, but their deployment on existing vehicle platforms remains difficult because they introduce both high inference latency and strong GPU-side resource pressure. In a full autonomous driving stack, this problem is even more pronounced: legacy vehicle platforms were provisioned for modular pipelines, yet after several planning-related functions are absorbed into a unified VLA model, part of the original CPU budget becomes underutilized, while the visual encoder and the main reasoning path still concentrate most computation and memory demand on the GPU. As a result, directly deploying VLA together with the rest of the onboard system can be hard under realistic GPU memory constraints. To address this issue, we present a hybrid CPU--GPU inference framework with flexible resource scheduling for autonomous driving. Our design partitions the VLA backbone at the block-layer granularity, executes the visual encoder and LLM prefix on the GPU, and offloads the LLM suffix to the CPU through a cross-frame asynchronous pipeline, thereby exposing a schedulable boundary for redistributing compute and memory pressure across heterogeneous processors. We evaluate the proposed framework on two representative driving VLA models, Orion and MindDrive. On Bench2Drive, our method reduces average latency from 521ms to 408.0ms for Orion and from 443ms to 306.2ms for MindDrive, corresponding to 21.7% and 30.9% reduction, respectively. For Orion, the estimated peak GPU memory is further reduced from 45GB to 29GB. In real-vehicle deployment under coexistence with Autoware.Universe, native Orion cannot run because the onboard GPU memory budget is insufficient, whereas the hybrid version runs successfully together with the full vehicle stack.

</details>


### [208] [Belayer: Efficient Fault Tolerance for LLM Agentic RL Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14635)
*Jiecheng Zhou,Qinghao Hu,Peng Sun,Xingcheng Zhang,Weiming Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了Belayer，一个针对LLM智能体强化学习训练的高效容错系统，通过GPU状态选择性复用和全状态检查点机制，显著降低了故障恢复时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体RL训练在沙盒环境中进行长时域交互，包含GPU密集型rollout引擎和有状态环境容器。单条轨迹可能跨越多轮交互，组件故障会丢弃已完成工作或导致环境状态与模型上下文不一致，而现有系统缺乏针对这种分布式执行模型的高效且正确的恢复机制。

Method: Belayer提出两类核心机制：(1)针对worker本地rollout故障，为预初始化的影子worker配备选择性GPU状态复用协议，通过健康检查后保留独立权重和KV-arena分配，重新初始化worker本地状态，并从日志token前缀重建请求特定的KV内容；(2)针对环境故障，引入全检查点和全恢复机制，联合捕获和恢复容器文件系统与运行时状态，并将恢复的环境与LLM上下文协调以保持前缀一致性。系统还采用自适应策略在LLM推理空闲期重叠全状态检查点。

Result: 实验表明：故障无关训练期间开销低；worker恢复时间相比全引擎冷启动加速最高达42倍；环境故障恢复速度提升1.5至3.5倍。

Conclusion: Belayer成功实现了LLM智能体RL训练中的高效容错，在保持低正常运行开销的同时，显著加速了两类关键故障场景的恢复过程，为长时域智能体训练提供了可靠的系统支持。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly trained with reinforcement learning in long-horizon, sandboxed environments. Unlike conventional RL, agentic RL couples GPU-intensive rollout engines with stateful environment containers whose actions may produce visible side effects, such as file edits, command execution, and dependency installation. A single trajectory can span many rounds of gen- eration and environment interaction, so a component failure can discard completed work or expose the model to an environment state that is inconsistent with its context. However, existing systems lack efficient and correct recovery mechanisms for this distributed execution model. This paper presents Belayer, an efficient fault-tolerant system for LLM agentic RL training. Belayer handles failures in both rollout engines and environment execution while targeting low failure-free overhead. For scoped worker-local rollout failures, Belayer equips each pre-initialized shadow worker with a selective GPU-state reuse protocol that retains independently owned weights and raw KV-arena allocations after owner and GPU health checks, reinitializes worker-local state, and rebuilds request-specific KV contents from logged token prefixes. For environment failures, Belayer introduces full checkpoint and full restore to jointly capture and restore container file-system and runtime state, and coordinates the recovered environment with the LLM context to preserve prefix consistency. An adaptive policy opportunistically overlaps full-state checkpointing with natural LLM inference bubbles when the predicted interval is long enough. Empirical results show low measured overhead during failure-free training, a worker-recovery-time reduction of up to 42 times faster compared with a full engine cold start, and 1.5 to 3.5 times faster recovery from environment failures.

</details>


### [209] [Porting and Benchmarking Chapel on Emerging RISC-V Hardware: an HPC Viability Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14799)
*Ian Henriksen,Chris Taylor,Patrick Diehl,Jade Abraham,Palmer Cox,Bradford L. Chamberlain,Stephen L. Olivier*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文讨论了Chapel编程语言移植到RISC-V架构的过程与经验，并通过基准测试评估了RISC-V硬件在HPC领域的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着RISC-V架构的兴起，探索其在高性能计算(HPC)领域的可行性成为重要研究方向。Chapel作为一种并行编程语言，需要评估其在新兴架构上的移植难度和性能表现，为未来RISC-V在HPC应用提供参考依据。

Method: 研究团队首先完成了Chapel编译器对RISC-V架构的移植工作，包括必要的代码修改和适配。随后利用Chapel广泛的基准测试套件，在SiFive P550、Unmatched开发板和Sophon SG2042等RISC-V硬件平台上进行性能测试，并与多种当代HPC CPU平台进行对比分析。同时记录了移植过程中遇到的可移植性问题和性能异常。

Result: 研究成功实现了Chapel对RISC-V架构的支持，发现了不同架构间的性能差异和移植挑战。尽管当前测试的RISC-V硬件尚属初步产品而非HPC级别设备，但基准测试结果显示出RISC-V在未来成为可行HPC平台的潜力，为后续硬件发展提供了积极预期。

Conclusion: RISC-V架构能够支持现代并行编程语言如Chapel的运行，虽然当前硬件性能尚不及成熟的HPC平台，但移植工作的成功和性能测试结果为RISC-V在未来HPC应用中展现了良好前景，有望在近期成为HPC领域的可行选择。

Abstract: The Chapel programming language recently added support for the RISC-V architecture. Here we discuss what changes were needed for Chapel to work on RISC-V as well as lessons learned from the porting process. We use some of Chapel's extensive benchmark suite to gain further insight into the suitability of the RISC-V architecture for future HPC use. We compare performance on SiFive P550 and Unmatched boards and a Sophon SG2042 with a variety of other recent HPC CPU platforms. Various portability and performance anomalies arose on different architectures and will be discussed. While the RISC-V machines represent smaller preliminary offerings and not HPC-class hardware, these results still provide hope that RISC-V hardware can become viable for HPC in the near future.

</details>


### [210] [When Does Distributed AI Inference Need More Wide-Area Bandwidth? A Co-Design Evaluation of Optical, Packet, and Software Levers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14967)
*Prasanna C*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文建立了模型预测跨站点传输推理状态与重计算的收益临界点（70B模型为74-111 Gbps/流），分析了五个敏感因素，评估经济性权衡（GPU稀缺性达5-20倍时传输更优），明确了光网络与包网络的角色定位，并提出了十指标测量计划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前立场论文认为AI推理需要弹性光广域网容量，但审稿人正确指出这些论证仅说明更多带宽有帮助，未证明其优于KV重计算、缓存压缩、路由优化或过度配置包网络等替代方案。本文旨在进行系统性比较分析。

Method: 推导工作负载模型预测传输与重计算的交叉点；量化五个敏感度轴（上下文长度、注意力架构、排队、智能体复合、带宽崩溃）；进行经济性分析；正确区分光网络与包网络的功能定位；设计十指标三站点生产光纤测试床测量方案。

Result: 70B多头注意力模型交叉点为74-111 Gbps/流，分组查询注意力降至9-14 Gbps；经济性分析显示GPU稀缺和KV复用使有效GPU成本提高5-20倍时传输获胜；现代注意力架构使平衡点向传输方向移动一个数量级；光网络弹性在经济层面替代过度配置而非功能层面。

Conclusion: 每个结论都有适用边界，部分发现削弱了原始论点的简单版本；明确指出了研究有效性的适用范围；提出了开放生态系统测量计划，强调单一公司无法独立完成证据收集。

Abstract: Wide-area bandwidth per unit of GPU compute falls every hardware generation: in compute-intensity-ratio terms (CIR, bytes per FLOP), the gap between on-package memory and the conventional WAN is four to five orders of magnitude, widening at roughly 12-19% per year. Position papers - including our own - argued this makes elastic optical wide-area capacity necessary for cross-site AI inference. Reviewers correctly objected that such arguments show more bandwidth helps, not that it beats the alternatives: KV recomputation, cache compression, locality-aware routing, scheduling, or an overprovisioned packet backbone. This paper does the comparison. We derive a workload model predicting when moving inference state across sites beats recomputing it - a context-independent crossover at 74-111 Gbps per stream for a 70B multi-head-attention model, falling to 9-14 Gbps under grouped-query attention at 1/8 KV heads - and quantify five sensitivity axes: context length, attention architecture, queueing, agentic compounding, and loss/jitter-induced bandwidth collapse. On economics: at list GPU prices recomputation is cheaper; transfer wins when GPU scarcity and KV reuse multiply effective GPU cost by roughly 5-20x, and modern attention moves the breakeven an order of magnitude in transfer's favour. We position the network levers correctly rather than adversarially: packet networks allocate lit capacity at millisecond timescales; optical fungibility changes how much capacity is lit, at minute timescales, substituting for overprovisioning economically rather than functionally. Finally we specify a ten-metric measurement plan on a three-site production-fibre testbed, framed as an open ecosystem exercise: no single company can - or should - assemble this evidence alone. Every claim is bounded by the regime in which it holds; several findings weaken the naive version of our own thesis, and we state them.

</details>


### [211] [MELD: A Protocol for Merging Knowledge Across Distributed Agentic Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16357)
*Lauri Lovén,Jaakko Sauvola,Jukka Riekki,Sasu Tarkoma*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了MELD，一种面向多智能体记忆联盟的自管理一致性机制，通过五结果程序和CRDT实现分布式知识图谱的冲突检测与一致性维护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自主智能体虽能共享传输和调用工具，但无法有效共享知识——缺乏能让两个智能体记忆协调不同表述的同一事实、链接相关事实或处理矛盾知识的协议，现有方案通常会静默丢弃其中一方。

Method: MELD采用五结果程序（插入、合并、关联、冲突、拒绝）处理每个输入声明，基于三个信号（作用域声明键身份、嵌入相似度、自然语言推理判断）并在上下文和新鲜度门控下决策。通过单一可审计、可认证的Patch对象进行状态变更，结合标准发布/订阅传输和每声明状态CRDT实现无协调器的分布式一致性，支持分区自愈和防止静默重写。

Result: 在HotpotQA干扰任务上，分布式合并的召回率不劣于集中式存储，比简单并集召回率更高且节省约11%存储；合并分类器AUC达0.968，假合并率仅0.013；状态CRDT在30/30次真实分区恢复试验中成功重聚，而最后写入者胜出策略仅11/30；语义路由在相同召回率下消息量减少约3倍。

Conclusion: MELD成功实现了多智能体记忆的分布式一致性管理，在保证冲突可追溯性（不静默解决矛盾）的同时，在多个维度上优于现有方法，为计算连续体（5G边缘、国家HPC、本地层级）上的智能体协作提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Autonomous agents share a transport and can call each other's tools, but they cannot share what they know: no protocol lets two agents' memories reconcile a fact phrased two ways, link related facts held apart, or reconcile contradictory knowledge without silently discarding either claim. We present MELD, a self-managing coherence mechanism for a federation of agent memories whose run-time model is the knowledge graph itself. Each brain admits every incoming claim through a five-outcome procedure (insert, merge, relate, conflict, or reject), decided from three signals (scoped claim-key identity, embedding similarity, and a natural-language-inference verdict) under context and freshness gates, and acting through exactly one auditable, authenticated Patch, the only object that mutates state. A binding onto standard publish/subscribe transport with a per-claim status CRDT keeps sovereign brains coherent in claim status without a coordinator: self-healing after partitions and under lossy routing, and self-protecting against silent rewrite by a peer, under a benign-fault model. MELD does not adjudicate truth; a detected contradiction is preserved for later adjudication, never silently resolved. On HotpotQA distractor, distributed merge is recall-non-inferior to a centralized store under a pre-specified equivalence test and recall-superior to naive union at about 11% less live storage; the merge classifier separates at AUC 0.968 with a 0.013 false-merge rate on adjudicated candidate pairs; the status CRDT reconverges in 30/30 real partition-heal trials where last-writer-wins manages 11/30; and semantic routing delivers about 3x fewer messages at matched recall. We evaluate on a real computing continuum spanning an operator-grade 5G edge, national HPC, and a local tier, with empirically calibrated thresholds.

</details>


### [212] [Collective Communication for Distributed LLM Systems: Planning, Runtime Adaptation, and Computation Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15118)
*Xuebin Song,Menghao Zhang,Yuezheng Liu,Jinyi Xia,Shucan Yang,Xiaohe Hu,Chunming Hu,Mingwei Xu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对分布式大语言模型系统中的集合通信原语（如AllReduce、ReduceScatter、AllGather和AlltoAll），提出了一个三层分类法：通信规划层生成拓扑感知的调度；通信执行与适配层将调度映射到GPU运行时；计算-通信协调层实现端到端优化，并探讨了未来开放性挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代大语言模型训练和服务集群呈现异构GPU互连、多网卡网络、混合并行策略、低延迟推理请求和高吞吐量训练管道等复杂特征，这些因素催生了对集合通信的规划、执行和重叠方式的多样化需求，亟需一个系统性的分类框架来组织和理解相关技术进展。

Method: 采用教程式的、以集合通信为中心的分类法，将近期研究进展组织为三个层次：(1)通信规划层——生成拓扑感知的集合通信调度；(2)通信执行与适配层——将调度实时映射到真实集群中的GPU运行时和硬件；(3)计算-通信协调层——将集合通信优化转化为端到端的训练和推理收益。

Result: 建立了一个系统性的三层分类框架，成功整合了分布式大语言模型系统中集合通信的规划、执行和协调等关键技术，为理解和组织该领域的研究进展提供了清晰的结构化视角。

Conclusion: 该分类法为分布式大语言模型系统中的集合通信研究提供了统一的组织框架，并指出了该领域存在的开放性挑战和未来机遇，为后续研究提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Distributed large language model (LLM) systems increasingly rely on collective communication primitives such as AllReduce (AR), ReduceScatter (RS), AllGather (AG), and AlltoAll (A2A). In modern LLM training and serving clusters, heterogeneous GPU interconnects, multi-NIC networking, mixed parallelism strategies, low-latency inference requests, and high-throughput training pipelines have motivated increasingly diverse ways to plan, execute, and overlap collective communication. This paper presents a tutorial-style, collective-centric taxonomy for collective communication. We organize recent advances into three layers: communication planning, which generates topology-aware collective schedules; communication execution and adaptation, which maps these schedules onto GPU runtimes and hardware in real clusters; and computation-communication coordination, which turns collective optimization into end-to-end training and inference benefits. We further discuss open challenges and future opportunities for collective communication in distributed LLM systems.

</details>


### [213] [P-PAS: Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15171)
*Timo Sämann*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文LLM服务中静态token调度预算的局限性，提出了Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling (P-PAS)方法，通过动态适应调度压力实现跨负载的低延迟服务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM应用（如RAG和智能体系统）通常需要处理数万输入token以产生短输出，端到端请求延迟成为关键服务目标。研究发现vLLM中的最大批量token数（MBT）对延迟的影响取决于调度压力：大token预算在低调度压力下能降低延迟，但在高压力下小预算更优，因此静态MBT无法在所有负载情况下表现最佳。

Method: 提出Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling (P-PAS)，一种轻量级策略，基于并发的prefill和decode状态动态调整调度预算。P-PAS在低调度压力下保留大token预算，随着压力增加约束prefill工作。通过内核级profiling分析，发现大prefill chunk在低调度压力下能提高执行效率，但随着调度压力增加，较小chunk能减少与活跃解码的干扰。

Result: P-PAS在不同模型、工作负载和GPU上均能在变化的负载情况下保持较低的端到端延迟，避免了固定MBT的限制。内核级分析显示，大prefill chunk在低调度压力下的执行效率优势因模型-硬件配置而异，调度压力增加时较小chunk能减少对活跃解码的干扰，解释了观察到的负载依赖性MBT敏感性。

Conclusion: P-PAS通过动态适应调度压力有效解决了静态MBT策略的局限性，为长上下文LLM服务提供了一种高效的延迟优化方案。代码和复现结果已开源。

Abstract: Long-context LLM applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic systems often process tens of thousands of input tokens to produce short outputs, making end-to-end request latency an important serving objective. We show that the maximum number of batched tokens (MBT), which controls the token scheduling budget in vLLM, has a scheduling-pressure-dependent effect on latency. Larger token budgets can reduce latency under low scheduling pressure, while smaller budgets become preferable under higher pressure. Consequently, no single static MBT performs best across load regimes.
  We introduce Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling (P-PAS), a lightweight policy that dynamically adapts the scheduling budget based on concurrent prefill and decode state. P-PAS retains a large token budget under low pressure and constrains prefill work as pressure increases. Across models, workloads, and GPUs, P-PAS maintains low end-to-end latency across changing load regimes, avoiding the limitations of a fixed MBT.
  Kernel-level profiling shows that large prefill chunks can improve execution efficiency under low scheduling pressure, but that this advantage varies across model--hardware configurations. As scheduling pressure increases, smaller chunks can instead reduce interference with active decoding, explaining the observed load-dependent MBT sensitivity. Code and artifacts for reproducing our results are available at https://github.com/TimoSaemann/ppas-vllm .

</details>


### [214] [LOCAL: Enabling Learning On-device Contiguously for Agent LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15241)
*Xinxin Liu,Jiaxin Li,Zibo Wang,Yun Ji,Zhangqi Zhu,Qing Hu,Zhibin Wang,Rong Gu,Sheng Zhong,Chen Tian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了LOCAL，首个支持LLM智能体在单GPU上进行连续在线学习的运行时系统，通过协同调度器、版本感知KV缓存管理器和多智能体运行时的协作，解决了适配器更新与缓存一致性、内存分配等关键挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM推理运行时假设权重稳定，强化学习系统假设资源分离，无法支持智能体在与用户持续交互的同时进行本地连续学习（适应），且需要保护隐私数据不上传云端。

Method: 核心洞察是GPU调度、适配器版本管理和KV缓存有效性不能由独立子系统处理。LOCAL通过三个协作组件（协作调度器、版本感知KV缓存管理器、多智能体模型运行时）共享适配器版本、任务优先级和缓存状态，保持调度、执行和缓存维护的一致性。

Result: 在单张24GB GPU上运行7B级模型时，LOCAL将前台队列等待p95降低3.1倍，p95 TTFT降低1.55倍，发布后首次命中预填充p99降低25.6%，跨智能体TTFT p99降低21.9%，同时在紧张KV预算下保持后台学习进程。

Conclusion: LOCAL成功实现了LLM智能体的连续在设备学习，在不中断用户交互的前提下提升了系统响应速度和学习效率，证明了统一管理调度、缓存和版本状态的必要性。

Abstract: On-device LLM agents interact repeatedly with users on local hardware, producing private traces that are valuable for adaptation but should not be sent to a remote trainer. Ideally, such agents would learn contiguously---adapting from every interaction without pausing or suspending user-facing inference---yet existing inference runtimes assume stable weights and existing RL systems assume separated resources, so neither can support this continuity. We present LOCAL, the first single-GPU runtime that enables contiguous on-device learning for LLM agents. The key insight is that GPU scheduling, adapter version management, and KV-cache validity cannot be handled by independent subsystems: adapter updates invalidate cached KV tensors from older versions, and cache retention affects the memory available for training. LOCAL makes adapter version, task priority, and cache state visible to three cooperating components---a cooperative scheduler, a version-aware KV-cache manager, and a multi-agent model runtime---that share this state to keep scheduling, execution, and cache maintenance mutually consistent. On a single 24 GB GPU with 7B-class models, LOCAL lowers foreground queue-wait p95 by 3.1x over FIFO, lowers p95 time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 1.55x versus non-preemptible training, cuts post-publish first-hit prefill p99 by 25.6% and cross-agent TTFT p99 by 21.9%, and keeps background learning progressing under tight KV budgets.

</details>


### [215] [FloodReasonBench: Benchmarking VLM Reasoning Segmentation for Embodied Flood Response at the Edge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15410)
*Rajat Bhattacharjya,Yoomee Jung,Minwoo Kim,Sing-Yao Wu,Eli Bozorgzadeh,Nalini Venkatasubramanian,Nikil Dutt*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了FloodReasonBench基准，用于评估边缘设备上洪水响应场景的视觉-语言模型推理分割性能，在NVIDIA Jetson平台上揭示了准确率、延迟、能耗和通信开销之间的权衡关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理分割基准主要关注通用视觉场景，忽视了洪水响应平台面临的领域特异性和资源约束问题，缺乏针对边缘端具身智能体的专门评估。

Method: 构建FloodResponseSeg洪水专用推理分割数据集，在轻量级视觉编码、分层分割推理和压缩中间表示条件下评估推理分割流程，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier上进行系统级测量。

Result: 通用预适应设置下分区准确率变化显著，而洪水适应的目标-工作负载设计空间在跨分区时展现更紧凑的准确率范围；边缘端存在推理分割准确率、延迟、能耗和通信开销之间的明确权衡。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了面向资源受限边缘端具身洪水响应的推理分割任务级和系统级特性刻画，支持质量约束下的边缘操作点选择。

Abstract: Reasoning segmentation enables vision-language models (VLMs) to translate mission-relevant language requests into pixel-level visual grounding, offering a natural perception interface for embodied agents. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on generic visual scenes and overlook the domain and resource constraints encountered in flood-response platforms. We present FloodReasonBench, a benchmark for VLM reasoning segmentation for embodied flood response at the edge. At its core, FloodReasonBench introduces FloodResponseSeg, a flood-specific reasoning-segmentation dataset constructed from real-world scenes and response-relevant targets. Beyond task accuracy, the benchmark characterizes reasoning-segmentation pipelines under lightweight visual encoding, hierarchical split inference, and compressed intermediate representations. We observe strong partition-dependent accuracy variation in the generic pre-adaptation setting, while the flood-adapted target-workload design space exhibits a substantially more compact accuracy range across partitions. Evaluation on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier further exposes the tradeoffs among reasoning-segmentation accuracy, edge-side latency, energy, and communication footprint, enabling quality-constrained selection of edge operating points. Together, these results provide a task- and system-level characterization of reasoning segmentation for resource-constrained embodied flood response at the edge.

</details>


### [216] [eAVID: Asynchronous Verifiable Information Dispersal with Post-Dissemination Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15469)
*Rithwik Kerur,Dahlia Malkhi,Michael K. Reiter*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出eAVID协议，在异步可验证信息分散中实现动态存储优化：健康网络下节点存储减半，故障网络下优雅降级至基线水平，无需协调或重编码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准AVID协议使用(F+1, N)纠删码导致3倍存储开销，且节点存储在分散时固定，无法适应网络健康状况。同步系统可达最优3/2倍开销，而异步系统存在永久性存储代价。

Method: eAVID采用单个(2F+1, 2N) Reed-Solomon码编码消息，所有2N个片段在单个Merkle根下提交。每个节点接收两个不同片段，分散带宽与标准方案相同。节点在收到所有N个节点的Done消息后，可单方面丢弃其中一个片段，无需证书、协调或重编码。

Result: 在健康网络中，eAVID将稳态节点存储减少至基线的一半，达到同步系统的最优3/2倍存储开销。任何2F+1个已验证片段均可解码，无论片段分布如何。在故障网络中优雅降级至基线存储。

Conclusion: eAVID通过解耦节点存储与接收片段，实现了自适应存储管理，在保持异步安全性和标准分散带宽的同时，首次在异步环境中达到了与同步系统相当的最优存储效率。

Abstract: Asynchronous verifiable information dispersal (AVID) lets a sender spread a message across $N=3F+1$ nodes such that it remains recoverable despite up to $F$ Byzantine failures. Because dispersal must complete on $N-F$ responses, standard AVID protocols fix a $(F{+}1,\, N)$ erasure code and pay a $3\times$ storage blowup, whereas a synchronous system achieves the optimal $3/2\times$. This cost is paid permanently: the per-node footprint is fixed at dispersal time and does not adapt when the network turns out to be healthy and all $N$ nodes respond.
  We present eAVID, an AVID protocol that decouples the storage a node retains from the fragments it was sent. eAVID encodes the message with a single $(2F{+}1,\, 2N)$ Reed-Solomon code, commits to all $2N$ fragments under one Merkle root, and sends each node two distinct fragments. This approach uses the same dispersal bandwidth as the standard scheme. Dispersal completes on $N-F$ responses, as in the original AVID. Our divergence comes post-commit: nodes continue to collect responses asynchronously, and once a node has heard a Done over its adopted root from all $N$ nodes, it can safely discard one of its two fragments unilaterally. Because fragments are disjoint across nodes, at least $2F{+}1$ verified fragments survive.
  Pruning requires no certificate, no coordination among storage nodes, and no re-encoding. Reconstruction is unchanged as any $2F{+}1$ verified fragments decode the message regardless of how fragments are distributed. eAVID halves steady-state per-node storage relative to the $(F{+}1,\, N)$ baseline when the network is healthy, and degrades gracefully to the baseline footprint when it is not.

</details>


### [217] [Q-First: Attention and Feed-Forward Concurrency at the Smallest Change to the Block](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15473)
*WenJie Fan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种协议，通过交换注意力层和前馈层（FFN）的执行顺序，并让查询（Q）提前读取，消除了分离式LLM服务中的设备空闲依赖，在不改变算子、形状或硬件的情况下实现了端到端验证，且对模型训练的干扰极小（0.0026 bits/byte），证明查询可以提前一层读取但不能更早。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分离式LLM服务架构中，KV缓存处理与计算（投影和前馈层）被分配到不同的硬件上。然而，解码器块内部存在依赖关系：注意力层先运行，前馈层消费其输出。这导致在一个序列内，当一侧工作时另一侧空闲，降低了硬件利用率。传统的解决方案需要为每个额外的序列保留一个KV缓存，但这违背了分离设备的初衷。

Method: 本文提出了一种新的协议：交换注意力层和前馈层的顺序。观察到注意力计算中的扫描（sweep）只需要查询（query），通过交换两个子层，可以在计算端仍有工作时就让查询可用。当前的键（K）和值（V）作为缓存写入，无需等待。该方法在Stock内核上运行，无需新的算子、改变张量形状或新的硬件。研究还通过8种方式训练模块，保持其他条件不变，仅改变注意力读取的位置，并在计算最优解的3%处测量bits per byte来量化对训练的干扰。

Result: 实验验证了该协议在训练好的检查点上端到端运行的相对误差为3.2×10^-3。在测量对训练干扰的实验中，5个前馈层不消费自身注意力的模块中，任何读取点与基准（不移动）的差异不超过0.0026 bits/byte，这比同一模块在不同随机种子下的差异（0.0066）还要小。而子层交换的干扰是其25倍。这说明提前移动查询的变化对模型训练的影响极小，以至于测量无法检测到。但该方法有界限：从网络输入投影每层的查询会带来+0.0974的损失，证实了查询只能提前一个前馈层读取。

Conclusion: 本文成功消除了分离式LLM服务中的设备空闲依赖，提出的协议使查询可以提前一个前馈层读取，且对模型训练的干扰微乎其微（测量无法检测到），同时不需要修改硬件或算子。研究还确立了该方法的适用界限：查询不能从更早的层（如网络输入）读取，否则会造成显著的性能下降。

Abstract: Disaggregated LLM serving puts the KV-cache sweep on memory-optimised hardware and the projections and feed-forward on compute-optimised hardware, then inherits from the decoder block a dependency neither device wants: attention runs first and the feed-forward consumes its output, so within one sequence each side idles while the other works. The usual repair costs one resident KV cache per extra sequence in flight, which is what motivated separating the devices at all. We remove the dependency instead. The sweep needs only the query, and exchanging the two sub-layers makes that query available while the compute side still has work to do; the current key and value follow as a cache write nothing waits on. We state the resulting decode as a protocol, show that it runs on stock kernels, and verify it end to end on a trained checkpoint to a relative error of 3.2x10^-3 -- with no new operator, no changed shape and no new hardware. We then train the block 8 ways at two seeds each, varying only where the attention reads and holding everything else fixed. At three per cent of compute-optimal a lead in bits per byte measures how much a change disturbed training rather than what it reaches, so we read magnitudes and not rankings. Among the 5 blocks whose feed-forward does not consume their own attention, no read point differs from the one that moves nothing by more than 0.0026 bits per byte -- smaller than the gap between an arm and itself at a second seed, 0.0066 -- while the same runs resolve a sub-layer exchange 25 times as large. Moving the query early is a change the measurement cannot find, which is what the protocol needs. The reach is bounded: projecting every layer's query from the network's input costs +0.0974, refuting a pre-registered threshold at both seeds, so a query may be read one feed-forward early and no further back.

</details>


### [218] [FlashQuant: Sparse-Dense Fusion for Memory-Efficient Outlier-Aware LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15531)
*Junqing Lin,Jingwei Sun,Zhengding Hu,Guangzhong Sun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出FlashQuant框架，通过内核融合与硬件优化加速大语言模型低比特量化推理，显著降低异常值处理开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异常值感知量化方法将密集GEMM和稀疏SpMM路径分离在不同GPU内核中执行，尽管它们共享激活和输出，但错失了算子内数据复用机会，导致冗余的全局内存访问。这种低效性在内存受限的解码工作负载中尤为突出。

Method: FlashQuant将密集GEMM和稀疏异常值SpMM路径融合为单个GPU内核，实现异构计算间片上激活和输出块复用。引入三项关键技术：1) 稀疏-密集分块，使异常值处理与密集GEMM块对齐；2) Tile-COO异常值编码，实现高效稀疏访问并减少共享内存bank冲突；3) 流水线调度，重叠计算与数据移动。

Result: FlashQuant有效降低异常值处理开销，相比cuBLAS BF16实现2.74×–4.18×加速，相比最强的非融合异常值感知基线实现最高1.53×加速。

Conclusion: FlashQuant通过内核融合与硬件友好的优化策略，显著提升了异常值感知量化在LLM解码工作负载中的效率，为低比特量化推理提供了高性能解决方案。

Abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and computational cost of large language model (LLM) inference. However, high-magnitude outlier weights can induce substantial quantization errors and degrade model accuracy. Outlier-aware quantization addresses this issue by retaining outliers in high precision while quantizing the remaining weights, resulting in a low-bit dense GEMM path and a high-precision sparse SpMM path. Existing implementations execute these paths in separate GPU kernels, despite their shared activations and outputs, thereby missing opportunities for intra-operator reuse and incurring redundant global-memory accesses. This inefficiency is particularly pronounced in memory-bound decoding workloads. We propose FlashQuant, a content-sharing execution framework for outlier-aware W4A16 decoding. FlashQuant fuses the dense GEMM and sparse outlier SpMM paths into a single GPU kernel, enabling on-chip reuse of activation and output tiles across heterogeneous computations. It introduces three key techniques: sparse-dense tiling, which aligns outlier processing with dense GEMM tiles; Tile-COO outlier encoding, which enables efficient sparse access and reduces shared-memory bank conflicts; and pipelined scheduling, which overlaps computation with data movement. Experiments show that FlashQuant reduces outlier-processing overhead, achieving $2.74\times - 4.18\times$ speedup over cuBLAS BF16 and up to $1.53\times$ speedup over the strongest unfused outlier-aware baseline.

</details>


### [219] [DeltaLog: Deferred Materialization of Recurrent States for Linear Attention Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15533)
*Junqing Lin,Jingwei Sun,Guangzhong Sun*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出DeltaLog，一种线性注意力模型的高效循环状态解码方案，通过将状态表示为“稠密基状态+有界更新日志”，用轻量的追加操作替代大部分全状态写回，在不改变模型语义的前提下，将状态更新内核加速至多1.86倍，状态写流量降低至多7.83倍，实现端到端服务加速1.05–1.20倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力模型通过循环状态更新替代softmax注意力的成对token交互，消除了二次方前缀计算和随上下文增长的KV缓存。然而，现有解码实现往往在每生成一个token后都将完整循环状态物化并写回，导致状态维护成为主要的内存流量开销，尤其是对于大状态、多头的模型。因此，需要在不改变模型语义的前提下降低循环状态维护的内存开销。

Method: 提出DeltaLog解码方案：将循环状态表示为一个稠密基状态加上一个有界的近期紧凑更新日志。大多数解码步骤只将紧凑的更新因子追加到该日志中，周期性地执行合并步骤，将累积的更新折叠回稠密基状态。这样模型观察到与急切解码相同的稠密状态，但大部分全状态写回被轻量的追加操作替代。针对GDN、KDA、RWKV6实现并集成到原型服务栈中。

Result: 在上述模型上，DeltaLog将循环状态更新内核加速至多1.86倍，将profiled的循环状态写流量降低至多7.83倍，并实现端到端服务加速1.05–1.20倍，超越稠密循环基线。

Conclusion: DeltaLog在不改变模型语义的前提下，有效降低了线性注意力模型解码时的循环状态维护开销，显著提升了推理效率，为大状态、多头的模型提供了实用的优化方案。

Abstract: Linear attention models eliminate the quadratic prefix computation and context-growing KV cache of softmax attention by replacing pairwise token interactions with recurrent state updates. However, existing decoding implementations often materialize and write back the full recurrent state after every generated token, making state maintenance a major source of memory traffic, especially for models with large states and many heads. This paper presents DeltaLog, a recurrent-state decoding scheme that reduces this overhead without changing the model semantics. Specifically, DeltaLog represents the recurrent state as a dense base state together with a bounded log of recent compact updates. Most decode steps append only compact update factors to this log, while periodic merge steps fold the accumulated updates back into the dense base state. Thus, the model observes the same dense state as in eager decoding, but most full-state write-backs are replaced by lightweight append operations. We implement DeltaLog for GDN, KDA, and RWKV6 and integrate it into a prototype serving stack. Across these models, DeltaLog accelerates the recurrent-state update kernel by up to $1.86\times$, reduces profiled recurrent-state write traffic by up to $7.83\times$, and achieves $1.05$--$1.20\times$ end-to-end serving speedups over dense recurrent baselines.

</details>


### [220] [When Is Shallow Enough? Adaptive Split Federated Learning with Client-Specific Sufficiency Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15639)
*Wenhao Yuan,Chenchen Lin,Wenhao Hu,Jian Chen,Jinfeng Xu,Shujie Li,Edith Cheuk Han Ngai*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出FedSGA框架，通过浅层充分性估计实现客户端自适应的分割联邦学习，有效解决客户端异构性问题并减少不必要的计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分割联邦学习采用静态分割策略，但在客户端异构场景下，由于客户端在数据分布、适应动态和表示学习进度上存在差异，单一分割点无法满足各客户端特定的训练状态需求，导致性能次优。

Method: 提出FedSGA框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)基于私有提示令牌的客户端特定适应通道，跟踪局部适应动态；(2)浅层充分性估计器，结合跨客户端语义对齐、时间接口稳定性和提示状态变化来判断最浅分割是否已充分；(3)分割兼容接口协调模块，将不同分割深度的激活投影到共享语义空间。

Result: 在多个异构基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，FedSGA相比最先进方法有效提升了模型性能，同时减少了不必要的客户端计算开销。

Conclusion: FedSGA通过充分性引导的自适应分割策略成功解决了客户端异构性问题，在提升性能的同时降低了客户端计算负担，为分割联邦学习提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: \textit{Split Federated Learning} (SFL) enables distributed model training by splitting networks between the server and clients. However, under client heterogeneity, the conventional static split strategy may be suboptimal because clients can differ in data distributions, adaptation dynamics, and representation learning progress, making a single split point insufficient to accommodate client-specific training states. In this paper, we propose \textsc{FedSGA}, a \textbf{S}ufficiency-\textbf{G}uided \textbf{A}daptive split \textbf{Fed}erated learning framework that addresses this question through client-specific shallow sufficiency estimation. First, we introduce a client-specific adaptation channel based on private prompt tokens, which tracks local adaptation dynamics separately from the shared backbone and provides a lightweight signal for detecting whether client adaptation remains active. To further avoid repeated online probing over multiple candidate depths, we design a shallow sufficiency estimator that combines cross-client semantic alignment, temporal interface stability, and prompt-state variation to estimate whether the shallowest split is already sufficient. Finally, we introduce a split-compatible interface harmonization module that projects activations from different split depths into a shared semantic space, improving the comparability of heterogeneous client interfaces before server-side prediction. Extensive experiments on multiple heterogeneous benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of \textsc{FedSGA} in improving model performance compared with state-of-the-art methods while reducing unnecessary client-side computation.

</details>


### [221] [Adaptive Heterogeneous Compression for Resource-Efficient Federated Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15660)
*Chenwang Liu,Yijun Liu,Chang Liu,Xu Zhang,Pengchao Han*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了ASCEND，一种面向联邦知识蒸馏的自适应异构压缩框架，通过将压缩策略选择建模为非平稳随机多臂老虎机问题，在保持模型精度的同时显著降低通信开销和训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习面临模型架构异构性和边缘网络通信资源受限的挑战。现有联邦知识蒸馏方法仍存在传输梯度带来的大量通信开销问题，而现有压缩方法通常对所有客户端采用统一策略，忽略了客户端模型特性和资源能力的多样性。

Method: 提出一种面向FedKD的异构压缩框架，允许每个客户端从候选策略集中选择压缩策略。将压缩策略选择问题建模为非平稳随机多臂老虎机（MAB）问题，每个臂对应一种压缩策略。设计了效率感知奖励函数，联合考虑局部优化改进、全局知识对齐和执行时间。开发了ASCEND算法，采用EMA增强的ε-贪婪策略来平衡探索与利用。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验结果表明，ASCEND能够有效适应异构模型和资源设置，在保持竞争性模型精度的同时，显著降低了通信开销和训练时间。

Conclusion: ASCEND成功解决了联邦知识蒸馏中压缩策略选择的问题，通过自适应机制实现了通信效率与模型性能的有效平衡，为异构联邦学习场景提供了实用的解决方案。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving distributed model training but faces challenges from heterogeneous model architectures and limited communication resources at the network edge. Federated knowledge distillation (FedKD) alleviates model heterogeneity by combining prototype-wise parameter aggregation and knowledge transfer across heterogeneous models. However, transmitting gradients still introduces considerable communication overhead, while existing compression approaches typically apply a uniform strategy across clients and ignore their diverse model characteristics and resource capacities. To address this issue, we propose a heterogeneous compression framework for FedKD that enables each client to select a compression strategy from a candidate strategy set. We formulate the compression strategy selection problem as a non-stationary stochastic multi-armed bandit (MAB), where each arm corresponds to a compression strategy. An efficiency-aware reward is designed by jointly considering local optimization improvement, global knowledge alignment, and execution time. Based on this formulation, we develop an Adaptive heterogeneouS Compression algorithm for fEderated kNowledge Distillation (ASCEND), which employs an exponential moving average (EMA)-enhanced $ε$-greedy policy to balance exploration and exploitation. Experimental results on multiple datasets demonstrate that ASCEND effectively adapts to heterogeneous model and resource settings, reducing communication overhead and training time while maintaining competitive model accuracy.

</details>


### [222] [KV-Pipe: On the Relation Between KV Sharing and Pipeline Parallel Efficiency in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15943)
*Maryam Dialameh,Hossein Rajabzadeh,Harish Krishnamoorthy Murali,Walid Ahmed,Weiwei Zhang,Hyock Ju Kwon*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: KV-Pipe通过跨层KV共享机制平衡流水线并行训练，最高提升9.2%的MFU并减少9.8%迭代时间，同时降低推理KV缓存开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流水线并行(PP)在大语言模型训练中广泛使用，但受限于阶段不平衡和流水线气泡导致效率低下。跨层KV共享主要被研究用于减少推理时的KV缓存成本，而未探索KV重用如何重塑流水线工作负载。

Method: 提出KV-Pipe机制：从尾部阶段开始，以尾优先顺序将选定的注意力层转换为跨层KV共享，迭代地重新定位当前瓶颈，将FLOPs不平衡比率(FIR)趋近于1。该方法离线执行，仅需要流水线分区和每层FLOPs估计，运行时开销可忽略。

Result: 在多种流水线并行配置下，KV-Pipe持续改善利用率和吞吐量，训练MFU最高提升9.2%，迭代时间减少9.8%，在更高流水线并行度下增益更大。同时，KV共享机制通过减少KV缓存增长和冗余KV投影工作，提高了长上下文工作负载的解码吞吐量。

Conclusion: KV布局被识别为系统-架构的自由度，可联合改善流水线并行训练效率和长上下文推理性能，为跨层KV共享提供了新的应用视角。

Abstract: Pipeline parallelism (PP) is widely used to scale large language model (LLM) training, but its efficiency is often limited by stage imbalance and pipeline bubbles. Meanwhile, cross-layer KV sharing has primarily been studied as a mechanism for reducing KV-cache costs during inference, without examining how KV reuse reshapes pipeline workloads. We present \textbf{KV-Pipe}, a stage-aware KV-sharing mechanism that turns KV reuse into a pipeline-balancing control knob.
