KV-Pipe starts from the tail stage, converts selected attention layers to cross-layer KV sharing in a tail-first order, and iteratively retargets the current bottleneck to drive the FLOPs Imbalance Ratio (FIR) toward $1$. The procedure is performed offline and requires only a pipeline partition and per-layer FLOPs estimates, introducing negligible runtime overhead and requiring no online tuning. Across multiple pipeline-parallel configurations, KV-Pipe consistently improves utilization and throughput, achieving up to \textbf{9.2\%} higher training MFU and up to a \textbf{9.8\%} reduction in iteration time, with larger gains at higher pipeline-parallel degrees where stage imbalance is amplified. Furthermore, the same KV-sharing mechanism provides an inference-side benefit by reducing KV-cache growth and redundant KV projection work, resulting in higher decoding throughput for long-context workloads. These results identify KV layout as a system--architecture degree of freedom for jointly improving pipeline-parallel training efficiency and long-context inference.

</details>


### [223] [A Scalable Pipeline for LLM-Teacher Distillation Labeling: Work-Stealing Job Scheduling and Memory-Aware GPU Concurrency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15975)
*Ravi Satya Durga Prasad Yenugula*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个简单、可复现的大规模LLM标注流水线，包含工作窃取环形线程池、内存感知并发规则和重标注基准方法，在偏斜负载下吞吐量提升3.4倍且容错性强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用LLM教师标注大规模文本语料库时，人工标注每批次数据不可行，面临两个核心问题：教师模型的标注质量与成本效益，以及如何在负载偏斜且易出错的GPU工作节点集群中保持高效运行。

Method: 提出三个核心组件：(1)工作窃取环形线程池，每个工作节点拥有队列并优先处理，随后从环后继节点窃取任务，通过原子条件写实现恰好一次任务声明，通过过期声明清理实现崩溃容错，仅需存储层的比较并设置原语，在SQLite文件上实现零依赖；(2)内存感知并发规则，根据GPU上可容纳的模型副本数调整每节点并行度；(3)重标注基准方法，教师模型重新标注已有金标签的公开数据集，将质量评估转化为一致性测量，成本通过测量吞吐量得出。

Result: 在偏斜负载下，线程池吞吐量达到静态分片的3.4倍，零偏斜时持平；当一半工作节点被杀死时，2000个任务零丢失（静态分片丢失953个）；在反讽和情感任务上获得了指令调优教师模型的质量和成本数据点。所有实验在公共数据和商用硬件上运行。

Conclusion: 该流水线成功解决了大规模LLM标注中的效率、容错和质量评估问题，实现简单、零依赖且完全可复现，为大规模文本标注提供了实用且可靠的技术方案。

Abstract: Labeling large text corpora with LLM teachers has become a practical route to training data at scale. At millions of items, hand-labeling every batch is not feasible, and two questions dominate: what label quality a teacher buys per dollar, and how to keep a fleet of GPU workers busy under skewed, failure-prone workloads. We present a simple, reproducible pipeline that addresses both. First, a work-stealing ring pool: each worker owns a queue, drains it first, and then steals from ring successors, with exactly-once task claims via atomic conditional writes and crash tolerance via stale-claim sweeping. The claim protocol requires only a compare-and-set primitive from its storage layer; we implement it on a single SQLite file, which makes the reference implementation dependency-free and the experiments reproducible on one machine. Second, a memory-aware concurrency rule that sizes per-node parallelism by how many model copies fit on the GPU, so the same code runs safely across device sizes. Third, a relabeling benchmark methodology in which the teacher relabels a public dataset that already has gold labels, so quality reduces to an agreement measurement and cost follows from measured throughput. Under skewed load the pool sustains up to 3.4 times the throughput of static sharding while matching it at zero skew, loses 0 of 2,000 tasks when half the workers are killed mid-run (static sharding loses 953), and yields measured quality and cost points for an instruction-tuned teacher on irony and sentiment tasks. All experiments run on public data and commodity hardware; code, tests, and run logs are released.

</details>


### [224] [FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16157)
*Shuo Yang,Xiaoze Fan,Melissa Pan,Haocheng Xi,Zhe Wang,Shanlin Sun,Kurt Keutzer,Song Han,Matei Zaharia,Chenfeng Xu,Ion Stoica*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: FreeToken是一个边缘原生MoE服务系统，通过动态资源映射和全栈协同设计，在消费级硬件上实现大规模模型服务（从笔记本电脑上的35B模型到工作站GPU上的753B模型）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开源大模型服务系统主要针对数据中心基础设施设计，而边缘设备具有异构资源和不平衡的硬件配置，且智能体工作负载的执行模式会持续变化，传统固定卸载策略难以适应这些特点。

Method: 提出边缘原生MoE服务系统FreeToken，采用全栈协同设计方法，包括：模型布局与加载、专家驻留管理、CPU-GPU协同执行、智能体状态复用以及运行时内存管理。系统不采用固定卸载策略，而是根据实际可用资源持续动态映射计算和模型状态。

Result: FreeToken支持超过20个MoE模型和真实的编程/工具使用智能体，硬件范围从8GB笔记本GPU到单工作站GPU。实现了在笔记本上服务35B模型、游戏桌面上服务284B模型、单工作站GPU上服务753B GLM-5.2模型的能力。

Conclusion: FreeToken将开源权重模型转化为可部署的本地软件，使用户现有设备成为部署前沿规模智能的实用平台，已在flashml.ai发布。

Abstract: Frontier open-weight models are increasingly available, but serving them still largely assumes datacenter infrastructure. We present FreeToken, an edge-native MoE serving system that treats a personal machine not as a small GPU, but as a unified, elastic inference platform. FreeToken co-designs the full serving stack, including model layout and loading, expert residency, CPU--GPU execution, agentic state reuse, and runtime memory management, around two realities of local AI: agent workloads continuously change their execution pattern, and edge hardware exposes heterogeneous resources whose balance differs from machine to machine. Rather than committing to a fixed offloading strategy, FreeToken continuously maps computation and model state onto the resources actually available. FreeToken supports more than 20 MoE models and real coding and tool-using agents across hardware ranging from an 8GB laptop GPU to a single workstation GPU. More importantly, it changes what these machines can practically serve, from a 35B model on a laptop to a 284B model on a gaming desktop and the 753B GLM-5.2 on a single workstation GPU. FreeToken turns open weights into deployable local software, making the machines users already own a practical platform for frontier-scale intelligence. We release the system at flashml.ai.

</details>


### [225] [Agent-Native Telemetry: Verifiable State-Delta Evidence for Autonomous Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16178)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出面向AI代理的运维遥测架构ATP，用可验证的状态变更记录替代传统人类可读日志，显著降低负载与LLM上下文开销，并提供加密完整性与对抗安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统运维遥测面向人类阅读，存在大量冗余与文本解析开销，难以满足AI代理对上下文效率与可验证来源的需求。

Method: 提出Agent Telemetry Protocol（ATP）与State-Delta Evidence Ledger，将运维事实结构化为四类证据原语，通过内容寻址Schema、签名与哈希链实现可验证性与完整性。

Result: 在分布式微服务基准测试中，ATP相对OpenTelemetry JSON，原始网络负载减少96.4%，LLM上下文Token减少88.8%，查询操作减少66.2%，检测出全部500次对抗性存储篡改，50次对抗试验中零次提示注入成功。

Conclusion: 面向AI代理的遥测架构ATP在效率与安全性上显著优于传统日志格式，为自主运维提供了可验证、高效且抗篡改的基础设施。

Abstract: Operational telemetry is predominantly engineered for human reading: systems repeatedly serialize verbose prose, static keys, and redundant context across billions of log lines. As autonomous AI agents become primary operational consumers, feeding them traditional logs wastes scarce context capacity parsing lexical syntax rather than reasoning over system state changes -- all while lacking cryptographic guarantees of provenance or collection completeness.
  This paper introduces agent-native telemetry, an operational evidence architecture for autonomous machine operators founded on verifiable state deltas rather than human prose. We present the Agent Telemetry Protocol (ATP) and the State-Delta Evidence Ledger, an implementation that structures operational facts into four core evidence primitives (Transitions, Observations, Relations, and State Checkpoints) governed by content-addressed schemas, while isolating uncurated text as digest-verified opaque references. Producers sign and hash-chain batches for atomic collector append. Verified records feed two parallel agent access paths: a stateless protocol decoder emitting compact positional rows, and a stateful semantic gateway serving bounded graph capsules. We prove an information-preservation lower bound and formalize a ledger-relative verified negative theorem for provable event non-occurrence. On distributed microservice benchmarks (AIOpsLab and OpenTelemetry Astronomy Shop), ATP reduces raw wire payload and modeled cloud query scan costs by 96.4% relative to OpenTelemetry JSON, reduces LLM context tokens by 88.8% and query operations by 66.2%, detects all 500 tested adversarial storage mutations, and yields zero successful prompt injections across 50 adversarial trials per ATP configuration.

</details>


### [226] [DepTGL: A Parallel Framework for Memory-based TGNN Training with Adaptive Temporal Data Dependency Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16305)
*Linfang Chen,Zhen Song,Lei Liu,Yu Gu,Yushuai Li,Yanfeng Zhang,Lizhen Cui,Ge Yu,Tianyi Li*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出了DepTGL，一个可扩展的分布式M-TGNN训练框架，通过混合时序依赖管理、梯度感知缓存同步和负载感知时序剪枝策略，解决了现有框架在时序数据依赖管理上的不足，实现了4.99倍的平均加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分布式框架缺乏有效管理M-TGNN中时序数据依赖的机制，导致必须强制执行严格的时间顺序更新、产生大量远程同步开销，并在时序事件流倾斜时出现严重的负载不平衡问题。

Method: 提出了三个核心技术：(1)混合时序依赖管理方案，通过时序事件缓存和选择性依赖驱动通信显式平衡通信与缓存开销；(2)梯度感知缓存同步策略，随模型优化稳定自适应抑制边界更新，减少冗余同步；(3)负载感知时序剪枝策略，在倾斜导致的负载峰值下消除辅助重放事件，减少冗余数据处理并缓解拖尾效应。

Result: 在六个真实世界时序图上的实验表明，DepTGL相比最先进的基线方法实现了4.99倍的平均加速，同时保持了相当的准确率。

Conclusion: DepTGL成功从以数据为中心的视角重构了M-TGNN的时序依赖管理，有效解决了分布式训练中的通信开销、同步冗余和负载不平衡等关键问题，为大规模时序图神经网络的训练提供了可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Memory-based Temporal Graph Neural Networks (M-TGNNs) maintain recursively updated node states to capture fine-grained temporal interactions. However, existing distributed frameworks lack effective mechanisms for managing the temporal data dependencies inherent in these models. As a result, they must enforce strict chronological updates, incur substantial remote synchronization overhead, and experience severe load imbalance when temporal event streams are skewed. We propose DepTGL, a scalable distributed training framework that restructures temporal-dependency management for M-TGNNs from a data-centric perspective. First, DepTGL introduces a hybrid temporal-dependency management scheme that explicitly balances communication and caching overhead via temporal-event caching, supplemented by selective dependency-driven communication. Next, DepTGL incorporates a gradient-aware cache-synchronization policy that adaptively suppresses boundary updates as model optimization stabilizes, thereby reducing redundant synchronization. Finally, DepTGL integrates a load-aware temporal-pruning strategy that eliminates auxiliary replay events under skew-induced load spikes, reducing redundant data processing and mitigating straggler effects. Experiments on six real-world temporal graphs show that DepTGL achieves an average speedup of 4.99x over state-of-the-art baselines, while maintaining comparable accuracy.

</details>


### [227] [DB-SpMSpV: Dual-View Blocked Sparse Matrix-Sparse Vector Multiplication for Dynamic GPU Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16308)
*Xing Cong,Chenhao Xie,Rui Wang,Zhongzhi Luan,Yi Liu,Depei Qian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出DB-SpMSpV双视图分块框架，通过统一存储布局支持动态稀疏场景下的push/pull自适应切换，在A100和RTX 4090上相比cuSPARSE和TileSpMSpV分别实现最高64.34×和14.01×加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GPU SpMSpV方法将存储布局、遍历方式（push/pull）与内核实现紧耦合，导致在输入向量动态稀疏变化时难以进行细粒度自适应切换，且切换开销大。由于最佳执行路径取决于全局稀疏度和局部向量块分布，亟需一种能根据运行时特征灵活调整的方案。

Method: 提出双视图分块框架DB-SpMSpV：将矩阵划分为固定2D块，高层维护块级CSR/CSC视图，底层复用单一payload同时支持行驱动pull和列驱动push；运行时根据输入块稀疏度选择全局遍历路径，根据局部矩阵/向量块结构选择微内核，并结合负载均衡、异步预取、层次化回写优化非规则访存、写回冲突与负载不均。

Result: 在NVIDIA A100和RTX 4090上使用SuiteSparse矩阵、对称图及三开源LLM评估：跨输入稀疏度，A100上相比cuSPARSE加速5.48×-64.34×，相比TileSpMSpV加速2.36×-14.01×，RTX 4090收益相近；DB-BFS端到端图遍历A100平均2.66×、RTX 4090平均3.60×提升；DB-Decoding单token线性层加速最高4.50×。

Conclusion: DB-SpMSpV通过存储布局与遍历方式解耦及细粒度运行时自适应，有效解决了动态稀疏场景的性能瓶颈，显著优于现有方法，并为图遍历与稀疏模型推理提供了高效的基础框架。

Abstract: Sparse Matrix-Sparse Vector Multiplication (SpMSpV) is a core primitive in graph traversal, sparse linear algebra, and sparse model inference. Its input vector is often dynamically sparse, so the best GPU execution path depends on both global sparsity and the local vector-block distribution. Existing GPU SpMSpV methods often bind storage layouts, push/pull traversal, and kernels together, making fine-grained adaptation difficult without extra storage or scheduling overhead.
  This paper presents DB-SpMSpV, a dual-view blocked SpMSpV framework for dynamic GPU workloads. DB-SpMSpV partitions the matrix into fixed-size 2D blocks, maintains block-level CSR/CSC views at the high level, and reuses a single low-level block payload to support both row-driven pull and column-driven push. At runtime, it selects the global traversal path based on input block sparsity, chooses block microkernels from the local matrix/vector block structure, and uses load balancing, asynchronous prefetching, and hierarchical writeback to reduce irregular memory accesses, writeback conflicts, and load imbalance. We further integrate the framework into DB-BFS and DB-Decoding.
  We evaluate DB-SpMSpV on NVIDIA A100 and RTX 4090 using SuiteSparse matrices, symmetric graphs, and three open-source LLMs. Across input sparsities, DB-SpMSpV achieves average speedups of 5.48$\times$--64.34$\times$ over cuSPARSE and 2.36$\times$--14.01$\times$ over TileSpMSpV on A100, with similar gains on RTX 4090. DB-BFS further improves end-to-end graph traversal by 2.66$\times$ over TileBFS on A100 and 3.60$\times$ on RTX 4090 on average, while DB-Decoding accelerates single-token linear layers by up to 4.50$\times$.

</details>


### [228] [GPU implementation of a resource-constrained virtual machine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16387)
*Simone Li,Vladislav Brusokas,Andrei Ghita,Shuxuan Li,Wim Vanderbauwhede*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在GPU上部署资源受限虚拟机Uxn的方法，通过OpenMP风格的并行API实现数据并行，使资源节俭型工作负载在GPU上高效执行，性能提升显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件膨胀导致计算硬件过时，资源受限虚拟机（如Uxn）通过硬性资源限制迫使程序员保持节俭。然而现有部署方式未充分利用现代设备普遍配备的GPU，无法有效执行这些节俭型工作负载。

Method: 在GPU上部署Uxn虚拟机，为Uxntal（Uxn平台的栈式汇编语言）设计了OpenMP风格的并行API，以充分利用GPU的数据并行能力。通过该API，开发者可以编写并行代码并在GPU上执行。

Result: 在集成GPU上的评估表明：(1) 计算密集型Stencil基准测试性能提升19倍；(2) 图形密集型Bunnymark基准测试帧率提升7倍。即使在集成GPU上，示例代码也能达到可比较的性能表现。

Conclusion: 所有笔记本电脑、台式机甚至移动设备都配备GPU，本研究证明这些GPU可以有效执行节俭型工作负载，为对抗软件膨胀导致的硬件过时问题提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: One of the main reasons compute hardware becomes obsolete is software bloat: resource requirements increase for every iteration of a software product. Resource constrained VMs are one way to combat software bloat as they post a hard limit on the resources and so force the programmer to be frugal. In this paper we explore the deployment of one such resource constrained VM, Uxn, on GPU.
  We show that for competitive performance it is essential to make use of the GPU data parallelism. We present an OpenMP-style parallelism API for Uxntal, the stack-based assembly-style language for the Uxn platform. We demonstrate that exemplar code using our API can run at comparable performance even on an integrated GPU. Specifically, our evaluation results show that using this approach improves performance on the compute-intensive Stencil benchmark with 19x and frame rate on the graphics-intensive Bunnymark benchmark with 7x.
  In practice, all laptops and desktops and even mobile devices have a GPU and our work shows that they can be used to execute frugal workloads effectively.

</details>


### [229] [Vantage: Availability-Graded Broadcast for Signature-Free BFT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16504)
*Nikita Polyanskii*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Vantage是一种在部分同步模型下的拜占庭容错协议，仅使用认证通道和抗碰撞哈希，无需数字签名即可实现高吞吐量和低延迟的共识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无签名高吞吐量协议由于认证通道无法提供可传递证据，需要在排序前为每个数据块完成可用性投票或广播实例，导致延迟增加。本文旨在消除对数字签名的依赖，同时保持低延迟和高吞吐量。

Method: Vantage引入了可用性分级广播(AGB)原语，采用哈希链接的作者通道发布区块。每个视图的提议者配对一个核心清单和一个乐观尖端清单。AGB使核心在仲裁数量的第一手响应上不可撤销，而对尖端进行分级而非阻塞。未解决的尖端通过无签名控制日志稍后封装。当所有节点正确且消息延迟为δ时，数据块可在发布后4δ内完成排序。

Result: 在模拟的十区域WAN环境中使用100个节点测试，Vantage在各种负载下具有最低的中位延迟，吞吐量达到239k TPS(512字节交易)，中位延迟低于500ms。协议在异步条件下保持安全性，在全局稳定时间后保证活性。

Conclusion: Vantage成功实现了无数字签名的高性能BFT共识，其性能指标与基于签名的乐观设计相匹配，为实际部署提供了一种无需签名的高效替代方案。

Abstract: Digital signatures make blocks and votes transferable evidence: one party can prove to another what a third party said. Authenticated channels convince only the direct receiver, so existing high-throughput signature-free protocols complete an availability vote or a broadcast instance for each data block before any proposer may order it. We present Vantage, a partially synchronous Byzantine fault-tolerant protocol for $n \ge 3f+1$ parties that uses only authenticated channels and collision-resistant hashing. Parties publish blocks on hash-linked author lanes; each view's proposer pairs a quorum-available core manifest of lane frontiers with an optimistic tip manifest of freshly received blocks. A new primitive, Availability-Graded Broadcast (AGB), makes the core irrevocable on a quorum of first-hand responses while grading, rather than blocking on, the tip. Unresolved tips are sealed later through a signature-free control log, by resolutions each correct party checks against its own recorded responses; a crash-only silent view is skipped by a quorum of skip votes without the log. AGB makes a published block proposal-eligible one message delay after publication, matching signed optimistic-tip designs. When all parties are correct and message delays are $δ$, a data-only proposal seals within $2δ$ of its send on all $n$ first-hand acknowledgments, so a block is sequenced within $4δ$ of publication, and within $3δ$ when publication aligns with the next proposal. We prove safety under asynchrony; liveness holds after the Global Stabilization Time. On an emulated ten-region WAN with 100 parties, Vantage has the lowest median latency among the nearest signature-based and signature-free protocols at every accepted load and sequences 239k 512-byte transactions per second with median latency below 500 ms.

</details>


### [230] [HAPS through the Lens of Satellites and UAVs: A Function-Level Perspective on the Emerging High Altitude Economy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16828)
*Mukhtiar Ahmad,Mohamed-Slim Alouini*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对高空平台站（HAPS）进行了严格的功能验证评估，发现仅有5项功能（光学地球观测、高光谱成像、甲烷成像、射频/信号情报和宽带中继）通过了飞行验证，且仅基于4个飞行项目。HAPS的核心优势在于近距离持久驻留而非高度，适合作为多层非地面网络中的持久区域层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HAPS作为介于卫星和无人机之间的第三层架构，长期以来存在架构案例超前于飞行验证证据的问题。随着2020-2026年平流层飞行浪潮的到来，现在可以进行直接比较评估，填补功能验证的空白。

Method: 定义严格的证据规则（仅在18公里以上操作相关的平流层数据返回才算飞行验证），对19项功能进行评估；采用卫星和无人机实现作为参考基准；通过四个工程域（尺寸重量功率、位置保持、孔径、观测几何）分析功能验证模式。

Result: 5项功能已通过验证：光学地球观测、高光谱成像、甲烷成像、射频/信号情报、宽带中继。但仅基于4个飞行项目，最多只有1项具有同行评审的飞行证据。1项功能地面演示，2项部分演示，3项概念性，8项仍未飞行。核心优势是近距离持久驻留，而非高度优势。

Conclusion: HAPS适合作为多层非地面网络中的持久区域层，成为新兴高空经济的基础。主要开放问题包括运营商级服务、位置保持精度和监管。研究提出了持久层假说作为可测试假设，并设定了2030年的时间标记。

Abstract: High-Altitude Platform Stations (HAPS) operate in the lower stratosphere at 17-27 km, between satellites and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). For this third tier the architectural case has long outpaced the flight evidence, but a wave of 2020-2026 stratospheric flights now permits a direct comparison. We evaluate HAPS function by function across sensing, navigation, and communication, taking operational satellite and UAV implementations as the reference. We define a strict evidence rule, counting a function as flight-validated only on operationally relevant stratospheric data return at or above 18 km, and apply it to nineteen functions. The resulting count is lower than the literature implies: five functions have credibly crossed over (optical Earth observation, hyperspectral imaging, methane imaging, RF/SIGINT, and broadband relay), yet these rest on only four flight programs, with at most one carrying peer-reviewed flight evidence. One function is ground-demonstrated, two are partially demonstrated, three are conceptual, and eight remain unflown. Four engineering domains (size, weight, and power; station-keeping; aperture; and viewing geometry), bounded by an operational envelope of platform stability and payload operability, explain the pattern. The governing advantage is persistence at close range, not altitude. Eight use cases, supported by same-sensor forward simulations, translate the pattern into missions, led by resilient public-safety mission-critical services (MCX). On this evidence, HAPS fits as a persistent regional tier in a multi-tier non-terrestrial network and as the seed of an emerging High Altitude Economy. Carrier-grade service, station-keeping precision, and regulation remain the principal open problems, and we pose the persistent-tier reading as a testable hypothesis with dated 2030 markers.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [231] [Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14556)
*Dongzhe Zheng,Christine Allen-Blanchette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP)方法，通过分离拓扑与几何，固定拓扑约束（由有向关联矩阵确定的胞上边缘算子）并从数据学习几何相关的对称正定上链度量，实现了物理场在网格上的精确建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理场在网格上建模需要区分拓扑和几何：守恒定律是拓扑性的且应当精确满足，而几何、材料响应和各向异性耦合需从数据学习。现有神经代理方法在无约束消息传递中混淆了这些角色。

Method: RHMP将有向关联矩阵确定的胞上边缘算子(d_k)固定，学习对称正定上链度量(H_k)表示几何相关传播；引入上链框架等变性保证物理传播对隐藏上链特征基的正交变换不变；使用度量加权的Hodge块(d_k^⊤ H_{k+1}d_k)实现架构。

Result: 在跨越流体、电磁学、规范场和变网格CFD的7个物理基准测试中，RHMP取得最佳整体性能，在拓扑、学习几何和场结构相互作用时提升最大。方法保证精确的上链复形恒等式(d_{k+1}d_k=0)、非负Hodge能量、正半定算子和精确阿贝尔曲率不变性。

Conclusion: 将拓扑与几何分离作为架构设计原则能有效提升物理场建模性能，RHMP成功实现了这一原则，在保持拓扑守恒定律精确性的同时灵活学习几何相关特征。

Abstract: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies, positive-semidefinite operators, and exact Abelian curvature invariance. Across seven physical benchmarks spanning fluids, electromagnetism, gauge fields, and variable-mesh CFD, RHMP achieves the best overall performance, with the largest gains when topology, learned geometry, and field structure interact.

</details>


### [232] [Forward Pass Domain Adaptation (Without Cross-Layer Backpropagation)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14563)
*Rivaan Patil,Simon Dennis,Hao Guo,Kevin Shabahang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FPO方法，仅通过前向传播训练MLP，无需反向传播，在保持模型泛化能力的同时，显著提升训练效率和降低内存占用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准微调方法需要完整的反向传播，计算成本高且内存占用大。作者观察到在Transformer的后期层中，输出层预测误差能够较好地近似真实梯度（余弦相似度0.47-0.59），这启发了仅在前向传播中进行训练的可能性。

Method: FPO首先引入一个两分钟的诊断工具，量化每层的梯度近似质量，确定哪些后期层适合适应。然后仅在输出层计算单一误差信号，并将其直接应用于每个目标层，无需层间信号传播或构建autograd图。整个过程仅涉及前向传播。

Result: 在OLMo-2-7B、Qwen3-8B、Falcon3-7B三个模型家族上的实验表明，FPO实现了2.7-3.2倍的训练吞吐量提升，峰值训练内存减少约40%，同时在领域内困惑度有所改善，且在MMLU、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag和Winogrande等离域基准测试中保持与基线相当的性能。

Conclusion: FPO提供了一种高效的大语言模型适应方法，通过利用后期层的梯度近似特性，避免了反向传播的开销，同时保持了模型的泛化能力。该方法为大规模模型的部署和应用提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Forward-Pass-Only MLP training (FPO) adapts large language models without a backward pass through the model body, achieving 2.7--3.2x the throughput of standard fine-tuning at ~40% less peak training memory, while leaving off-domain benchmarks within seed-noise of baseline, a property that full-network fine-tuning does not reliably reproduce. FPO rests on a single empirical observation: at late layers of a transformer, the output-layer prediction error approximates the true gradient with cosine similarity 0.47--0.59 across six public models we survey. We introduce a two-minute diagnostic that quantifies this approximation per layer for any model, identifying where late-layer adaptation is viable. Informed by the diagnostic, FPO computes a single error signal at the output and applies it to each target layer. No signal is propagated between layers, and no autograd graph is constructed at any point. We evaluate FPO on three model families (OLMo-2-7B, Qwen3-8B, Falcon3-7B). Across all three, FPO produces in-domain perplexity improvement and leaves MMLU, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, and Winogrande within seed-noise of baseline. Localizing SFT to FPO's target layers to enter this regime is also feasible, but at 2.2x the wall-clock cost of FPO.

</details>


### [233] [Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Resolution Diffusion Models for Trajectory Generation in Urban Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14570)
*Wen Ye,Muyan Weng,Chuizheng Meng,Hao Niu,Yizhou Zhang,Yan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MR-Traj，一种多分辨率扩散框架，用于生成大规模轨迹数据。该方法通过将轨迹建模为粗粒度里程碑和细粒度段的组合，在保持全局分布相似性的同时，更好地捕捉多分辨率的时空依赖性，并生成更具多样性的轨迹以降低隐私风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模公开轨迹数据的可用性因隐私担忧而受限，现有合成轨迹生成方法主要关注全局分布相似性，但往往忽视了不同时空分辨率下的移动模式，而这些模式对于实际应用至关重要。

Method: 提出MR-Traj多分辨率扩散框架，将轨迹显式建模为粗粒度里程碑和细粒度段的组合，通过多分辨率建模捕捉复杂的时空依赖性，并在多个分辨率级别引入随机性。

Result: MR-Traj在全局分布相似性方面达到与最先进方法相当的性能，在建模细分辨率移动模式和支持下游城市移动任务方面持续优于现有方法；同时生成的轨迹更具多样性，经验性地降低了种子引导数据发布设置下的轨迹链接风险。

Conclusion: MR-Traj通过多分辨率建模有效平衡了轨迹数据的实用性和隐私保护，为大规模轨迹数据生成提供了一个有前景的解决方案，能够更好地支持下游城市移动任务并降低隐私风险。

Abstract: Understanding human mobility is critical for a wide range of urban applications, including traffic management, epidemic control, and urban planning. However, due to privacy concerns, the availability of large-scale public trajectory data remains limited, posing challenges for downstream mobility analysis. Existing methods for synthetic trajectory generation primarily focus on matching global distribution similarity, while often overlooking mobility patterns across different spatial and temporal resolutions that are essential for practical utility.
  To address these challenges, we propose a novel multi-resolution diffusion framework, MR-Traj, for large-scale trajectory generation. MR-Traj explicitly models trajectories as compositions of coarse-grained milestones and fine-grained segments, enabling the capture of complex spatial-temporal dependencies at multiple resolutions. Experimental results demonstrate that MR-Traj achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods in terms of global distribution similarity, while consistently outperforming them in modeling fine-resolution mobility patterns and supporting downstream urban mobility tasks. In addition, by introducing stochasticity at multiple resolution levels, MR-Traj generates more diverse trajectories, which empirically reduces trajectory linkage risk under a seed-guided data release setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/Ray0202/MR-Traj.

</details>


### [234] [Geometry Is Not Robustness: A Trajectory-Level Study of PGD Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14594)
*Dhairysheel Durgule*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过分析PGD攻击的轨迹特征，发现损失演变和梯度对齐无法有效区分不同鲁棒性模型，而失败步数分布能更清晰反映模型的对抗鲁棒性。轨迹级诊断应作为补充工具而非替代标准鲁棒性测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性评估主要依赖PGD的最终对抗准确率，无法捕捉攻击过程中的模型行为。近期研究提出轨迹级诊断方法（损失演变、梯度对齐、失败步数），但这些指标是否能可靠指示鲁棒性强度尚不明确。

Method: 在Fashion-MNIST上训练卷积神经网络，比较干净训练和对抗训练模型。使用20步PGD（随机初始化+多次重启）测量鲁棒性，单初始化记录轨迹进行诊断。记录3000个样本的完整PGD轨迹，分析损失演变、梯度对齐和失败时序。

Result: 揭示了模型间的清晰鲁棒性层级，但轨迹指标贡献不均：平均损失轨迹和梯度对齐在鲁棒准确率差异显著的对抗训练模型间表现相似；而失败步数分布能更清晰地区分鲁棒性区域，直接反映对对抗扰动的功能抵抗能力。

Conclusion: 轨迹级诊断描述优化几何但不能独立测量对抗鲁棒性。其可解释性取决于鲁棒性区域、攻击强度和多指标评估。轨迹级分析应作为补充诊断工具，在上下文中解释，而非替代标准鲁棒性测量。

Abstract: Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) is widely used to evaluate adversarial robustness, typically via final adversarial accuracy, which does not capture model behaviour throughout the attack. Recent work proposes trajectory-level diagnostics, such as loss evolution, gradient alignment, and steps-to-failure, for deeper insight into adversarial optimisation dynamics. However, whether these diagnostics reliably indicate robustness strength remains unclear. We conduct a trajectory-level investigation of PGD attacks on convolutional neural networks trained on Fashion-MNIST. We compare clean-trained and adversarially-trained models across multiple robustness regimes, using rigorous 20-step PGD evaluations with random initialisation and multiple restarts for robustness measurement, and single-initialisation trajectory recording for diagnostics. We record full PGD trajectories across 3000 clean-correct samples per model and analyse loss evolution, gradient alignment, and failure timing across attack iterations. Our results reveal a clear robustness hierarchy across models; however, trajectory metrics do not contribute equally to its identification. Mean loss trajectories and gradient alignment patterns appear quantitatively similar across adversarially-trained models with substantially different robust accuracies. In contrast, steps-to-failure distributions provide a clearer separation of robustness regimes, directly reflecting functional resistance to adversarial perturbation. These findings indicate that trajectory-level diagnostics describe optimisation geometry but do not independently measure adversarial robustness. Their interpretability depends on robustness regime, attack strength, and multi-metric evaluation. Trajectory-level analysis should be a complementary diagnostic tool, interpreted in context, rather than a replacement for standard robustness measurements.

</details>


### [235] [DumpsterCluster: From Dumpster Diving to Serving LLaMA-70B on $60 GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14614)
*Zeyu Cao,Xuan Guo,Cheng Zhang,Cheuk Hang Lau,Ilia Shumailov,Yiren Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过构建128个二手GPU组成的DumpsterCluster，验证了退役GPU在现代大语言模型推理中的可行性。虽然初始成本极低（2.2万美元 vs 60万美元），但能效和碳排放问题严重，仅在清洁能源充足且电价低廉的地区才具有经济和环境可持续性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI数据中心淘汰功能正常的GPU，大量仍具计算能力的加速器进入二级市场。本研究旨在探索这些退役GPU是否能够重新利用来构建服务于现代大语言模型推理的集群，以及在何种条件下这种再利用在经济上可行且环境可持续。

Method: 研究团队从零开始构建了一个由128个二手GPU组成的DumpsterCluster，使用纯二手组件，并持续运行一年。通过流水线并行优化技术，在V100架构的DumpsterCluster上实现了LLaMA-70B模型的推理吞吐量测试，并与当前一代硬件（B200系统）进行了对比分析。

Result: 经济方面，DumpsterCluster的构建成本（2.2万美元）远低于8卡B200系统（60万美元）。性能方面，通过优化可达到具有竞争力的LLaMA-70B吞吐量。但在能耗和碳排放方面存在显著劣势：老一代GPU的每token能耗更高，仅在低电价地区总拥有成本才具优势；在电网平均碳排放强度下，二手系统对8B模型的每token碳排放比新一代硬件高约4倍，对70B模型则高出40倍以上。

Conclusion: GPU再利用并非普遍可持续，硬件重新部署必须与低碳能源策略性结合。在具备有利能源经济和清洁电力的地区，二手GPU为扩展AI算力提供了一条可行路径，能够同时实现可负担性、能源安全和环境责任。但在高碳排放电网区域，这种方案的环境代价可能超过经济效益。

Abstract: As AI datacenters retire functional GPUs, vast quantities of still capable accelerators enter secondary markets. This paper investigates whether these retired GPUs can find a productive afterlife to form a DumpsterCluster that can serve modern LLM inference, and under what conditions such repurposing is economically viable and environmentally sustainable. We physically built a 128-GPU DumpsterCluster from scratch using only second-hand components and ran it for one year. At current market prices (\$22K for the DumpsterCluster vs. \$600K for an 8-GPU B200 system), the economic advantages are substantial. Through pipeline-parallel optimizations, our V100 based DumpsterCluster achieves competitive LLaMA-70B throughput, validating production viability. However, our deployment reveals critical context dependencies. Older GPUs consume significantly more energy per token, making total cost of ownership favorable only in regions with inexpensive electricity. Under grid-average carbon intensity, second-hand systems can produce approximately 4x higher total carbon emissions per token for 8B models, and over 40x for 70B models, compared to current-generation hardware. These findings show that GPU afterlife is not universally sustainable - hardware repurposing must be strategically coupled with low carbon energy sources. When deployed in regions with favourable energy economics and clean electricity, second-hand GPUs offer a viable pathway for expanding AI capacity while advancing affordability, energy security, and environmental responsibility.

</details>


### [236] [One Residual with Three Reuses: A Wristband Front End for Gesture Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16542)
*Sam Rifaki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对手腕佩戴手势识别和运动症状监测，提出了一种低功耗前端设计，在纽扣电池预算下结合MEMS IMU和60GHz FMCW雷达，在遮挡和佩戴漂移下保持鲁棒性。通过共享残差生成器实现分类器唤醒门控、传感器路由和EKF测量重加权，在边缘MCU上实现0.72/0.80检测概率、47%能耗降低和4.6倍姿态跟踪误差改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手腕佩戴的持续手势感知系统需要低功耗、鲁棒的前端设计。现有系统在遮挡和佩戴漂移条件下性能下降，且功耗受限（纽扣电池预算）。需要设计一种结合MEMS IMU和60GHz FMCW雷达的前端，在保持鲁棒性的同时满足严苛的功耗约束。

Method: 设计了一个共享片上残差生成器的手腕前端架构，该生成器同时服务于：(1) 分类器唤醒门控；(2) mmWave与IMU传感器路由；(3) 基于创新的扩展卡尔曼滤波(EKF)测量重加权。该设计占用14.4KB程序存储器和278B状态存储，在Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus类边缘MCU上以每帧110K MAC运行。在四个公开数据集(IPN Hand, SHREC 2021, MiliPoint, EAT-Radar)上验证设计。

Result: 在1%虚警率下检测概率达到PD=0.72/0.80；在90%手势检测召回率下减少47%分类器调用能耗；相较于自适应卡尔曼滤波R膨胀基线，在测量偏差漂移下姿态跟踪RMSE降低4.6倍。设计占用14.4KB程序存储器、278B状态存储，每帧110K MAC计算量。

Conclusion: 本研究是一项设计研究（实测硅功耗和身体佩戴采集留待后续硬件工作），验证了通过共享残差生成器实现多功能融合的低功耗手腕前端设计方案的可行性，为纽扣电池供电的持续手势感知系统提供了有效的设计范式。

Abstract: Continuous wrist-worn hand sensing for gesture interfaces and motor symptom monitoring needs an always-on front end that fits inside a coin-cell power budget while pairing a micro-electro-mechanical-systems (MEMS) inertial measurement unit (IMU) with a 60 GHz frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar to stay robust under occlusion and on-body drift. We present a design study of such a wristband front end in which classifier wake-up gating, mmWave versus IMU routing, and innovation-based EKF measurement reweighting share a single on-chip residual generator. The shared generator occupies 14.4 KB of program memory and 278 B of state and runs at 110K multiply-accumulates (MACs) per frame on an Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus class edge microcontroller unit (MCU). Across four public sensor data corpora (IPN Hand, SHREC 2021, MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW radar, EAT-Radar) the front end reaches detection probability $P_D = 0.72/0.80$ at a 1% false-alarm rate, sustains a 47% classifier invocation energy reduction at 90% gesture detection recall, and lowers pose tracking root-mean-square error by $4.6\times$ under measurement bias drift relative to an adaptive Kalman with $R$-inflation baseline. Measured silicon power and on-body capture are deferred to follow-on hardware; the contribution here is a design study.

</details>


### [237] [Calibrated Trust, Not Sharper Prediction: An Empirical Test of Uncertainty Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14617)
*Surya Saka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过大规模实验发现，将不确定性工具融合到法律AI预测管道中并未显著提升预测性能，甚至引入校准误差和安全风险；但通过保形选择性预测层，可实现对案件的有效分流，提升系统的可信赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律AI领域存在一种反复出现的提议：通过将多种不确定性工具（证据图、贝叶斯更新、Dempster-Shafer融合、保形预测）融合到统一管道中来提升案件结果预测效果。然而，这种融合管道的实际效果尚未经过严格验证，研究旨在系统性评估其在真实法律场景中的表现。

Method: 在1,000个欧洲人权法院真实案件上，比较三类方法：（A）原始LLM、（B）通过融合管道的LLM、（C）通过相同管道的词频基线。测试覆盖Claude Opus 4.8和GPT-5.5两个前沿LLM，共约4,750项测试。系统性地评估融合管道对判别性能、校准误差、安全性的影响，并探索其在选择性预测中的操作价值。

Result: 实验发现：（1）在判别性能上（AUROC约0.83），融合管道相比原始LLM或基线无提升，直接使用前沿LLM即为最强判别器；（2）朴素组合LLM与贝叶斯/Dempster-Shafer融合导致校准误差翻倍（ECE从约0.16升至0.46），存在先验不匹配机制；（3）Dempster-Shafer融合在长链场景中存在主动安全风险，以高置信度错误标记低于随机水平的准确率；（4）移除问题组件、重校准并应用类别条件风险控制后，系统在1,000案件全集上实现96.8%自动清理准确率、0.5%错误逃逸率、96.3%送审率，显著优于未调优基线的85.9%/3.8%/72.1%。

Conclusion: 融合管道在法律领域的主要贡献并非提升预测敏锐度，而是提供可校准的信任机制。研究建议移除Dempster-Shafer融合，并通过保形选择性预测层实现案件自动化与人工审核的有效分流，从而构建更可信赖的法律AI系统。

Abstract: A recurring proposal in legal AI is to improve case-outcome prediction by fusing uncertainty tools (evidence graphs with belief propagation, sequential Bayesian odds updating, Dempster-Shafer combination, and conformal prediction) into one pipeline. We test this on 1,000 real European Court of Human Rights cases from LexGLUE and FairLex, predicting whether the Court found a Convention violation from the case's fact paragraphs. We compare three families across two frontier LLMs (Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5) as per-fact evidence estimators: (A) the raw LLM, (B) the LLM routed through the fusion pipeline, and (C) a term-frequency baseline through the same pipeline. Across roughly 4,750 tests we find: (1) on discrimination (AUROC around 0.83) the pipeline yields no improvement over either the raw LLM or the baseline; a frontier LLM used directly is the strongest single discriminator. (2) Naively composing an LLM with Bayesian-odds and Dempster-Shafer fusion more than doubles calibration error (ECE from about 0.16 to 0.46) via a prior-mismatch mechanism that replicates across both models. (3) Dempster-Shafer fusion is actively unsafe on long chains, committing confidently to wrong labels at below-chance accuracy; we recommend removing it. (4) The pipeline's genuine value is operational: routed through a conformal selective-prediction layer, the system decides which cases to automate and which to escalate. After removing Dempster-Shafer, recalibrating, and applying class-conditional risk control on the full 1,000-case set, the tuned engine auto-clears at 96.8 percent accuracy with 0.5 percent errors escaping and 96.3 percent caught for review, versus 85.9 / 3.8 / 72.1 for an untuned baseline. The contribution of such pipelines in law is calibrated trust, not sharper prediction.

</details>


### [238] [PIKFNO: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Physics Informed Kernel Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14619)
*Yuan Guo,Hanshu Chen,Zhuojia Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种新型可解释神经算子框架PIKFNO，通过将物理信息核函数显式融入神经算子架构，在有限训练数据下实现了高预测精度和优越泛化能力，同时显著提升了模型的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经算子（如DeepONet）依赖深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏物理可解释性和数据效率。为了构建既符合物理规律又具有高度可解释性的神经算子，作者提出将物理信息核函数显式整合到神经算子架构中。

Method: 提出PIKFNO框架，通过物理信息核函数约束主干网络，使算子结构与无网格配点法中使用的核展开相一致。引入两种构建策略：一是直接从数据学习核函数（可视为非奇异基本解），二是通过对解析基本解进行变换构建核函数。

Result: 数值实验表明，PIKFNO在有限训练数据条件下实现了高预测精度和优越的泛化能力，同时具有显著改进的可解释性。学习到的核函数可被解释为非奇异基本解，为模型提供了物理意义。

Conclusion: PIKFNO为开发高效、物理一致且可解释的神经算子提供了新途径，成功弥合了数据驱动方法与物理约束之间的差距，为科学计算中的深度学习应用开辟了新方向。

Abstract: This work proposes a new interpretable neural operator framework, termed the Physics Informed Kernel Function Neural Operator (PIKFNO), which explicitly incorporates physics informed kernel functions derived from governing equations into the neural operator architecture. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which rely on deep networks to implicitly learn basis functions, PIKFNO constrains the trunk network through physics informed kernel functions, thereby aligning its operator structure with the kernel expansions used in meshless collocation methods. Two construction strategies are introduced: one learns kernel functions directly from data, where the learned kernel can be regarded as a nonsingular fundamental solution, while the other builds them through transformations of analytical fundamental solutions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that PIKFNO achieves high predictive accuracy with substantially improved interpretability and superior generalization under limited training data. The proposed framework offers a new pathway for developing efficient, physically consistent, and interpretable neural operators.

</details>


### [239] [Explaining Reinforcement Learning Decisions in Self-adaptive Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14620)
*Jasmina Gajcin,Juan C. Rosero,Ivana Dusparic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了EARL，一个用于在强化学习（RL）环境中生成反事实解释的Python库，旨在提高RL策略（特别是深度RL）的可解释性和透明度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习在自治和自适应系统中应用广泛，但RL策略（尤其是基于神经网络的深度RL）缺乏透明性、难以理解。这会导致用户信任度降低，并增加系统验证的难度。因此，需要一种有效的方法来为RL系统生成直观、用户友好的解释。

Method: 提出EARL（Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning）Python库，通过探索“如果……会怎样”（What-if）场景来生成反事实解释。该方法通过比较可能的结果来阐明智能体的行为。EARL支持在真实的基于RL的自适应系统中生成反事实解释。

Result: 在一个CitiBikes自行车共享系统的自适应仿真中演示了EARL的适用性，并提供了评估结果，展示了EARL在实际应用中的性能表现。

Conclusion: EARL成功填补了现有反事实解释实现多局限于玩具示例和基准测试的空白，为现实RL自适应系统提供了一种可行的解释生成方案，有助于提升RL系统的可解释性和用户信任度。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been extensively used in autonomous and self-* systems, but RL policies, especially deep RL ones relying on neural networks, lack transparency and are difficult to understand. This can lead to diminished user trust, and makes for a more challenging verification of systems. To address this challenge, this paper introduces Explanations using Alternative Realities for Reinforcement Learning (EARL), a Python library to produce counterfactual explanations in RL settings. This library allows the user to produce explanations by exploring What-if scenarios to clarify agent behavior by comparing possible outcomes. Counterfactual explanations have been shown to be intuitive and user-friendly in psychology research, but have only recently been explored in RL, with existing implementations usually limited to toy examples and benchmarks. EARL supports counterfactual explanation generation in realistic RL-based self-adaptive systems. To demonstrate its applicability, we demonstrate its use in a simulation of CitiBikes, a self-adaptive bike-sharing system, and we provide evaluations showing how it performs in real applications.

</details>


### [240] [Metaplasticity as adaptive gradient preconditioning for incremental learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14634)
*Isabelle Aguilar,Zayn Andre Zainal,Omid Kavehei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 受生物突触元可塑性启发，提出SynGAP框架，通过自适应梯度预条件化实现任务无关的持续学习，在CIFAR-100和CORe50基准上显著优于EWC++和经验回放等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物智能通过互补学习系统(CLS)理论和突触元可塑性自然避免灾难性遗忘，而人工神经网络在非平稳环境中面临稳定性-可塑性困境。现有持续学习解决方案通常需要任务标签或产生巨大内存开销，与生物现实存在偏差。

Method: 提出SynGAP（突触几何自适应预条件化）框架：1)在连续数据流上维护Fisher信息矩阵的指数移动平均，模拟实时元可塑性；2)将动态元可塑性状态转换为有界乘法掩码；3)通过预条件化原始梯度，选择性抑制对关键历史参数的更新。该方法无需显式情节触发或任务标签。

Result: 在Split CIFAR-100基准上，SynGAP准确率比EWC++提升4倍，比经验回放(ER)高出近10%，遗忘度量相比两种方法降低超过10%。在CORe50基准上达到约68%准确率，相比优化器基线提升10%。

Conclusion: 通过将连续生物元可塑性数学形式化为稳定的基于梯度的正则化，SynGAP为边缘自适应智能提供了一个高度鲁棒且内存高效的解决方案，成功桥接了生物学机制与人工神经网络的持续学习。

Abstract: Biological intelligence naturally prevents catastrophic forgetting through Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory, a macroscopic consolidation process driven at the local level by synaptic metaplasticity: the continuous, history-dependent neuromodulation of individual synapses. While artificial neural networks struggle with the stability-plasticity dilemma in non-stationary environments, existing solutions often require task labels or incur massive memory overhead, diverging from biological reality. Re-framing this localized neuromodulation as an optimization-driven process, we introduce $\textbf{SynGAP}$: $\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning. SynGAP is a task-free continual learning framework based on adaptive gradient preconditioning. Rather than relying on explicit episodic triggers, SynGAP simulates real-time metaplasticity by maintaining an exponential moving average of the Fisher Information Matrix over a continuous data stream. During the optimization step, these dynamic metaplastic states are translated into a bounded multiplicative mask that preconditions raw gradients, selectively attenuating updates to critical historical parameters. Empirical evaluations demonstrate SynGAP's superior ability to mitigate catastrophic forgetting compared to established baselines. On the Split CIFAR-100 benchmark, SynGAP delivers a $4\times$ increase in accuracy compared to EWC++ and outperforms Experience Replay (ER) by almost $10\%$, while reducing the forgetting measure by over $10\%$ against both methods. Furthermore, on the CORe50 benchmark, SynGAP achieves about $68\%$, a $10\%$ improvement over optimizer baselines. By mathematically formalizing continuous biological metaplasticity as stable gradient-based regularization, SynGAP offers a highly robust and memory-efficient solution for adaptive intelligence at the edge.

</details>


### [241] [Fractional Optimizers Meet Fractal Activation Functions: An Empirical Study of Multi-Scale Optimization in Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14636)
*Sebastian Raubitzek,Georg Goldenits,Sebastian Schrittwieser,Philip König,Kevin Mallinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了分数阶优化方法与分形激活函数的交互作用，发现两者存在选择性配对关系：正则化式分数阶缩放与特定分形激活函数配合良好，而自适应记忆分数阶优化在扰动表面上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分数阶优化方法和分形激活函数是改进神经网络训练的两个独立研究方向，但二者的交互作用尚未被探索。本文旨在统一实验框架下研究这两种方法的协同效果。

Method: 在Ackley和Himmelblau基准测试曲面（包括标准形式和添加Weierstrass型扰动）以及十个分类数据集的前馈神经网络中，系统评估分数阶优化器族与常规/分形激活函数的组合性能。比较包括标准方法、正则化式优化器、显式和自适应记忆分数阶优化器等。

Result: 分数阶优化与分形激活函数存在有用但选择性的配对关系。正则化式分数阶缩放在神经网络训练中与特定分形激活函数配合良好；Grünwald-Letnikov记忆在扰动表面上最相关；自适应记忆在多个案例中改善了简单记忆替代的效果。

Conclusion: 受控的分数阶记忆是一个有前景的研究方向，但不应作为通用替代方案。分数阶优化与分形激活函数的有效配对需要根据具体任务和应用场景进行选择。

Abstract: Fractional optimization methods and fractal activation functions are two independent directions for improving neural network training. Fractional optimizers extend first-order optimization through fractional derivatives and memory effects, whereas fractal activations introduce multi-scale nonlinear representations based on self-similar Weierstrass- and Blancmange-type functions. Here, we investigate their interaction within a unified experimental framework. We evaluate fractional optimizer families on Ackley and Himmelblau benchmark surfaces, in standard form and with additive Weierstrass-type perturbations, and then in feed-forward neural networks with conventional and fractal activations on ten classification datasets. The comparison includes standard methods, regularization-style optimizers, explicit and adaptive memory-based fractional optimizers, and other representative literature methods. Overall, fractional optimization and fractal activations show useful but selective pairings. Regularization-style fractional scaling performs well with selected fractal activations in network training, while Grünwald--Letnikov memory is most relevant on perturbed surfaces. Adaptive memory improves plain memory substitution in several cases, supporting controlled fractional memory as a promising direction rather than a universal replacement.

</details>


### [242] [Early Cycle Charge Trajectory Generative Prediction and Full Life Cycle Health Management of Iron-Chromium Flow Batteries Based on FlowBD-E1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14637)
*Suyang Zhuang,Zekun Jiang,Tianhang Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对铁铬液流电池提出FlowBD-E1早期循环生成预测框架，仅用前9个循环数据即可高精度预测整个生命周期的充放电轨迹和健康状态，为长时储能电池的早期退化诊断提供了新方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时固定储能电池需要在容量显著衰减前检测其退化。铁铬液流电池因使用丰富廉价活性物质而具吸引力，但受慢铬动力学、析氢、膜渗透和电解质失衡等耦合过程影响，且现有电池预测研究多集中于锂离子电池或将老化简化为标量容量和健康状态标签。

Method: 基于工业级33 kW铁铬液流电池，提出FlowBD-E1早期循环生成预测框架，结合多尺度卷积编码器、生命周期Transformer和年龄感知FiLM解码器，对比三种部署策略：单步潜在外推（SLE）、递归潜在预测（RLF）和教师强制更新（TFU）。

Result: 仅使用289个循环中的前9个循环，RLF方法在剩余生命周期的联合电压/电流MAPE达0.731%，SOH估计MAPE低于1%；消融实验和独立序列测试表明，该年龄感知生成架构优于LSTM和TCN基线，在工业验证下保持亚百分比误差。

Conclusion: 早期循环轨迹生成可将短期调试记录转化为液流电池管理的长期诊断信号，为长时储能系统的早期退化检测和预测性维护提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Long-duration stationary energy storage requires batteries whose degradation can be detected before substantial capacity loss has accumulated. Iron-chromium redox flow batteries are attractive for this role because they use abundant and low-cost active species, yet their operation is shaped by slow chromium kinetics, hydrogen evolution, membrane crossover and electrolyte imbalance. These coupled processes gradually reshape the full charge voltage/current (V/I) trajectory, but most battery prognostic studies either focus on lithium-ion cells or compress ageing into scalar capacity and state-of-health (SOH) labels. Here we study an industrial 33 kW Fe-Cr redox flow battery and introduce FlowBD-E1, an early-cycle generative forecasting framework that predicts complete future charge V/I trajectories from only the first few cycles. The model combines a multi-scale convolutional encoder, a lifecycle Transformer and an age-aware FiLM decoder, and we compare three deployment strategies: single-step latent extrapolation (SLE), recursive latent forecasting (RLF) and teacher-forced updating (TFU). Using the first 9 of 289 cycles, RLF achieved a joint V/I mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 0.731% over the remaining lifecycle and produced SOH estimates below 1% MAPE. Ablation and independent-sequence tests showed that the age-aware generative architecture outperformed LSTM and TCN baselines and retained sub-percent errors under industrial validation. These results suggest that early-cycle trajectory generation can turn a short commissioning record into a long-horizon diagnostic signal for flow-battery management.

</details>


### [243] [Randomly initialized autoencoders: fixed points and edge-of-chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14638)
*Leonid Berlyand,Roman Sarapin,Yitzchak Shmalo,Victor Slavin,Sasha Sodin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了自编码器的固定点性质，提出了局部和全局混沌边缘概念来控制不同尺度的输入扰动，利用随机矩阵理论分析了自编码器的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自编码器作为一类特殊的深度神经网络，其性能可通过固定点来刻画。这自然引发了关于固定点的存在性、稳定性及其吸引域的问题。这些问题与自编码器的收缩性质密切相关，也与混沌边缘概念紧密相连。

Method: 利用随机矩阵理论的谱技术研究局部混沌边缘问题；使用高斯过程的Sudakov-Fernique不等式研究全局混沌边缘问题；将混沌边缘概念从一般神经网络推广并改进到自编码器场景。

Result: 提出了适用于自编码器的局部和全局混沌边缘概念，分别用于控制小尺度和任意尺度的输入扰动；基于随机矩阵理论的谱技术分析了局部混沌边缘；利用Sudakov-Fernique不等式分析了全局混沌边缘。

Conclusion: 通过引入局部和全局混沌边缘概念，为自编码器的稳定性分析提供了理论框架；将自编码器的稳定性研究纳入随机矩阵理论中非线性问题的范畴，为深入理解自编码器的动力学性质提供了新的理论工具。

Abstract: In this paper we study autoencoders, a special class of deep neural nets (DNNs) whose performance can be characterized via their fixed points. This perspective naturally raises questions of existence, stability, and basins of attraction of these fixed points. These questions are addressed via the contractive properties of autoencoders, and are closely related to the notion of edge-of-chaos.
  Edge-of-chaos (EoC) is an important notion in the theory of DNNs. It describes the critical regime separating ordered and chaotic signal propagation through a randomly initialized network. Initialization at or near this critical regime offers several theoretical and practical advantages, including stability of the network w.r.t. perturbations of the input. EoC was previously introduced for broad classes of neural networks using mean-field averaging methods. In this paper we modify the notion of EoC for the study of autoencoders. Specifically, we introduce local and global EoC for autoencoders that control local (small) and global (arbitrary) perturbations of the input respectively.
  The study of stability of autoencoders falls within the scope of nonlinear problems in Random Matrix Theory (RMT). Our analysis of local EoC is based on spectral techniques of RMT, whereas global EoC is studied by employing Sudakov-Fernique inequality for Gaussian processes.

</details>


### [244] [Valid Per-Field Selective Risk Control for Document Extraction: Three Failure Modes, a Validity Ladder, and When Conditioning Pays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14639)
*Bhaskar Gurram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了文档提取系统中"按字段接受/审查"流程存在三种失效模式，导致错误率控制失效，并提出了一套有效性层级方案，通过拟合/验证分割协议和Mondrian Learn-then-Test方法，实现了风险控制，其中支持箱（support-bin）方法在特定条件下表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文档提取系统需要一种信任契约：仅当被接受字段的错误率被控制时才接受该字段。然而，现有自然流程在真实文档上会悄然违反这一契约。作者旨在诊断失效原因并构建可证明风险控制的解决方案。

Method: 在13,859个Claude-Sonnet-5字段上进行实验，诊断三种失效模式（文档聚类、分数重拟合泄漏、并列群体病理）；构建四层有效性层级：(1)期望选择性风险控制；(2)分组PAC证书（Mondrian Learn-then-Test）；(3)簇校正；(4)文档级IID证书；并引入支持箱（support-bin）作为预定义来源分类法。

Result: 拟合/验证分割协议恢复了期望选择性风险控制：覆盖率0.318，风险0.096（α=0.10）；Mondrian Learn-then-Test产生分组PAC证书：field-iid覆盖率0.171（风险0.068），cluster-corrected 0.140，doc-iid 0.060；支持箱在Sonnet CORD上击败所有层级（p<1e-4，Bonferroni校正），但在Haiku或Qwen上未能复现；人工审计验证实际层级接受集风险为1.3%（预算10%，Fleiss' kappa=0.83）。

Conclusion: 现有风险控制协议在真实文档上存在严重失效，但通过合理的分割协议和校验方法可以实现有效的风险控制；支持箱方法在特定条件下表现优异，但不同模型间存在异质性；文档级证书虽然形式上唯一匹配文档，但目前实际效用接近空白。

Abstract: Per-field accept/review with selective risk at most alpha -- accept a field only if the error rate among accepted fields is controlled -- is the trust contract document-extraction systems need, and the natural procedure silently violates it on real documents. On 13,859 genuine claude-sonnet-5 fields from 800 CORD receipts (49.0% correct) we diagnose three failure modes: document clustering (design effect 1.84-2.45), score-refit leakage (coverage 0.416 at risk 0.127, violating alpha=0.10 in 95% of splits), and a tie-mass pathology (a degenerate score collapses the threshold grid, 0.030 to 0.001). We organize the fixes as a validity ladder, guarantee form stated per tier. A fit/val split protocol restores expected-selective-risk control for a learned fusion: coverage 0.318 at risk 0.096 at nominal alpha=0.10, no tolerance band (production variant 0.326) -- an on-average point whose realized risk exceeds alpha in 47.5% of resplits, not a certificate. Mondrian Learn-then-Test with exact binomial tails yields per-group PAC certificates: field-iid 0.171 at risk 0.068, cluster-corrected 0.140, doc-iid 0.060 -- the only tier matching documents, honestly near-vacuous today. Support-bin, the pre-specified provenance taxonomy, wins every rigor tier on the sonnet CORD capture (p<1e-4, Bonferroni-corrected) -- a win that does not replicate on the same documents under haiku or qwen -- while on higher-accuracy corpora pooled thresholds win: conditioning helps exactly where pooled cannot certify, subsumed by a learned score elsewhere. A frozen-configuration confirmation on selection-untouched claude-haiku-4-5 held at both risk levels, and a blind three-annotator human-gold audit verifies the practical tier's accepted-set risk at 1.3% against its 10% budget (Fleiss' kappa=0.83; labels err one-sidedly pessimistic). Released Apache-2.0 with seed-pinned, regression-gated procedures.

</details>


### [245] [BDIP-Net: Dual-Interaction Graph Learning for Property Prediction of Bilayer Materials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14640)
*An Vuong,Chen Zhao,Jin Hu,Shui-Qing Yu,Xintao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一个用于高效构建和预测双层材料性质的机器学习框架，包括基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化工作流和显式区分层内/层间相互作用的图神经网络BDIP-Net，在多种双层体系上验证了其优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双层材料的堆叠依赖性性质研究具有重要科学意义，但计算发现面临两大挑战：（1）精确结构生成依赖昂贵的DFT优化计算；（2）现有机器学习模型无法显式区分层内强键合与层间弱范德华相互作用，导致性质预测性能不佳。

Method: 提出包含两个核心组件的机器学习框架：（1）基于MatterSim-D3的结构优化工作流，可从单层构建块和堆叠构型以大幅降低的计算成本生成DFT质量的双层结构；（2）BDIP-Net图神经网络，通过相互作用特异性势表示和自适应消息融合机制显式建模层内和层间相互作用。在BiDB、HetDB和SAMBA数据集上进行评估，涵盖同质双层、异质双层和扭转双层系统。

Result: 基于MatterSim-D3的工作流能够紧密复现DFT-PBE-D3优化结构；BDIP-Net在双层性质预测任务上持续优于现有图神经网络和基于势函数的方法。

Conclusion: 该机器学习框架成功实现了高效的双层材料构建和精确的性质预测，通过显式区分不同相互作用类型有效解决了现有方法的局限性，为双层材料的计算发现提供了强有力的工具。

Abstract: Stacked bilayer materials exhibit rich stacking-dependent properties driven by the interplay between strong intra-layer bonding and weak inter-layer van der Waals interactions. The computational discovery of such materials is challenging because accurate structure generation typically relies on expensive DFT-based optimization, while existing machine-learning models often fail to explicitly distinguish different interaction types during property prediction. To address these challenges, we propose a machine-learning framework for efficient construction and property prediction of stacked bilayer materials. The framework employs a MatterSim-D3-based structural optimization workflow to generate DFT-quality bilayer structures from monolayer building blocks and stacking configurations at substantially reduced computational cost. For property prediction, we introduce BDIP-Net (Bilayer Dual-Interaction Potential Network), a graph neural network that explicitly models intra-layer and inter-layer interactions through interaction-specific potential representations and adaptive message fusion. We evaluate the proposed framework on BiDB, HetDB, and SAMBA, encompassing homobilayers, heterobilayers, and twisted bilayer systems. Results show that the MatterSim-D3-based workflow closely reproduces DFT-PBE-D3 optimized structures, while BDIP-Net consistently outperforms existing graph neural network and potential-based approaches for bilayer property prediction.

</details>


### [246] [Training and Evaluating Ethical Reinforcement Learning Agents on Per-Episode Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14642)
*Prabhjyot Singh,Majid Ghasemi,Mark Crowley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文比较了四种在强化学习中训练伦理行为的方法，发现基于ESR准则的非补偿性效用优化方法能在几乎每个episode中严格遵守伦理违规预算，而传统方法在最坏情况下会出现违规率翻倍的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习代理在单一奖励信号上训练时会利用设计奖励与预期行为之间的差距。当试图向强化学习代理灌输伦理行为时，这是一个特别的问题——代理可以在平均水平上看起来符合伦理，同时将违规集中在少数糟糕的episode中，而且在一个episode中受到伤害的生物不会因为另一个episode中的良好行为而恢复。

Method: 在Craftax开放性生存基准测试中比较四种训练伦理行为的方法：带终止的标量惩罚、线性多目标权重扫描、自适应拉格朗日约束，以及在期望标量化回报(ESR)准则下按episode优化的非补偿性效用。所有方法都在单一检测器协议下评估，该协议统计每个episode中的每次违规而不进行审查。

Result: 在平均回报与平均违规率的前沿上，四种方法难以区分；但在每个episode层面它们显著分离。在匹配的平均回报下，ESR代理在几乎每个episode中都保持其规定的一次违规预算（最差十分位数为1.04±0.07次违规），拉格朗日方法泄漏超过相同预算（1.14±0.03），权重扫描的最差episode违规翻倍（2.20±0.20）。观察增强控制将这种分离归因于训练目标而非代理观察到内容，且每个episode的保证在均值前沿上不产生额外代价。

Conclusion: 当伦理违规无法在episode间平均消除时，训练和评估都必须针对每个episode的分布而非均值。这为在强化学习中实现真正的伦理行为保障提供了重要指导。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents trained on a single reward signal exploit the gap between the designed reward and the intended behavior. This is particularly a problem when we are trying to imbue ethical behavior into RL agents. An agent can look ethical on average while concentrating its violations in a few bad episodes, and a creature in the environment harmed in one episode is not restored by good conduct in another. We compare four ways of training ethical behavior in Craftax, an open-ended survival benchmark. The four are: scalar penalties with termination, a linear multi-objective weight sweep, an adaptive Lagrangian constraint, and a non-compensatory utility optimized per episode under the Expected Scalarized Returns (ESR) criterion. All are evaluated under a single detector-based protocol that counts every violation in every episode without censoring. On the frontier of mean return against mean violation rate, the four methods are indistinguishable; per episode they separate sharply. At matched mean return, the ESR agent holds its stated budget of one violation in effectively every episode (worst-decile 1.04 +/- 0.07 violations), the Lagrangian leaks past the same budget (1.14 +/- 0.03), and the weight sweep's worst episodes double it (2.20 +/- 0.20). An observation-augmentation control attributes the separation to the training objective rather than to what the agent observes, and the per-episode guarantee costs nothing on the mean frontier. When ethical violations do not average away across episodes, we argue both training and evaluation must target the per-episode distribution rather than the mean.

</details>


### [247] [DUET: Dual-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Same-Weight Disagreement for Prohibition Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14644)
*Zihan Li,Feifei Li,Wenhui Que*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DUET方法，通过双教师对比实现LLM运行时禁令合规，在保持正常功能的同时大幅提升合规性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际LLM部署中需要处理运行时注入的禁令规则（企业策略、PII红线、工具边界等），这些规则因请求和租户而异。传统后训练方法存在结构性缺陷：SFT将违规信号隐藏在合规标签中，DPO的序列级偏好与token级违规不匹配。

Method: DUET采用token选择性策略蒸馏方法，配置两个相同权重的教师模型：一个可见禁令（正向教师），一个不可见禁令（负向教师）。两教师的token级分歧隔离了禁令的因果效应，产生纯净的监督信号。该方法包含两个机制：信号清洗（丢弃冗余或前缀污染的一致性token）和偏好导向学习（在token粒度上将学生模型推向正向教师、远离负向教师），将DPO风格优化直接嵌入OPD中。

Result: 在1.5B-8B Qwen变体上，DUET实现72.3-85.2%的违规合规率，同时保持88-93%的正常效用，显著优于教师模型和其他蒸馏基线。外部评估显示在GSM8K和MATH-500上仅有最小性能下降，同时改善了安全对齐。

Conclusion: DUET成功解决了运行时禁令合规问题，通过双教师对比机制有效隔离禁令因果效应，在不依赖离线偏好数据的情况下实现了token级别的精准合规控制，为LLM的实际部署提供了有效的合规解决方案。

Abstract: Real-world LLM deployments increasingly rely on runtime-injected prohibitions--enterprise policies, PII redlines, tool boundaries--that vary per request and per tenant. Conventional post-training is structurally ill-suited: SFT hides the violation signal in compliant labels, and DPO's sequence-level preferences mismatch token-localized violations. We propose DUET, a token-selective on-policy distillation method for prohibition compliance. DUET pairs a teacher that sees the prohibition (positive) with an identical-weight teacher that does not (negative). Because the two teachers differ only in prohibition visibility, their per-token disagreement isolates the prohibition's causal effect--yielding a clean supervision signal uncontaminated by model capacity or mismatch. This disagreement drives two complementary mechanisms: signal cleaning, which discards agreement tokens as redundant or prefix-corrupted, and preference-directed learning, which pushes the student away from the negative teacher and toward the positive one at token granularity, embedding DPO-style optimization directly into OPD without offline preference data. We construct an industrial Prohibition-Compliance benchmark spanning five task families covering explicit-refusal, paraphrase robustness, and over-refusal. Across 1.5B-8B Qwen variants, DUET achieves 72.3-85.2% violation compliance while preserving 88-93% normal utility, dramatically outperforming teacher model and other distillation baselines. External evaluation on SysBench confirms improved safety alignment with minimal degradation on GSM8K and MATH-500.

</details>


### [248] [Efficient Neural-Network-Based High-Resolution Radiative Transfer for CO___ Retrieval, and Application to Interferometric Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14645)
*Jordan Lontsi Tedongmo,Yann Ferrec,Laurence Croizé,Pablo Musé,Gabriele Facciolo,Andrés Almansa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出一种用于大气顶辐射亮度预测的MLP代理模型，以加速CO2/CH4浓度反演，支持低成本卫星星座对温室气体排放的监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究气候变化需要降低CO2和CH4排放估算的不确定性，以更好区分人为源和自然源，这推动了具有更高重访频率和空间覆盖的星载测量。为此，Horizon Europe SCARBOn项目评估了一种低成本卫星星座，其核心传感器为NanoCarb成像干涉仪。然而，估算CO2和CH4浓度面临计算挑战：全物理反演算法依赖的高分辨率辐射传输（RT）模拟在逐行计算时计算成本高昂。

Method: 提出一种前馈多层感知机（MLP）代理模型，用于高效准确预测CO2弱波段的顶辐射亮度。该模型使用辐射亮度和RT Jacobians的联合平均绝对误差（MAE）损失，以同时保证光谱精度和对地球物理参数的敏感性。进一步将MLP代理模型与NanoCarb仪器响应耦合，构建高效的精确前向模型。

Result: 基于MLP的RT代理模型与NanoCarb仪器响应耦合后，为NanoCarb测量提供了高效且精确的前向模型，在CO2浓度反演中显示出有前景的结果。

Conclusion: 所提出的MLP代理模型能够替代计算昂贵的逐行辐射传输模拟，在保持预测精度的同时显著降低计算成本，为实现高重访频率和空间覆盖的温室气体浓度反演提供了有效技术途径。

Abstract: Studying climate change requires reducing uncertainties in CO2 and CH4 emission estimates to better distinguish anthropogenic from natural sources, which motivates spaceborne measurements with improved revisit frequency and spatial coverage. In this context, the Horizon Europe SCARBOn project assesses a low-cost satellite constellation featuring the NanoCarb imaging interferometer as its core sensor for monitoring CO2 and CH4 emissions in the atmosphere. However, estimating CO2 and CH4 concentrations with high revisit and spatial coverage poses significant challenges: full-physics retrieval algorithms commonly used rely on repeated high-resolution radiative transfer (RT) simulations, which are computationally expensive when using line-by-line RT models. As an alternative, we propose in this study a feedforward multilayer perceptron (MLP) surrogate designed to accurately and efficiently predict top-of-atmosphere radiances in the CO2 weak band, using a combined mean absolute error (MAE) loss on radiances and RT Jacobians to preserve both spectral accuracy and sensitivity to geophysical parameters. Coupling the MLP-based RT surrogate with the NanoCarb instrumental response yields an efficient and precise forward model for NanoCarb measurements, which shows promising results for CO2 concentration retrieval.

</details>


### [249] [iFuzz-Meta: An Interpretable Fuzzy Learning Framework Bridging Top-Down and Bottom-Up Knowledge Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14646)
*Xiaowei Jiang,Daniel Leong,Beining Cao,Nan Zhou,Yingtao Ren,Yu-Cheng Chang,Thomas Do,Chin-Teng Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了iFuzz-Meta，一个可解释的模糊规则学习框架，通过在神经网络中保留人类可理解的推理结构，实现了透明推理和跨领域泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经计算中可解释表示学习仍是一个关键挑战，模型不仅需要表现良好，还需要能够解释其推理过程。现有方法缺乏人类可理解的推理结构。

Method: 提出iFuzz-Meta框架：1) 每个模糊规则对应原始特征空间中定义的语义和空间原型；2) 采用元学习分析可解释规则如何跨任务和领域重组；3) 引入知识引导的正则化机制实现自上而下和自下而上的整合，将理论先验作为软归纳偏置。

Result: iFuzz-Meta实现了可解释推理和稳定的跨领域泛化性能，能够沿语义和生理意义明确的轨迹进行适应，而非任意参数转移。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了通往可解释和知识感知模糊系统的潜在通用路径，为现代神经架构中的可解释表示学习提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Interpretable representation learning remains a key challenge in modern neural computation, particularly when models are expected not only to perform but also to explain their reasoning. This paper introduces iFuzz-Meta, an interpretable fuzzy rule-based learning framework that preserves human-understandable reasoning structures within modern neural architectures. Each fuzzy rule corresponds to a semantic and spatial prototype defined in the original feature space, enabling transparent inference and direct interpretability. Meta-learning is employed as an analytical paradigm to examine how these interpretable rules reorganize across tasks and domains, providing a principled means to link algorithmic adaptation with cognitive representation. A knowledge-guided regularization mechanism further enables a top-down-bottom-up integration, in which theoretical priors act as soft inductive biases while data-driven learning refines and extends them. This dual process ensures that adaptation proceeds along semantically and physiologically meaningful trajectories, rather than arbitrary parameter shifts. Evaluations demonstrate that iFuzz-Meta achieves interpretable reasoning and stable cross-domain generalization, establishing a potential general pathway toward explainable and knowledge-aware fuzzy systems.

</details>


### [250] [SMOPD: Selective Token-Entropy Masking for Dirty-History Multi-Turn On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14647)
*Chenyang Jiang,Changhan Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SMOPD方法，通过选择性掩蔽低熵token来稳定多轮OPSD，在LiC基准上提升1.0-2.5pp准确率，优于基于最终答案正确性的缩放方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮OPSD存在脆弱性问题：一旦学生模型生成错误中间回复，后续轮次将基于该错误回复进行，导致均匀蒸馏在低纠正信号token上浪费损失。需要一种能针对token级别不确定性而非粗粒度轨迹结果进行稳定化的方法。

Method: 提出SMOPD（选择性掩蔽在线策略蒸馏）方法：对每个生成的中间轮回复，按学生熵排序token位置，从裁剪的广义JS蒸馏损失中移除最低熵的20%token；最终答案损失和FULL保留损失保持不变。该方法不增加参数，推理时零开销。

Result: 在LiC基准上使用Qwen3模型：SMOPD在单种子1.7B、4B、8B模型上提升SHARDED-view准确率1.0-2.5pp；4B多种子实验显示相比基线平均+1.7pp（p=0.022）。对比实验表明：单独使用结果缩放在1.7B上有害（-4.0pp）；与掩蔽结合时效果依赖于规模（4B:+1.3pp，1.7B:中性，8B:-0.5pp）。

Conclusion: token级不确定性比标量最终答案正确性是更可靠的稳定化信号，证明了SMOPD在dirty-history OPSD设置中的有效性。未来工作将进行因果机制测试和更广泛的基准验证。

Abstract: Dirty-history rollouts make multi-turn on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) brittle: once a student emits an erroneous intermediate reply, later turns are conditioned on that reply, and uniform distillation can spend loss on tokens that carry little corrective signal. We introduce SMOPD (Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation), a loss-only stabilization method for multi-turn OPSD. For each generated middle-turn reply, SMOPD ranks token positions by student entropy and removes the lowest-entropy 20% from the clipped generalized Jensen-Shannon distillation loss; final-answer and FULL-preservation losses are unchanged. This design targets token-level uncertainty rather than coarse trajectory outcomes, adds no parameters, and has zero inference-time overhead. We compare SMOPD with a correctness-scaling variant that multiplies a common detached reliability proxy using final-answer correctness. On LiC with Qwen3 models, SMOPD improves SHARDED-view accuracy by 1.0-2.5 percentage points in single-seed 1.7B, 4B, and 8B comparisons, and a small 4B multi-seed check shows a +1.7pp mean SHARDED gain over baseline (two-tailed p = 0.022). Adding the outcome scalar is harmful without masking at 1.7B (-4.0pp) and remains scale-dependent when combined with masking (+1.3pp at 4B, neutral at 1.7B, and -0.5pp at 8B). These archived aggregate results suggest that token-level uncertainty is a more reliable stabilization signal than scalar final-answer correctness in this evaluated dirty-history OPSD setting, while leaving causal mechanism tests and broader benchmark validation to future work.

</details>


### [251] [Discrete Diffusion Language Models Are Training-Free Multi-Label Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14649)
*Pawan Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需训练的多标签文本分类方法dLLM-SetScore，通过离散掩码扩散语言模型对每个标签独立评分，有效解决了标签位置偏差问题，在多个数据集上取得了优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多标签文本分类任务中，传统方法需要大量标注数据或特定任务的微调。现有的基于提示的方法在处理多个标签时存在严重的位置偏差问题（第一个答案位置几乎总是预测为正类），这促使研究者开发一种无需训练且能避免此类偏差的新方法。

Method: 提出dLLM-SetScore方法，使用离散掩码扩散语言模型进行多标签文本分类。该方法对每个候选标签构造简单的"是/否"问题，在单个掩码位置比较两个答案token的概率。采用逐标签评分策略，确保每个标签处于相同句法位置，消除标签顺序对预测的影响。方法无需任务特定微调或在文本蕴涵数据集上训练，仅需200个标注验证样本用于选择阈值、温度和提示措辞。

Result: 在六个数据集上评估了LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B，与NLI模型、自回归LLM、SetFit和监督分类器进行对比。在五个共享数据集上，Instruct检查点在10次比较中9次提升macro-F1，8次提升micro-F1。LLaDA-Instruct在Reuters和ECtHR数据集上取得了无需训练方法中的最高性能值。证明了排列不变性，刻画了加权Hamming损失下的阈值决策特性，推导了召回率和F1的短名单上限。探索性的局部联合集合细化步骤降低了F1值，作为负面结果保留。

Conclusion: dLLM-SetScore方法成功解决了多标签分类中的标签位置偏差问题，在无需训练的设置下取得了竞争性甚至最优的性能。逐标签评分策略证明了其在消除位置偏差方面的有效性，为训练免费的多标签分类提供了新思路。方法具有理论保证的排列不变性，并给出了性能上界的理论刻画。

Abstract: We present dLLM-SetScore, a training-free method that uses discrete masked-diffusion language models for multi-label text classification. For each candidate label, it asks a short yes/no question and compares the probabilities of the two answer tokens at one masked position. The method uses no task-specific fine-tuning or training on textual-entailment datasets; a 200-example labelled validation slice selects thresholds, temperature, and prompt wording.
  We first show that placing all labels in one prompt creates a strong slot-position asymmetry: the first answer slot is predicted positive on $99.4\%$ of GoEmotions examples and $100\%$ of Reuters examples. Per-label scoring places every label in the same syntactic position, making predictions invariant to label order and avoiding this artifact. We evaluate LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B on six datasets against NLI models, an autoregressive LLM, SetFit, and supervised classifiers. On the five datasets shared by both diffusion families, Instruct checkpoints improve macro-F1 in 9 of 10 comparisons and micro-F1 in 8 of 10, although these comparisons do not identify the cause. Within our protocol, LLaDA-Instruct records the highest training-free values for both Reuters and ECtHR metrics. We prove permutation invariance, characterize thresholded decisions under weighted Hamming loss, and derive shortlist ceilings for recall and F1. An exploratory local Joint Set Refinement step lowers F1 from biased and unbiased initializations and is retained as a negative result.

</details>


### [252] [Paired Exact-Reset Evaluation of a Prediction-Derived Medium-to-Full World-Model Cascade](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14650)
*Malo de Pastor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在成对精确重置物理结果下，Medium接口能否预测何时切换到Full预测器足以证明顺序开销的合理性。通过新的成对评估协议，在PushT基准测试上证明了预测接口路由器能降低决策成本，但优势仅限于低计算价格场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自适应推理和世界-动作模型系统使用廉价阶段输出或预测未来来分配额外计算。本文研究一个更狭窄的问题：在成对精确重置物理结果下，Medium派生接口能否预测何时切换到单独冻结的Full预测器能够充分改善任务特定决策损失以证明顺序开销的合理性？

Method: 提出成对评估和审计协议：所有候选动作从相同重置状态执行，Medium和Full作用于相同候选集和任务，其成对物理损失差异定义路由目标。在新的PushT基准（V106：1600个状态，39个任务，三个检查点对）上测试冻结预测接口路由器，并使用第二个PushT确认集（V107）进行前瞻性验证，采用当前DINO特征的维度匹配投影作为控制。

Result: 在V106上，冻结预测接口路由器相对于独立Medium、独立Full和延迟优势的任务专用路由器降低了包含开销的决策成本。在V107确认集上，预测接口使定价物理决策成本降低0.002549（状态聚类95%区间[-0.002867, -0.002238]；单侧95%上限-0.002286），三个检查点对均为负效应。控制PyBullet审计独立支持复合任务-预测-体制路由器。

Conclusion: 顺序路由器仍比固定策略慢，其优势仅限于低计算价格。证据支持测试的预测接口中存在增量路由信息，超出了一个刻意优待的当前DINO控制，但不支持因果充分性、计算节省、闭环价值或跨族通用性。

Abstract: Existing adaptive-inference and world-action-model systems use cheap-stage outputs or predicted futures to allocate additional computation. We study a narrower question: under paired exact-reset physical outcomes, can a Medium-derived interface predict when switching to a separately frozen Full predictor improves task-specific decision loss enough to justify sequential overhead? Our contribution is a paired evaluation and audit protocol, not a new generic routing rule: all candidate actions are executed from the same reset state, Medium and Full act on the same candidate set and task, and their paired physical-loss difference defines the routing target. On a fresh PushT bank (V106; 1,600 states, 39 tasks, three checkpoint pairs), a frozen prediction-interface router lowers overhead-inclusive decision cost relative to standalone Medium, standalone Full, and a latency-advantaged task-only router. We then prospectively seal a second 1,600-state PushT confirmation (V107) against a stronger current-state control using the task, a dimension-matched projection of current DINO features, and all five candidate actions, with no DINO encoder latency charged. The prediction interface lowers priced physical decision cost by 0.002549 (state-clustered 95% interval [-0.002867, -0.002238]; one-sided 95% upper bound -0.002286), with negative effects for all three checkpoint pairs. A controlled-PyBullet audit independently supports a composite task-prediction-regime router. The sequential router remains slower than fixed policies, and its advantage is restricted to low compute prices. The evidence supports incremental routing information in the tested prediction interface beyond one deliberately favoured current-DINO control, but not causal sufficiency, compute saving, closed-loop value, or cross-family generality.

</details>


### [253] [Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14652)
*Yang Zhao,Peisong Niu,Tian Zhou,Ziqing Ma,Guanlong Ma,Rong Jin,Huiling Yuan,Liang Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对全球高分辨率天气预报模型训练数据不足的问题，本文提出BaguanHR框架，利用超分辨率技术从低分辨率再分析数据合成大量高分辨率数据，有效解决了数据瓶颈问题，显著提升了预报性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习全球高分辨率天气预报模型的发展受到高分辨率数据稀缺的限制，现有的再分析数据仅为0.25°分辨率，而直接将低分辨率模型在有限的高分辨率样本上微调的方法，受限于粗分辨率预报中不可逆的信息损失，迁移效果不佳。

Method: 提出BaguanHR框架，核心思想是从模型迁移转向数据迁移。首先证明了超分辨率任务相比预报任务具有更低的条件熵和输入放大效应，是更稳健的分辨率迁移载体。进而利用变量级超分辨率技术，从ERA5低分辨率再分析数据合成大量0.1°高分辨率数据，并基于合成数据与真实数据的组合数据集训练模型。

Result: 在合成数据与真实数据组合数据集上训练的模型，在72小时预报时效内超过85%的时次上优于现有机器学习方法和IFS-HRES方法。发现数据量与预报误差存在幂律缩放效应：数据量翻倍可使72小时预报RMSE降低4.6%，120小时预报RMSE降低4.9%。

Conclusion: 证明了高分辨率机器学习预报模型的主要瓶颈在于数据匮乏，而非模型本身；变量级超分辨率技术为利用长期的粗分辨率再分析数据进行高分辨率训练提供了简单而通用的解决方案，有效突破了高分辨率预报模型的数据瓶颈。

Abstract: The development of 0.1$^{\circ}$ global weather forecasting models based on machine learning (ML) is constrained by the limited availability of high-resolution data, as decades of reanalysis are only available at 0.25$^{\circ}$ resolution. While existing approaches fine-tune 0.25$^{\circ}$ forecast models on limited 0.1$^{\circ}$ samples, we show that this transfer is hindered by the irreversible information loss inherent in coarse-resolution forecasting. Therefore, we propose BaguanHR, a framework that shifts the focus from transferring models to transferring data. We first show that super-resolution (SR) has lower conditional entropy and input amplification than forecasting, making it a more robust vehicle for resolution transfer. By leveraging this advantage through variable-wise SR, we synthesize extensive 0.1$^{\circ}$ data from ERA5. BaguanHR's performance on the synthetic-plus-real dataset exceeds both ML-based methods and IFS-HRES, achieving superior performance across over 85% of the lead times within 72 hours. Furthermore, our findings highlight a power-law scaling effect, as a twofold increase in data reduces RMSE by 4.6% for 72-hour forecasting and 4.9% for 120-hour forecasting. Our results demonstrate that scaling high resolution ML-based forecasting is primarily a data bottleneck, and that variable-wise super-resolution provides a simple yet general solution to unlock long coarse-resolution reanalyses for high-resolution training.

</details>


### [254] [Do Uncertainty Signals Help? A Systematic Study of Uncertainty-Aware Decoding with Rollback Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14653)
*Xianzong Wu,Xiaohong Li,Yuejun Guo,Xinyang Liu,Tianlin Li,Junjie Wang,Qiang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了基于不确定性的回滚解码策略，通过识别不可靠生成区域并回滚到早期有效前缀来提升LLM代码生成性能，在多个基准测试上取得显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测不确定性是量化模型置信度的广泛采用指标，但不确定性量化在提升大语言模型代码生成方面的潜力仍未被充分探索。作者旨在探究不确定性信号在多大程度上能有效改善基于LLM的代码生成。

Method: 提出不确定性感知的回滚解码策略（uncertainty-aware rollback decoding），这是一种推理时策略，利用不确定性信号识别不可靠的生成区域，并回滚到早期的有效前缀，而无需重新训练模型。在统一的解码设置下，评估了7个代码LLM、5个代码生成基准和8个token级不确定性信号。

Result: 完整的回滚框架在评估基准和模型设置上均优于等预算重启策略。在功能性代码生成基准上，pass@1提升高达0.26，AvgTestPassRate提升0.35；在Dsec-Python上Patch-Aligned Safe Rate绝对提升高达6.4%。信息论度量（如token熵和负对数似然）表现最佳，在标准基准上频繁取得最优或接近最优的结果。消融实验表明反馈引导的回滚提供主要改进，不确定性定位在控制其他因素后提供额外增益。

Conclusion: 不确定性信号可以有效提升LLM代码生成性能，特别是信息论度量表现突出。反馈引导的回滚机制是主要改进来源，为基于不确定性的代码生成优化提供了可行方向。

Abstract: Prediction uncertainty is a widely adopted metric for quantifying model confidence, with downstream applications spanning model explanation, data selection, and prediction rollback. Despite its demonstrated utility, the potential of uncertainty quantification to enhance code generation in large language models (LLMs) remains largely underexplored, raising a critical question: to what extent can uncertainty serve as an effective signal for improving LLM-based code generation?
  To answer this question, we study uncertainty-aware rollback decoding, an inference-time strategy that uses uncertainty signals to identify unreliable generation regions and roll back to earlier valid prefixes without retraining the model. We evaluate this framework on seven code LLMs, five code generation benchmarks, and eight token-level uncertainty signals under a unified decoding setup.
  Our results show that the complete rollback framework improves over equal-budget restart across the evaluated benchmarks and model settings, with gains of up to 0.26 in pass@1 and 0.35 in AvgTestPassRate on functional code generation benchmarks, and an absolute improvement of up to 6.4\% in Patch-Aligned Safe Rate on Dsec-Python. Among the evaluated signals, information-theoretic measures such as token entropy and negative log-likelihood show the most favorable overall trend, frequently achieving the best or near-best results on standard benchmarks. A component-controlled ablation further shows that feedback-guided rollback provides the main improvement, while uncertainty localization provides an additional gain when checking, budget, rollback, and branch decay are held fixed.

</details>


### [255] [FedImp: Enhancing Federated Learning Convergence with Impurity-Based Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.14654)
*Hai Anh Tran,Cuong Ta,Truong X. Tran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedImp算法，通过量化设备本地数据的信息含量来计算聚合权重，有效解决联邦学习中非独立同分布数据导致的训练效率低和收敛慢的问题，显著减少通信轮次并提高准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习面临设备间数据非独立同分布(non-IID)的挑战，这严重阻碍训练效率并减缓收敛速度，影响整体模型性能。

Method: 提出联邦不纯度加权(FedImp)算法，基于本地数据的信息含量量化每个设备的贡献，将这些贡献归一化以计算全局模型更新的差异化聚合权重。

Result: 在EMNIST数据集上，通信轮次相比FedAvg、FedProx和FedAdp分别减少64.4%、27.8%和66.7%；在CIFAR-10上分别减少44.2%、44%和25.6%。在高度不平衡数据分布下，FedImp超越所有基线方法并达到最高准确率。

Conclusion: FedImp为提升非IID环境下的联邦学习效率提供了有效解决方案，在收敛速度和模型准确性方面均表现优异。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a collaborative paradigm that enables multiple devices to train a global model while preserving local data privacy. A major challenge in FL is the non-Independent and Identically Distributed (non-IID) nature of data across devices, which hinders training efficiency and slows convergence. To tackle this, we propose Federated Impurity Weighting (FedImp), a novel algorithm that quantifies each device contribution based on the informational content of its local data. These contributions are normalized to compute distinct aggregation weights for the global model update. Extensive experiments on EMNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets show that FedImp significantly improves convergence speed, reducing communication rounds by up to 64.4%, 27.8%, and 66.7% on EMNIST, and 44.2%, 44%, and 25.6% on CIFAR-10 compared to FedAvg, FedProx, and FedAdp, respectively. Under highly imbalanced data distributions, FedImp outperforms all baselines and achieves the highest accuracy.
