We show that self-supervised pretraining on coarse wrist IMU activities (e.g., sitting, walking, exercise) learns motion structure rich enough to transfer to fine-grained manipulative, gestural, and procedural activities (e.g., snapping, stirring, waving) that are absent from pretraining. We implement TransfHAR as a real-time smartwatch application that lets users define and expand their own activity set for personalized recognition from only a few demonstrations. Across three offline cross-dataset evaluations, TransfHAR matches or exceeds fully supervised baselines that use complete label sets with equal or additional sensor channels, by 6.2 balanced-accuracy points on average. In an in-lab study with 10 participants each performing seven novel wrist activities, TransfHAR reaches 86.7% balanced accuracy across participants with five examples per class and 90.4% when updated from a single one-minute recording per class. These results indicate that broad self-supervised wrist pretraining provides an effective foundation for on-demand fine-grained activity recognition.

</details>


### [359] [Feasible and Novel Synthetic Population Generation with Tabular and Sequential Travel Attributes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15867)
*Farbod Abbasi,Zachary Patterson,Bilal Farooq*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出正则化两阶段生成框架，有效解决了小样本条件下人口合成中的采样零值缺失、不可行零值产生以及静态与序列属性联合生成等挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 活动导向的交通需求模型需要合成人口作为输入，但小样本数据会导致缺失有效属性组合（采样零值），生成模型可能产生不可行的结构零值，且需要同时捕捉静态人口属性和序列出行行为（如出行链），现有方法难以同时满足可行性、多样性和新颖性要求。

Method: 提出正则化两阶段生成框架：第一阶段使用带有三个正则化项（IGP、LDR、CLAP）的Wasserstein GAN梯度惩罚模型，提高表格化人口合成的可行性、多样性和新颖性；第二阶段采用Transformer和LSTM-Attention模型，基于合成的人口特征生成序列出行属性（出发时间、出行目的、出行方式）。引入新颖性和计数感知评估指标。

Result: 正则化模型在可行性、多样性和新颖性方面均优于原始WGAN-GP。可行性提高2.1-3.7个百分点，新颖性提高6.6-10.0个百分点，F1分数提高6.3-8.6个百分点，在不牺牲可行性的前提下改善了采样零值恢复。序列属性生成中，LSTM-Attention在出行长度分布匹配上表现最佳，Transformer在整体序列F1分数上更优（90.6% vs 89.1%）。跨阶段验证确认生成的机动性状态与出行链之间具有强一致性。

Conclusion: 所提出的正则化两阶段生成框架能够有效生成兼顾静态人口属性和序列出行行为的合成人口，在可行性、多样性、新颖性三个维度上均取得显著提升，为活动导向的交通需求模型提供了更高质量的输入数据。

Abstract: Synthetic populations are critical inputs for activity-based travel demand models, yet generating realistic populations from limited survey data remains challenging. Small samples miss valid attribute combinations, known as sampling zeros, and generative models may also produce infeasible structural zeros. Moreover, realistic synthetic populations must capture both static socio-demographic attributes and sequential travel behaviour, such as trip chains. This paper proposes a regularized two-stage generative framework to address these challenges, where regularization refers to additional loss terms that guide the generator toward broader valid coverage and fewer infeasible samples. In Stage 1, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty is augmented with three regularization terms, IGP, LDR, and CLAP, to improve feasibility, diversity, and novelty in tabular population synthesis. In Stage 2, Transformer and LSTM-Attention models generate sequential travel attributes, including departure time, trip purpose, and travel mode, conditioned on the synthesized tabular profiles. We also introduce novelty and count-aware metrics to evaluate whether valid unseen combinations are recovered and generated in realistic proportions. Results show that regularized models outperform the vanilla WGAN-GP across feasibility, diversity, and novelty. Regularization increases feasibility by 2.1 to 3.7 percentage points and novelty by 6.6 to 10.0 percentage points, improving sampling-zero recovery without sacrificing feasibility. The F1 score improves by 6.3 to 8.6 percentage points. For sequential attributes, LSTM-Attention best matches the trip-length distribution, while Transformer achieves higher overall sequential F1, 90.6\% versus 89.1\%. Cross-stage validation confirms strong consistency between generated mobility status and generated trip chains.

</details>


### [360] [Deploying Frontier Agentic Technology in MOOSEnger, a Multiphysics-Capable AI Assistant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15881)
*Zaid Abulawi,Mengnan Li,Guillaume Giudicelli,Yang Liu,Cody Permann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文扩展了MOOSEnger这一面向MOOSE框架的AI代理，增加了针对本地托管模型的工具集，实现了从知识检索、输入验证到经验存储的完整流程。在多个物理仿真类别的测试中，MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2达到90%成功率，显著优于基线模型的5%和0%，证明了代理式工具的重要价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOOSE多物理场仿真环境的使用门槛较高，需要专门的专业知识，这阻碍了许多领域科学家和工程师的有效使用。为了降低这一技术壁垒，需要开发智能化的辅助工具来帮助用户更高效地使用仿真框架。

Method: 开发了一个针对本地托管模型的工具集（harness），为AI代理提供完整的工作流程：从MOOSE代码库检索上下文知识、通过与仿真可执行环境的交互来验证和诊断输入文件、以及提取和存储经验教训到持久化记忆中。该框架被集成到MOOSEnger代理系统中。

Result: 在包含扩散、Navier-Stokes、相场、塑性、多孔介质流动、固体力学、瞬态传热和反应堆网格生成等8个类别的测试中（每类25个案例），MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2成功率达90%，MOOSEnger-Gemma4达76.5%。相比之下，不具备代理能力的基线模型表现极差：GPT-5.2仅5%，Gemma4为0%，充分证明了代理式工具集的关键作用。

Conclusion: 该工作成功展示了基于代理的AI工具在复杂多物理场仿真中的应用潜力，能够显著提升模型在专业领域的性能表现。通过国家反应堆创新中心虚拟测试台的实际工程问题验证了其实用价值，为降低多物理场仿真工具的使用门槛提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: The Multiphysics Object-Oriented Simulation Environment (MOOSE) is an open-source finite-element framework for building multiphysics simulation applications. Using a multiphysics environment effectively demands specialized expertise, creating a barrier for many domain scientists and engineers. MOOSEnger, developed at Idaho National Laboratory (INL), is a domain-specific, tool-enabled AI agent built for the MOOSE Framework. This work extends MOOSEnger with a harness focused on locally-hosted models. The harness gives the agent a full pipeline: it retrieves contextual knowledge from the MOOSE repository, validates and diagnoses the resulting input through interaction with the simulation executable environment, and extracts and stores lessons in a persistent memory.
  The resulting framework is demonstrated on an engineering problem from the National Reactor Innovation Center Virtual Test Bed (VTB), illustrating its potential to support realistic multiphysics simulation workflows. Additionally, the agent performance is evaluated on different categories including diffusion, Navier--Stokes, phase field, plasticity, porous media flow, solid mechanics, transient heat transfer, and reactor mesh generation. Each category consists of 25 prompts/cases. We compare MOOSEnger-Gemma4 against MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2, alongside baseline Gemma4 and GPT-5.2 without agentic capabilities. MOOSEnger-GPT-5.2 shows a slight edge, achieving a 90\% success rate versus 76.5\% for MOOSEnger-Gemma4. The baseline models perform far worse, at just 5\% (GPT-5.2) and 0\% (Gemma4), underscoring the impact of the agentic harness.

</details>


### [361] [Layers Matter: Why Continual Learning Regularization Should Be Layer-Adaptive](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15901)
*Brian B. Moser,Ahmed Anwar,Tobias Christian Nauen,Shishir Muralidhara,Federico Raue,René Schuster,Stanislav Frolov,Andreas Dengel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出传统持续学习方法（如EWC）使用的对角Fisher信息矩阵忽略了层级Hessian顶部特征值信息，导致正则化效果不佳。基于块对角Hessian假设，证明遗忘由层级顶部特征值加权决定，并提出保护早期层、放松深层层的改进策略，在EWC和SLCA上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有持续学习正则化方法（如EWC）采用逐参数的重要性权重（对角Fisher值），看似比逐层方法更灵活。然而，对抗性位翻转攻击和Hessian谱研究表明，神经网络中这种缺失的层级敏感性跨越多个数量级。对角Fisher矩阵作为层曲率的弱摘要，无法捕获控制遗忘的顶部特征值信息，这促使研究者重新审视正则化的粒度设计。

Method: 基于块对角Hessian假设（类比EWC现有的对角假设），理论分析遗忘的层级分解特性。证明遗忘可分解为各层贡献的加权和，权重由该层Hessian顶部特征值决定；对角Fisher权重无法恢复此特征值，相同Fisher均值的层其顶部特征值差异可达层宽度量级。据此提出简单策略：对早期层施加强正则化保护，允许深层层自由移动。将此策略应用于EWC和SLCA方法。

Result: 理论证明：遗忘分解为各层项之和，权重为顶部Hessian特征值；相同遗忘水平下，均匀正则化会损失新任务性能，损失量与层条件数成比例。实验验证：改进后的EWC和SLCA在平均性能和遗忘指标上均显示清晰提升，证实保护早期层、放松深层层的有效性。

Conclusion: 对角Fisher正则化存在理论缺陷，无法捕获层级顶部特征值信息导致正则化粒度不当。通过理论分析揭示遗忘的层级结构特性，提出并验证了一种简单有效的改进策略：差异化处理不同层级的正则化强度，为持续学习正则化方法的设计提供了新视角。

Abstract: Continual learning regularizers like EWC fight forgetting by penalizing changes from previous-task parameters with per-parameter importance, typically diagonal Fisher values. Per-parameter looks more flexible than per-layer, but each layer's diagonal Fisher is a weak summary of its actual curvature, missing the top-eigenvalue information that controls forgetting. Adversarial bit-flip attacks and Hessian-spectrum studies show that this missing per-layer sensitivity spans orders of magnitude in neural networks. Under a block-diagonal Hessian assumption, the layer-level analogue of EWC's existing diagonal assumption, we prove three things. Forgetting decomposes as a sum of per-layer terms weighted by each layer's top Hessian eigenvalue. Diagonal-Fisher weights cannot recover this eigenvalue. For instance, two layers with identical Fisher averages can have top eigenvalues differing by a factor as large as the layer width. For the same level of forgetting, uniform regularization loses new-task performance by an amount scaling with the layer condition number. Our theoretical analysis leads to a simple recipe: protect early layers strongly, let deeper layers move. We apply this recipe to EWC and SLCA and show clear improvements in average performance and forgetting metrics.

</details>


### [362] [Information Geometry of Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15922)
*Mykola Lukashchuk,Kyrylo Yemets,Alex Ledbetter,İsmail Şenöz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了自然梯度消息传递（NGMP）算法，在Forney风格因子图上实现了边缘局部的自然梯度平稳条件，相比传统变分消息传递在不确定性校准方面表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的变分消息传递（VMP）在处理非共轭因子时，通过对相邻信念进行平均来近似消息，这种方法在边缘不确定性持续存在时会导致精度损失。作者希望开发一种更准确的消息传递方法，能够保留接收分布族可表示的精确消息部分。

Method: 从Bethe自由能出发，将选定的边缘边际约束到指数族分布。在平稳点处，边缘的自然参数等于两个投影消息之和。每个投影消息是精确信念传播日志消息在当前接收边际处的自然梯度投影，即其在均值坐标中期望的梯度。该方法具有局部性：每条边可携带自己的指数族，因子发送的消息依赖于接收它的边际。

Result: 实验表明，NGMP在Poisson平滑、异方差回归和ETTh小时预测任务中优于VMP。当进入非共轭因子的边缘不确定性消失时，NGMP与VMP一致；当不确定性持续存在时（如部分观测的潜在链或参数通过连续数据批次过滤），NGMP更准确。性能提升主要体现在不确定性校准方面。

Conclusion: NGMP通过保留接收分布族可表示的精确消息部分，而非对相邻信念下的因子进行平均，实现了更准确的不确定性校准。该方法为变分推断提供了一种新的局部消息传递规则，特别适用于边缘不确定性持续存在的场景。

Abstract: We show that the natural-gradient stationary condition of variational inference has an edge-local form on a Forney-style factor graph. We start from the Bethe free energy and constrain a selected edge marginal to an exponential family. At a stationary point, the natural parameter of that edge equals the sum of two projected messages, one from each incident factor. Each projected message is the natural-gradient projection of the exact belief-propagation log-message at the current receiving marginal, or equivalently, the gradient of its expectation in the so-called mean coordinates. We call the resulting scheme natural-gradient message passing (NGMP). The rule is local; each edge may carry its own exponential family, and the message a factor sends depends on the marginal that receives it. Compared with variational message passing, NGMP keeps the part of the exact message that the receiving family can represent instead of averaging the factor under the neighboring beliefs. The two coincide when the uncertainty on the edges entering a non-conjugate factor vanishes, and NGMP is more accurate when that uncertainty persists, for example, along a partially observed latent chain or when parameters are filtered through successive data batches. Experiments on Poisson smoothing, heteroskedastic regression, and hourly ETTh forecasting confirm this and show that the gain appears mainly in uncertainty calibration.

</details>


### [363] [ReliaGate: Reliability Routing for Low-Stakes Wearable Stress Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15951)
*Jaden Moon,Yu Wu,Arvind Pillai,Andrew Campbell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReliaGate框架，通过后处理门控机制决定是否输出可穿戴压力预测系统的原始标签，在保持标签不变的前提下降低输出错误率，解决了聚合准确率不足以反映个体信息获取不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在低风险的反思和总结场景中，可穿戴压力预测系统仅关注聚合准确率是不够的。因为系统可以通过"不输出"来降低整体错误率，但这会导致部分用户获得很少甚至没有任何信息。现有方法缺乏一个框架来平衡输出错误率、信息可用性以及不同用户间的公平性。

Method: 提出固定标签可靠性路由方法：首先由锁定的分类器输出预定义的压力/非压力标签，然后通过后处理门控（ReliaGate）决定是否输出该原始标签。ReliaGate整合置信度、信号质量/信任度、一致性、训练标准化的异常性以及训练拟合的几何线索，构建一个后处理的正确性评分。在四个可穿戴数据集上使用受试者不交叠的交叉验证、验证集选择路由策略以及成对保留受试者区间进行评估。

Result: 在WESAD数据集上，ReliaGate的点估计结果表现更优；在UBFC-Phys数据集上，主要的覆盖率和风险区间指标支持ReliaGate；在E4数据集的检查中结果呈现混合表现。整体而言，ReliaGate在不修改标签的前提下，有效平衡了输出错误率和信息可用性。

Conclusion: ReliaGate提供了一个可操作的分析框架，用于研究输出标签错误、输出可用性以及跨受试者的接受输出分布，无需修改标签或提供临床及有限样本的风险保证。该框架为低风险场景下的可穿戴压力预测系统提供了一种实用的可靠性控制方法。

Abstract: We study when a wearable stress system should surface a prediction rather than change it. In low-stakes reflection and summary settings, aggregate accuracy is insufficient because withholding can reduce error while leaving some people with little or no information. We formulate fixed-label reliability routing: after a locked classifier emits a protocol-defined stress/non-stress label, a post-hoc gate surfaces that unchanged label or withholds it as unavailable. ReliaGate assembles established confidence, signal-quality/trust, agreement, train-standardized atypicality, and train-fitted geometry cues into a post-hoc correctness score. We evaluate four wearable datasets using subject-disjoint folds, validation-selected routing, paired held-out-subject intervals, and pooled and per-subject analyses. WESAD point estimates favored ReliaGate, UBFC-Phys primary coverage/risk intervals favored ReliaGate, and E4 checks were mixed. ReliaGate provides an operational framework for studying surfaced-label error, output availability, and accepted-output distribution across subjects, without revising labels or providing clinical or finite-sample risk guarantees.

</details>


### [364] [Beat the Counter First: A Baseline for Temporal-Graph Anomaly Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15965)
*Omair Shafi Ahmed,Zohair Shafi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了SimpleCount，一个无参数拟合的流式图异常检测参考方法，仅从固定特征池中选择一个标量特征。实验表明SimpleCount在多个数据集上匹配或超过了复杂的SLADE模型，且计算速度快23-133倍。研究发现复杂架构的收益取决于数据集，建议所有方法都应与强单特征基准进行对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式边缘级图异常检测（GAD）领域的发展伴随着越来越复杂的架构，从count-min-sketch卡方检验到记忆增强注意力网络。然而，这些增加的复杂性所带来的经验性收益尚未得到系统性评估，缺乏对复杂性与性能收益之间关系的深入分析。

Method: 提出SimpleCount作为参考方法，该方法无需参数拟合，从固定的计数、新近度、首次出现指标和计数衍生变换特征池中为每个数据集选择一个标量特征。在五个公共数据集和一个合成数据集上，将SimpleCount与两个时序图检测器模型和一个拟合完整特征向量的IsoForest控制方法进行比较，采用配对统计检验和五种子SLADE评估。

Result: SimpleCount在六个数据集中的三个上匹配或超过了SLADE，在所有六个数据集上都超过了IsoForest。SLADE需要的计算时间是SimpleCount的23到133倍。在Synth-Triangle和Synth-Quad探针上，事件前结构评分能够恢复植入信号（AUC高达0.955），而所有评估的检测器模型表现接近随机。

Conclusion: 复杂性的收益依赖于数据集，每一个声称的增益都应该与一个强单特征参考方法一起报告其计算成本。研究强调了在图异常检测领域中建立简单而强大的基准方法的重要性，并建议未来工作应更系统地评估复杂架构的实际价值。

Abstract: Progress in streaming, edge-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) has been marked by increasingly elaborate architectures, from count-min-sketch chi square tests to memory-augmented attention networks. Yet the empirical gains attributable to this added complexity have not been systematically evaluated. We propose SimpleCount, a reference with no parameter fitting that selects one scalar feature per dataset from a fixed pool of counts, recencies, first-occurrence indicators, and count-derived transforms. We compare SimpleCount with two temporal-graph detector models and an IsoForest control fitted to the complete feature vector across five public datasets and one synthetic dataset. SimpleCount matches or exceeds SLADE on three of six datasets and exceeds IsoForest on all six. We report paired statistical tests and five-seed SLADE evaluations. SLADE requires 23 to 133x more wall-clock time than SimpleCount. On Synth-Triangle and an additional Synth-Quad probe, pre-event structural scores recover the planted signal at AUC up to 0.955, while all evaluated detector models remain near random. The benefit of complexity is dataset-dependent, and every claimed gain should be reported against a strong one-feature reference together with its compute cost.

</details>


### [365] [A Banach-Space Theory of Markovian Halpern Iteration for Non-Expansive Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15966)
*Ege C. Kaya,Arda Fazla,M. Berk Sahin,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对马尔可夫轨迹下的非扩张算子不动点问题，提出了方差缩减的PAGE-Halpern方法，将样本复杂度从O(ε^{-5})降低到O(ε^{-3})，并推广到有限维Banach空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究非扩张算子不动点的随机逼近问题，当样本来自连续马尔可夫轨迹时，直接块小批量Halpern迭代虽然达到O(log N/N)的期望最后迭代残差，但需要Õ(ε^{-5})的马尔可夫样本复杂度，计算代价高昂。

Method: 提出方差缩减的马尔可夫PAGE-Halpern方法，通过Poisson方程分析刷新和同态差分块；将Hilbert空间中的构造推广到一般有限维Banach空间，用位移级Halpern界替代Hilbert空间势能，通过范数平滑处理非光滑sup和块sup几何结构。

Result: 在Hilbert空间中利用I-T的余强制性获得O(ε^{-3})样本复杂度；在一般有限维Banach空间中同样达到Õ(ε^{-3})样本复杂度（以原始非扩张范数度量）；建立了具有相同主导精度依赖的高概率保证（以辅助光滑范数度量估计器）。

Conclusion: 成功将方差缩减技术应用于马尔可夫采样框架下的Halpern迭代，显著降低了样本复杂度，并将理论从Hilbert空间推广到Banach空间，为非扩张算子不动点问题提供了高效的随机逼近算法。

Abstract: We study stochastic approximation of fixed points of a non-expansive operator when the oracle samples originate from a continuing Markovian trajectory. A direct block-minibatch implementation of Halpern iteration attains an expected last-iterate residual of order $O(\log N/N)$, but accrues a substantive complexity of $\tilde O(ε^{-5})$ Markovian samples. We therefore introduce a variance-reduced Markovian PAGE-Halpern method whose refresh and same-state difference blocks are analyzed through the Poisson equation. In Hilbert spaces, the cocoercivity of $I-T$ results in an $O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity. Our main result extends this construction to a general finite-dimensional Banach space. A displacement-level Halpern bound replaces the Hilbert-space potential and yields $\tilde O(ε^{-3})$ sample complexity in the original non-expansiveness norm. We also establish a high-probability guarantee with the same leading accuracy dependence by measuring the estimator in an auxiliary smooth norm. Non-smooth sup and block-sup geometries are covered through norm smoothing.

</details>


### [366] [The Limits of Binding in Dual Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15971)
*Kin Ian Lo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从数学角度系统分析了CLIP等双编码器模型在属性绑定任务上的失败原因，证明了深度、目标和几何结构三个层面的理论限制，并通过实验验证了这些限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP等双编码器模型通过单一内积评分图像-文本对，在属性绑定任务上表现接近随机水平（如无法区分"红色汽车和蓝色狗"与"蓝色汽车和红色狗"）。本文旨在从数学角度解释这种失败何时是必然的，何时是偶然的。

Method: 在Kang等人提出的理想编码器框架下工作，首先证明了相关公理的可满足性，然后通过三个维度证明不可能性定理：1）深度：推导递归角色绑定码的交换边际精确定律m(D)=2b^{-D}；2）目标：提出架构无关的节流定理，分析对比目标的绑定奖励；3）几何：建立平滑性-绑定的紧密边界。通过18个部署文本编码器的文本诊断实验验证理论。

Result: 深度方面，可解析深度随维度仅呈对数增长，在CLIP规模下为个位数；目标方面，对比目标的绑定奖励被训练时对比其自身交换的速率限制，该速率在网页规模下趋近于零；几何方面，交换相关字幕嵌入到共享释义锚点的距离与绑定边际存在精确常数关系。实验显示所有模型仅达到其上限的25-35%，诱导的上限与SugarCrepe难度相关性达r=0.99。

Conclusion: 已部署双编码器的绑定失败并非源于维度或平滑性限制，而是激励和码结构限制，并存在一个已证明的深度上限，即使修复这些问题后该上限仍然存在。

Abstract: Dual-encoder models such as CLIP score an image-caption pair by a single inner product of two independently computed unit vectors, and fail at binding, often scoring near chance when asked to distinguish "a red car and a blue dog" from "a blue car and a red dog". We give a mathematical account of when this failure is necessary and when it is contingent. Working within the ideal-encoder framework proposed by Kang et al., we first show the relevant axioms are satisfiable, so every impossibility must enter through an added, checkable hypothesis. We then prove three such obstructions. Depth: for recursive role-binding codes the swap margin obeys an exact law $m(D) = 2b^{-D}$ in the nesting depth D, with a finite-dimension version holding up to one explicitly flagged concentration estimate; the resolvable depth grows only logarithmically in the dimension and is single-digit at CLIP scale, the nesting depth of ordinary language. Objective: architecture-free throttle theorems showing that the contrastive objective's entire reward for binding is bounded by the rate at which training contrasts a caption against its own swap, a rate that vanishes at web scale, and that exactly reversed binding costs only that rate times the mean binding margin; both are verified in simulation. Geometry: a tight smoothness-binding frontier: the closer the two swap-related captions must embed to a shared paraphrase anchor, the smaller the binding margin can be, with an exact constant. Measuring its text-only diagnostic across 18 deployed text encoders, every model sits at roughly 25-35% of its ceiling, and the induced per-item ceiling tracks SugarCrepe's subset difficulty at r = 0.99. Binding failure in deployed dual encoders is thus not a dimension or smoothness limit today, but an incentive and code-structure limit, with a proved depth ceiling that remains once those are fixed.

</details>


### [367] [Fiber Fingerprints of Hidden Learning-State Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15976)
*Qinyou Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了学习系统的当前行为不能完全预测其未来学习能力，通过形式化“纤维指纹”概念并实验验证了隐藏状态维度的存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习系统可能存在于某些执行状态，这些状态在所有当前行为观测下不可区分，但对未来训练的响应却不同。这表明当前行为可能不是未来学习能力的充分统计量，需要建立形式化框架来刻画这种隐藏的差异性。

Method: 1) 引入纤维指纹概念，形式化未来学习响应律在当前行为等价类上的约束；2) 构建预测性商函子和Nerode型最小递归充分表示；3) 在有限维Hilbert实现下分解响应为可见、可见模式复用和不可约新扇区；4) 提出条件机制结果，识别图-Hodge年代分解和精确Adam矩截面；5) 在冻结Transformer-LoRA-AdamW设置下对Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B-v0.3进行实证研究。

Result: 实验支持局部作用骨架、更长远视野的首次返回非闭包性质，以及带有输出范围复用和低秩不可约扇区的新可见相对完成。预注册的负面或混合结果限定了更强主张：重锚定传输在测量地板以上未解决；严格的有限网格Hodge-3/2联合未达成；Qwen在冻结原始矩图表中的可访问性未建立；Mistral的揭示依赖于未来上下文而非库不变量。

Conclusion: 在支持、尺度、度量和上下文分辨的边界内，当前行为不是已声明未来学习的充分统计量。这揭示了学习系统存在隐藏的结构复杂性，需要超越可观测行为来理解其学习动力学。

Abstract: A learning system can occupy execution states that are indistinguishable under every declared present-behavior readout yet respond differently to future training. We formalize this through fiber fingerprints: controlled future-learning response laws restricted to present-behavior equivalence classes. Prefix-compatible finite probes induce a predictive quotient functor, a Nerode-type minimal recursively sufficient representation, and a canonical set-level predictive fiber without assuming smoothness, reversibility, finite rank, or a manifold. Under an explicit finite-dimensional Hilbert realization, response decomposes into visible, visible-mode-reuse, and irreducible-new sectors; a history-reachability bridge retains only distinctions generated by natural training histories. Conditional mechanism results then identify a graph-Hodge chronology decomposition, a regular switching class with root-mean-square scale $\sqrt{p}η^{3/2}$ and finite-scale corrections, and an exact Adam moment section whose immediate adaptive field is constant while common future gradients can reveal hidden moment differences. Frozen Transformer--LoRA--AdamW studies with Qwen2.5-7B and Mistral-7B-v0.3 support a local action backbone, longer-horizon first-return non-closure, and fresh visible-relative completion with output-range reuse and a low-rank irreducible sector. Stronger claims remain bounded by preregistered negative or mixed results: re-anchored transport is unresolved above its measurement floor; the strict finite-grid Hodge--$3/2$ conjunction is unmet despite prospective contraction; Qwen accessibility is not established in the frozen raw moment chart; and Mistral revelation is future-context dependent rather than bank invariant. Within these support-, scale-, metric-, and context-resolved boundaries, present behavior is not a sufficient statistic for declared future learning.

</details>


### [368] [Operator-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Multitask Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15982)
*Mahdi Mohammadigohari,Thomas Borsani,Giuseppe Di Fatta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于向量值再生核Hilbert空间上的Koopman复合算子表示，为深度多输出函数类建立了算子理论泛化界，分别在向量值Sobolev RKHS和Brownian RKHS框架下推导了Rademacher复杂度界，并研究了跨任务的共享算子学习问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习的泛化理论对于理解神经网络的性能至关重要。现有研究主要关注单输出网络，而多输出网络在多任务学习、算子学习等场景中更为常见。本文旨在为多输出深度网络建立系统的泛化界分析框架，通过算子理论方法揭示网络结构与泛化能力之间的关系。

Method: 1. 将网络层表示为向量值RKHS上的Koopman复合算子；2. 在向量值Sobolev RKHS框架下，为可逆和宽度扩展的内射架构推导Rademacher复杂度界；3. 在Brownian/Cameron-Martin框架下，利用锚定导数范数刻画推导层复杂度界；4. 建立跨任务共享算子学习的有限秩表示定理和目标迁移界。

Result: 1. Sobolev框架下的界将输出耦合贡献（任务矩阵的迹）与层算子范数、Sobolev符号比、行列式因子和限制常数分离；2. Brownian框架下的界因子分别以|W_l|^{1/2}和‖σ_l'‖_∞^{1/2}尺度增长，不涉及Sobolev平滑指数；3. 证明了共享算子学习的有限秩表示定理，给出了平方损失的精确有限维问题形式；4. 在合成数据和MNIST上验证了Sobolev启发和Brownian启发的复杂度代理。

Conclusion: 本文为多输出深度网络建立了统一的算子理论泛化分析框架，Sobolev和Brownian两种机制各有适用范围，不存在一致的支配关系。理论结果为理解多任务学习中的泛化行为提供了新视角，实验验证表明所提复杂度代理能够稳定捕捉网络结构的泛化特性。

Abstract: We develop operator-theoretic generalization bounds for deep multi-output function classes by representing network layers as Koopman composition operators on vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. In vector-valued Sobolev RKHSs, we derive Rademacher complexity bounds for invertible and width-expanding injective architectures. The estimates separate the output-coupling contribution, represented by the trace of the task matrix, from the layerwise operator norms, Sobolev symbol ratios, determinant factors, and restriction constants generated by the linear maps. We then analyze a distinct one-dimensional Brownian/Cameron--Martin regime. Using the exact anchored derivative-norm characterization of the vector-valued Brownian RKHS, we obtain layerwise bounds for domain-preserving scalar linear maps and anchored diffeomorphic activations; the corresponding factors scale as $|W_l|^{1/2}$ and $\|σ_l'\|_\infty^{1/2}$, respectively, and do not involve Sobolev smoothness exponents. Because the Sobolev and Brownian results concern different hypothesis spaces, neither is asserted to dominate the other uniformly. We additionally formulate shared operator learning across tasks, prove a finite-rank representer theorem, derive the exact finite-dimensional problem for squared loss, and establish a target-transfer bound when the learned operator is obtained independently of the target sample. Synthetic and MNIST studies examine stabilized Sobolev-inspired and Brownian-inspired complexity proxies; these empirical proxies are not evaluations of the proved bounds for rank-deficient architectures.

</details>


### [369] [Toward Optimal Second-Order Path-Length Guarantee for Adversarial Multi-Armed Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15996)
*Mengxiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了对抗性K臂老虎机中二阶路径长度遗憾的开放性问题，证明了Bubeck等人(2019)的算法在已知Q_{\infty,2}时可达到接近最优的遗憾界，并通过自适应重启机制消除了对Q_{\infty,2}的先验知识需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bubeck等人[2019]在对抗性K臂老虎机中设计了一阶路径长度遗憾为\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})的算法，但留下了二阶路径长度遗憾能否达到\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})的开放问题，本研究旨在解决这一理论缺口。

Method: 1. 对Bubeck等人[2019]的原有算法进行更深入的分析，在Q_{\infty,2}已知的情况下证明其可达到\mathcal{O}(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)(1+Q_{\infty,2})})的期望遗憾；2. 设计具有一致有界增量的路径长度估计器，结合自适应重启机制消除对Q_{\infty,2}的先验知识需求。

Result: 1. 证明了Bubeck等人(2019)的算法在Q_{\infty,2}已知时达到\mathcal{O}(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)(1+Q_{\infty,2})})的期望遗憾，在对数因子和加性项意义下匹配Ω(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})下界；2. 提出的自适应重启算法成功消除了对Q_{\infty,2}的先验知识需求。

Conclusion: 本研究填补了二阶路径长度遗憾的理论空白，证明了与下界近乎最优匹配的遗憾界是可实现的，并通过自适应重启机制实现了无需先验知识的实用算法，为自适应在线学习提供了新的理论保证。

Abstract: We study second-order path-length regret in adversarial $K$-armed bandits against oblivious loss sequences. Bubeck et al. [2019] designed an algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K+\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,1}})$ regret, where $Q_{\infty,1}$ is the first-order path length, and left open whether $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\text{poly}(K)\sqrt{1+Q_{\infty,2}})$ regret is achievable under bandit feedback, where $Q_{\infty,2}$ is the second-order path length. Somewhat surprisingly, we resolve this question positively by showing that with a more involved analysis, the exact same algorithm of Bubeck et al. [2019] achieves $\mathcal{O}\left(K\log(KT)+\sqrt{K\log(KT)\bigl(1+Q_{\infty,2}\bigr)}\right)$ expected regret when $Q_{\infty,2}$ is known, where $T$ is the horizon. This matches the $Ω(\sqrt{KQ_{\infty,2}})$ lower bound up to logarithmic factors and additive terms. We further remove the knowledge of $Q_{\infty,2}$ using an adaptive restart scheme whose path-length estimator has uniformly bounded increments.

</details>


### [370] [Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast for Molecule-Text Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16005)
*Shunshun Gu,Shengqi Qiu,Hang Zhou,Xiao Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出RISEN方法，通过检索引导的孪生融合和相似度感知对比学习来改进分子-文本对齐，在分子搜索和属性预测等下游任务上取得更好效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子-文本对齐方法通常忽略子结构与文本之间的细粒度语义关系，仅结合图结构挖掘与对比学习，导致下游任务性能次优。

Method: 提出RISEN方法：(1)为每个子结构构建潜在孪生分子，通过跨模态检索获取相关文本描述和共享相似子结构描述的分子；(2)使用注意力池化聚合表示，得到孪生潜在表示并与原始子结构融合；(3)测量子结构与文本的相似度，通过软阈值引导跨模态对比学习。

Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验验证了RISEN相比现有基线方法的优越性。

Conclusion: RISEN方法通过引入细粒度语义关系建模，有效提升了分子-文本对齐的性能，为分子搜索和属性预测等下游任务提供了更好的联合表示。

Abstract: This paper studies the problem of molecule-text alignment, which aims to project molecules and their textual descriptions into a joint latent space for downstream tasks including molecule search and molecular property prediction. Previous approaches typically combine graph structure mining with contrastive learning to enhance joint representation learning. However, they typically neglect fine-grained semantic relationships between substructures and texts, leading to suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Retrieval-guided Twin Fusion with Similarity-aware Contrast (RISEN) for molecule-text alignment. The core idea of RISEN is to construct a latent twin molecule for each substructure with cross-modal retrieval for semantic enhancement. In particular, for each substructure query, we retrieve relevant textual descriptions and sample several molecules that share similar descriptions of substructures. Then, we aggregate their representations via attention pooling for a twin latent representation, which would be further fused with the original substructure for representation enrichment. In addition, we measure the similarity across substructures and texts, which would further guide cross-modal contrastive learning with soft thresholding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the superiority of the proposed RISEN in comparison with existing baselines.

</details>


### [371] [Breaking the Compression Barrier: Cross-Architecture Compression Boundary Learning via Reverse Regrowth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16010)
*Zhaocen Liu,Satvik Praveen,Yi Sheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了BRIDGE框架，通过逆向再生方式解决模型压缩中的性能崩溃问题，能够在极稀疏状态下恢复关键结构，将压缩极限提升4.77%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有剪枝方法在超过稀疏度阈值后会发生性能突然崩溃，难以确定模型的可行压缩极限，这限制了在资源受限边缘设备上的部署效果。

Method: 提出边界学习逆向再生框架（BRIDGE），将压缩问题重构为建设性边界搜索问题。该方法首先将模型驱动至极稀疏状态以暴露崩溃区域，然后通过分层再生策略（粗粒度层选择和细粒度再生参数选择）有选择地再生关键结构以恢复性能。

Result: 在CNN和Transformer架构上均能将模型从崩溃边缘恢复，证明了架构无关性。在非结构化剪枝中性能提升达1.49%，在结构化剪枝中性能提升达4.77%。

Conclusion: 逆向再生方法能够有效扩展压缩极限并保持稳定性能，为模型压缩提供了新的思路，突破了传统前向剪枝方法的性能崩溃瓶颈。

Abstract: Model compression is critical for deploying networks on resource-constrained edge devices. While pruning-based methods can significantly reduce model size, they often suffer from abrupt performance collapse beyond a sparsity thresh-old, making it difficult to identify the feasible compression limit of the model. To address this challenge, we propose a boundary-Learning reverse regrowth framework, BRIDGE, that reformulates compression as a constructive boundary-search problem. Unlike forward pruning, our method first drives the model to an extremely sparse state to expose the collapse region, and then selectively regenerates the critical structure to restore performance. The proposed framework employs a hierarchical regeneration strategy, including coarse-grained layer selection and fine-grained regeneration parameter selection, to accurately identify which parameters require recovery. Experiments show that our method can recover models from the brink of collapse on both CNNs and Transformer architectures, demonstrating its architecture in-dependence. BRIDGE achieves a performance improvement of up to 1.49% in unstructured pruning and up to 4.77% in structured pruning. These results demonstrate that reverse regeneration can effectively extend the compression limit while maintaining stable performance. The source code is available at https://github.com/EnumaCaliber/BRIDGE.

</details>


### [372] [RagGAD: Rationale-Aware Conditional Gaussian Mixture Normalizing Flow for Unsupervised Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16018)
*Junxin Lu,Jing Zhao,Shiliang Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RagGAD框架，通过解耦稳定与虚假关联并利用条件高斯混合归一化流建模，解决了现有图异常检测方法对同质性假设的依赖问题，显著提升了检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图异常检测方法过度依赖同质性假设，难以区分虚假亲和性且无法捕捉正常节点的多样化行为，导致在复杂现实场景中鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出RagGAD无监督框架，包含：1) 自适应理由解耦器，从节点关系中分离稳定理由与虚假关联，并将稳定理由分解为鲁棒与脆弱成分；2) 理由-非理由高斯混合建模与鲁棒-脆弱理由混合学习策略，构建结构感知的分布空间。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，RagGAD显著优于现有最先进方法，有效识别出与不稳定或虚假关联相关的异常节点。

Conclusion: 通过缓解虚假同质性关联并接纳正常模式的异质性，RagGAD成功将异常识别为结构感知分布空间中的低密度区域，为复杂图场景下的异常检测提供了新思路。

Abstract: Graph anomaly detection aims to identify nodes that deviate from normal behavioral patterns within graphs. However, existing methods largely rely on the homophily assumption, which makes it difficult to distinguish spurious affinities and to capture the diverse behaviors of normal nodes,limiting their robustness in complex real-world scenarios. To address this problem, we propose RagGAD, an unsupervised graph anomaly detection framework based on rationale-aware conditional Gaussian mixture normalizing flow. RagGAD introduces an adaptive rationale disentangler to disentangle stable rationales from spurious correlations within node interrelationships, and further decomposes stable rationales into robust and fragile components. The learned rationales capture underlying interaction patterns that characterize normal behaviors under varying conditions, while anomalies emerge as deviations associated with unstable or spurious correlations. To model the intricate distributions of normal and abnormal nodes, RagGAD integrates rationale-non-rationale Gaussian mixture modeling with a robust-fragile rationale mixture learning strategy. By mitigating spurious homophilic correlations and embracing the heterogeneity of normal patterns, RagGAD identifies anomalies as low-density regions within a structure-aware distribution space. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that RagGAD outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [373] [Group ICA 2.0: Closing the Gap Between Subjects and Group Latent Decomposition with Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16029)
*Oktay Agcaoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了CoLiG-ICA算法，通过联合估计模板链接、队列特异性和个体特异性的脑网络，解决了传统组ICA无法捕捉个体差异的问题，在精神分裂症研究中发现了额外的脑网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的组独立成分分析（gICA）主要识别跨被试共享的成分，这一组层面假设限制了对个体或部分被试特有网络的恢复能力，降低了对临床神经影像数据中被试间异质性的敏感性。

Method: 提出Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA)算法，属于Group ICA 2.0框架。该方法联合估计模板链接、队列特异性和个体特异性的脑网络，结合了基于ICA的空间分解、基于Copula的依赖建模和深度学习优化技术。

Result: 在UCLA-CNP静息态fMRI数据上的评估显示：相比传统约束ICA，CoLiG-ICA在估计模板链接成分、发现额外自由成分、提高成分独立性方面表现更好；相比MOO-ICAR，显著降低了成分间空间依赖性和运动相关方差；在精神分裂症组分析中，额外识别出三个静息态网络（一个感觉运动网络和两个视觉网络）。

Conclusion: CoLiG-ICA成功解决了传统gICA在捕捉个体差异方面的局限性，能够有效识别被试间异质性，为临床神经影像研究提供了更敏感的分析工具。

Abstract: Group Independent Component Analysis (gICA) is widely used to decompose high-dimensional functional MRI data into interpretable brain networks. However, conventional gICA primarily identifies components shared across subjects. This group-level assumption can limit the recovery of networks present only in individuals or subject subsets, reducing sensitivity to intersubject heterogeneity in clinical neuroimaging datasets. We introduce Copula-Linked Group ICA (CoLiG-ICA), an algorithm in the Group ICA 2.0 framework that jointly estimates template-linked, cohort-only, and subject-only brain networks within a unified model. CoLiG-ICA combines ICA-based spatial decomposition, copula-based dependence modeling, and deep learning optimization to preserve the consistency and interpretability of template-constrained ICA while enabling free components beyond the reference networks. By linking subject decompositions to shared templates and jointly estimating cohort-only and subject-only sources, CoLiG-ICA represents individual variability not captured by conventional group priors. We evaluate CoLiG-ICA using resting-state fMRI data from the UCLA-CNP dataset and compare it with conventional constrained ICA in estimating template-linked components, discovering additional free components, improving component independence, and capturing subject-level variability beyond the shared group prior. Compared with MOO-ICAR, CoLiG-ICA showed significantly lower intercomponent spatial dependence, indicating improved subject-level component independence, and significantly reduced motion-related variance in the template-linked components. Additionally, in a schizophrenia-only group analysis, CoLiG-ICA identified three additional resting-state networks beyond the 53 template-linked NeuroMark components: one sensorimotor and two visual networks.

</details>


### [374] [AdROD: HyperNetwork-based Adversarially Robust Object Detection for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16031)
*Yuting Wu,Dongfang Guo,Xiangzhong Luo,Qun Song,Rui Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AdROD，一种用于自动驾驶的嵌入式随机集成防御系统，通过低秩超网络生成多样化检测器来抵御物理对抗攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于相机的物体检测器容易受到物理对抗攻击，而对抗训练和输入净化方法往往对特定攻击分布过拟合，在面对自适应对手时失效。需要一种能够提供持续保护、不易被攻击者获取具体检测器、且具有良好泛化能力的防御机制。

Method: 采用低秩超网络（仅需标准超网络1.6%的参数）以每帧速率生成多样化检测器；引入功能性多样性机制，将随机权重更新与独特的输入空间变换相结合；设计两种服务模式：AdROD-I（连续保护模式，利用检测器间分歧恢复被破坏的检测）和AdROD-II（按需模式，由目标跟踪中的运动不连续性触发）。

Result: 在合成基准测试、物理部署的对抗补丁以及OpenCDA协同仿真器的端到端安全测试中，AdROD优于五种基线防御方法；相比评估的对抗训练基线展现出更优的泛化能力；在装备对抗补丁的停车标志处能够保持实时性能，安全停车。

Conclusion: AdROD成功实现了对物理对抗攻击的有效防御，通过低秩超网络和功能性多样性机制在保持实时性能的同时提供了卓越的鲁棒性和泛化能力，为自动驾驶系统提供了一种实用的嵌入式防御解决方案。

Abstract: Camera-based object detectors are vulnerable to physical adversarial attacks designed to suppress detections. While adversarial training and input purification offer some protection, they often overfit to specific attack distributions and fail on adaptive adversaries. This paper presents AdROD, an embedded, stochastic ensemble defense software designed for autonomous driving. AdROD employs {\em low-rank HyperNetworks}, which require only 1.6\% of the parameter footprint of standard HyperNetworks, to generate diverse detectors at a per-frame rate, making it impractical for attackers to obtain the deployed detectors in time. To further improve adversarial robustness, AdROD incorporates a novel \emph{functional diversity} mechanism, which couples stochastic weight updates with unique input-space transformations. We design two serving modes of AdROD that strike different trade-offs between robustness and runtime overhead: AdROD-I, a continuous protection mode for maximum resilience that leverages inter-detector disagreement to recover compromised detections, and AdROD-II, an on-demand mode triggered by kinematic discontinuities in object tracking. Through comprehensive evaluation with synthetic benchmarks, physically deployed adversarial patches, and end-to-end safety tests in the OpenCDA co-simulator, AdROD outperforms five baseline defenses and exhibits superior generalizability compared with the evaluated adversarial-training baselines, while maintaining real-time performance for safely stopping the vehicle at a stop sign instrumented with adversarial patches.

</details>


### [375] [NICE: Scale-Stable Perturbations for Graph Neural Network Explanations via Noise Corruption](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16038)
*Ziluowen Luo,Jun Yin,Ruochen Liu,Ming Cheng,Shirui Pan,Chengqi Zhang,Senzhang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了现有GNN解释器中元素掩码(EM)引起的"尺度漂移"问题，提出了基于噪声腐蚀(NC)的解释框架NICE，通过保持消息范数的扰动机制提升解释可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验GNN解释器采用的扰动-查询范式存在分布偏移问题，广泛使用的元素掩码(EM)会确定性压缩消息传递尺度，导致预测变化混淆了信息损坏与传播尺度偏差，影响解释可靠性。

Method: 提出噪声腐蚀(NC)替代EM，通过匹配范数的随机方向扰动保持期望消息范数；构建NICE框架学习随机恢复边界(SRB)平衡目标预测恢复与紧凑性；设计边界积分梯度(BIG)将边界转换为边归因。

Result: 实验表明NICE在多个基准数据集上实现了更强的解释性能和模型忠实度；验证了NC显著减少了掩码引起的尺度漂移现象。

Conclusion: 通过重新审视扰动机制本身，本文提出的尺度稳定扰动方法NC有效解决了EM的尺度漂移问题，为GNN解释提供了更可靠的框架，提升了解释质量与模型一致性。

Abstract: Post-hoc Graph Neural Network (GNN) explainers commonly follow a Perturb-Query paradigm, inferring the importance of graph elements based on queried predictions to perturbed inputs. However, such perturbations often introduce substantial distribution shift, undermining the reliability of the queried predictions used to derive explanations. While existing efforts mainly improve perturbed graphs or stabilize model predictions on them, we revisit the perturbation mechanism itself. We show that the widely used Element-wise Masking(EM) suppresses edge-induced messages toward zero, causing deterministic scale contraction that accumulates across message-passing layers, a phenomenon we term Scale Drift. Consequently, prediction changes under EM may conflate information corruption with deviations in propagation scale. As a scale-stable alternative to EM, we introduce Noise Corruption (NC), which perturbs each message through matched-norm random-direction corruption while preserving the expected squared message norm. Building on NC, we propose NICE, a Noise Corruption-based explanation framework, which learns a Stochastic Restoration Boundary (SRB) under NC-induced uncertainty, balancing target-prediction restoration against compactness. Furthermore, Boundary-Integrated Gradient (BIG) converts this boundary into edge attributions by accumulating each edge's contribution to reducing restoration risk along the restoration path. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate stronger explanation performance and model faithfulness while confirming that NC substantially reduces the Scale Drift induced by masking.

</details>


### [376] [OceanLight: Efficient Global Ocean Forecasting via Geometry-Adaptive Unstructured Mesh Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16070)
*Wei Wu,Xiang Wang,Hongze Leng,Qingye Min,Junxing Zhu,Junqiang Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OceanLight是一种基于非结构化网格和图神经网络的高效全球海洋预测框架，在提升预测精度的同时显著降低了计算资源消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理海洋预测模型计算成本过高，而现有深度学习方法依赖结构化网格架构，导致对陆地掩膜区域进行不必要的计算，且无法根据局部流动复杂性自适应调整分辨率。

Method: 提出OceanLight框架，创新性地结合几何自适应非结构化网格标记化技术与图神经网络（GNN）骨干网络，实现对动态异构海洋区域的自适应分辨率处理。

Result: 模型在点对点预测精度和动能谱保真度上超越业务化数值分析和最先进AI模型，在地转平衡一致性方面优于所有AI海洋模型，同时GPU内存消耗减少62%，浮点运算量减少70%，并可靠地表示中尺度涡旋结构。

Conclusion: 非结构化网格表示为可扩展的数据驱动海洋学建立了可推广的范式，实现了计算效率与预测性能的有效平衡。

Abstract: Reliable global ocean forecasting is critical for climate monitoring, marine navigation, and extreme event early warning. Physics-based ocean forecasting models impose prohibitive computational costs, while existing deep learning approaches predominantly rely on structured-grid architectures, incurring unnecessary computation on masked land cells and enforcing uniform resolution across dynamically heterogeneous ocean regions regardless of local flow complexity. Here we present OceanLight, an efficient global ocean forecasting framework innovatively combining geometry-adaptive unstructured mesh tokenization with a graph neural network (GNN) backbone. OceanLight achieves pointwise forecast accuracy and kinetic energy spectral fidelity exceeding both operational numerical analyses and state-of-the-art AI-based models, while surpassing all AI-based ocean models in geostrophic balance consistency. Furthermore, OceanLight demonstrates reliable mesoscale eddy representation, capturing coherent ocean structures beyond pointwise statistical optimization. These capabilities are delivered with a 62% reduction in GPU memory consumption and 70\% reduction in FLOPs relative to structured-grid baselines. Our unstructured mesh representation establishes a generalizable paradigm for scalable data-driven oceanography.

</details>


### [377] [Learn What's Left, Not What's Mastered: Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16072)
*Yixuan Wang,Yifei Chen,Haichao Zhang,Haozheng Luo,Xander Wu,Jie Ni,Yun Fu,Nuno Vasconcelos,Yijiang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SA-MRPO方法，通过独立标准化各奖励目标并根据饱和度自适应调整权重，解决了多目标强化学习中的梯度分配问题，在数学推理、自适应推理和编程任务上均取得性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于群组相对优势的多目标强化学习方法存在两个根本问题：(1) 不同奖励配置的轨迹可能获得相同的优势值；(2) 所有目标以固定相对权重进行优化，导致已解决的目标仍占用梯度预算，而优化空间大的目标得不到足够关注。

Method: 提出饱和度感知优势重加权方法（SA-MRPO）：(1) 对每个奖励目标独立进行标准化；(2) 根据批次级别的目标饱和度估计自适应地折扣各目标的贡献，动态地将优化努力重新分配给欠优化目标。理论证明饱和度感知重加权可改变更新方向而非仅缩放幅度。

Result: 在数学推理的15个基准比较中，12个提高了较难的正确性目标，在AIME24上提升高达5%；在自适应推理的5个基准上平均提升3.8%，AMC23上最高提升9.2%；在编程基准上通过率提升最高2.3%；同时在所有设置中维持较易目标在已满足水平。

Conclusion: SA-MRPO通过独立标准化和饱和度感知的动态重加权机制，有效解决了多目标强化学习中的梯度分配效率问题，实现了对欠优化目标的聚焦，同时保持已满足目标的性能，为语言模型推理器的后训练提供了更优的多目标优化框架。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with group-relative advantages has become the de facto standard for post-training language model reasoners. However, when optimizing multiple reward objectives, existing methods typically scalarize the reward vector with a fixed weighted sum before group-wise standardization. We show that this design leads to two fundamental problems: rollouts with distinct reward profiles can receive identical advantages, and all objectives are optimized with fixed relative weights regardless of their current level of saturation. As a result, training continues to allocate gradient budget to already-solved objectives instead of focusing on those with greater remaining headroom. We introduce \textbf{Saturation Aware Advantage Reweighting for Multi-Reward Policy Optimization} (SA-MRPO), which standardizes each reward objective independently and adaptively discounts its contribution according to a batch-level estimate of objective saturation. This dynamically reallocates optimization effort toward under-optimized objectives while empirically maintaining performance on those that are already well satisfied. We further show that saturation-aware reweighting can reverse the sign of an update, rather than merely rescale its magnitude. Across mathematical reasoning with two- and three-objective reward combinations, SA-MRPO improves the harder correctness objective over GDPO in 12 of 15 benchmark comparisons, with gains of up to $5\%$ on AIME24. On adaptive reasoning it improves accuracy on all five benchmarks, by $3.8\%$ on average and up to $9.2 \%$ on AMC23, and on coding benchmarks it improves pass rate by up to $2.3\%$, while in all settings maintaining the easier objectives near their already satisfied levels.

</details>


### [378] [DeepOHeat-v2: Self-Improving Operator Learning for Fast and Trustworthy Thermal Optimization in 3D-IC Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16080)
*Xinling Yu,Yixing Li,Ziyue Liu,Xin Ai,Zhiyu Zeng,Hai Li,Zheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DeepOHeat-v2，通过改进物理损失函数和自改进框架，解决了高对比度多裸芯3D集成电路热优化的挑战，实现56倍加速且精度接近精确求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的DeepOHeat-v1算子学习代理模型仅适用于低对比度几何结构，在高对比度多裸芯堆叠中存在两个关键问题：(1)材料界面处的非连续导热系数导致连续物理损失函数在材料界面处定义不清；(2)离散化强形式损失的条件数过大(κ₂(Aₕ)≈6×10⁴)，超出一阶优化的能力范围，导致预测误差超过30K。

Method: 提出两项关键改进：(1)采用离散化物理损失函数处理材料界面的非连续性，其能量形式将预测空间损失Hessian的条件数从κ²降至κ，并结合矩阵预条件优化器；(2)设计自改进框架，包含热点信任门机制，将标记的布局发送给参考求解器，代理模型在改进解上增量重训练，仅在验证误差改善时保留更新。

Result: 在多裸芯基准测试中，平均峰值温度误差从超过30K降至0.55K；代理模型与真实峰值温度差距从1.12K降至0.11K，匹配每步求解的优化器精度，同时运行速度提升56倍。

Conclusion: DeepOHeat-v2成功解决了高对比度多裸芯3D集成电路热优化中的关键挑战，通过能量形式损失函数和自改进框架实现了高精度、高效率的热感知优化，为复杂3D集成电路设计提供了可靠的快速求解方案。

Abstract: Thermal-aware optimization of multi-die 3D integrated circuits evaluates many designs, each a costly heat-equation solve. Operator-learning surrogates replace this solve with a fast forward pass, ideally trained from physics alone, without labeled data. DeepOHeat-v1 made such surrogates fast and trustworthy, but only on low-contrast geometries. High-contrast multi-die stacks break it in two ways: discontinuous conductivities make the continuous physics loss ill-defined at material interfaces, and ill-conditioning ($κ_2(A_h) \approx 6 \times 10^4$) puts the discretized strong-form loss beyond first-order optimization. We propose DeepOHeat-v2 to overcome both. First, we train on a discretized physics loss that handles the discontinuities natively; its energy form reduces the prediction-space loss-Hessian conditioning from $κ^2$ to $κ$, and a matrix-preconditioned optimizer cuts the mean peak temperature error from over 30 K to 0.55 K. Second, because optimization leaves the training distribution, we propose a self-improving framework: a hotspot trust gate sends flagged placements to a reference solver, and the surrogate incrementally retrains on the refined solutions, keeping an update only when it improves held-out validation error. On a multi-die benchmark, the surrogate-true peak gap on the returned design falls from 1.12 K to 0.11 K, matching a solve-at-every-step optimizer while running $56\times$ faster.

</details>


### [379] [Towards Reasonable Molecular Structure Elucidation from Infrared Spectroscopy with Chemical Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16082)
*Yusen Tan,Hongyu Zhan,Hai-tao Yu,Changxi Chi,Wenjie Du,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了FIRMPO框架，通过引入分子式匹配和红外光谱一致性作为化学反馈信号，显著提升了红外光谱分子结构解析的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于红外光谱的分子结构解析机器学习方法存在预测不合理的问题：候选结构的分子式与输入不匹配，且理论光谱与观测光谱不一致，导致即使排序靠前的预测结果也缺乏可靠性。

Method: 提出Formula- and IR-Matched Preference Optimization (FIRMPO)框架，将化学反馈作为偏好信号，基于精确分子式匹配和红外光谱一致性来引导结构预测。该框架具有模型无关性，可即插即用地集成到不同的结构预测模型中。

Result: 在三个广泛使用的红外光谱数据集上的大量实验表明，FIRMPO显著提升了分子结构解析的准确性，在top-ranked预测的准确性上有实质性改进，优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: FIRMPO成功解决了现有方法中候选结构不合理的问题，通过化学反馈驱动的偏好优化策略，使模型优先考虑满足化学约束的结构，为红外光谱分子结构解析提供了一个有效且通用的解决方案。

Abstract: Infrared (IR) spectra provide characteristic signals of molecular structure, which are often interpreted by experts via functional-group identification or library matching, making the process time-consuming and ambiguous. Recent machine learning methods have made progress in molecular structure elucidation using molecular formulas and IR spectra. However, these models often infer unreasonable candidate molecular structures, including top-ranked predictions. More specifically, the molecular formula implied by a candidate structure often fails to match the input molecular formula, and the candidate's theoretical IR spectrum is often inconsistent with the observed IR spectrum. To address these issues, we propose Formula- and IR-Matched Preference Optimization (FIRMPO), a general and plug-and-play chemical feedback-driven preference optimization framework for molecular structure elucidation. FIRMPO incorporates chemical feedback as preference signals based on exact molecular formula matching and IR spectral consistency to guide reasonable structure predictions. Unlike generic preference optimization methods, FIRMPO is tailored to molecular structure elucidation while remaining model-agnostic, enabling it to be readily integrated with different structure prediction models in this class. This encourages models to prioritize structures that satisfy the chemical feedback, leading to a substantial improvement in the accuracy of top-ranked predictions. Extensive experiments on three widely used IR datasets show that FIRMPO significantly improves molecular structure elucidation accuracy over existing baselines.

</details>


### [380] [Behaviour Is an Incomplete Measure of Reasoning Development: Cross-surface pre-arrival accessibility and the limits of developmental inference in a recurrent-depth reasoner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16085)
*Simon Lam-Muir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现行为能力、内部可访问性和训练时间发展是三种不同的可观察量，行为表现或解码器可访问性都不能准确识别训练获得的计算能力，需要因果干预来真正理解能力发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常从行为阈值、最终检查点或解码器读取的隐藏状态推断能力发展，但这些量可能标识不同的事件。作者旨在通过严格控制实验来区分这些概念，揭示能力发展测量的真实性质。

Method: 在封闭的oracle定义世界中研究30M参数的递归深度关系推理器；使用密集行为轨迹、两种训练表面（符号和言语）、预注册的到达前隐藏状态探针、前瞻性可评估性检查以及明确的未训练和负对照；保持训练时间和推理时间轴分离。

Result: （1）行为层面：在冻结获取标准下，三跳能力在符号表面需70逻辑epoch，言语表面需13,055 epoch（186.5倍对比），之后言语四跳能力在8逻辑epoch内达成；（2）内部测量：言语表面上线性探针在行为到达前恢复未来答案身份（0.056159 vs 均匀机会0.025），预到达可访问性在表面变化后仍存续；（3）追踪可访问性的尝试不可干净评估，因为探针资格由行为到达定义，测量群体随测量值变化。

Conclusion: 行为能力、内部可访问性和训练时间发展是不同的可观察量；行为表现或解码器可访问性都不能识别训练获得的计算；因果干预是必要的下一步研究方法。

Abstract: Capability development is routinely inferred from behavioural thresholds, from final checkpoints, or from what a decoder can read out of a hidden state. These quantities need not identify the same event. We study a 30M-parameter recurrent-depth relational reasoner in a closed, oracle-defined world, using dense behavioural trajectories, two training surfaces, preregistered pre-arrival hidden-state probes, prospectively checked evaluability, and explicit untrained and negative controls, holding the training-time and inference-time axes separate throughout. Behaviour first: under one frozen acquisition criterion, three-hop competence cost 70 logical epochs on the symbolic surface and 13,055 on the verbal surface, a 186.5-fold contrast, after which verbal four-hop competence cleared in 8 logical epochs. Across the 13,055-epoch grind, four-hop held-out behaviour never exceeded 3/40 and ended at 0/40. Internal measurement next: on the verbal surface a linear probe recovered future-answer identity before behavioural arrival at 0.056159 against uniform chance 0.025, an untrained control of 0.024758 and a population frequency baseline of 0.048309 (p = 0.012987; 16/40 answer classes contributing). Analogous pre-arrival accessibility survived the surface change, reaching 0.1020 against a zero-step control of 0.0460 (p = 0.000999) at the upstream structural position and 0.0618 at the readout comparator (p = 0.004), with 21/40 classes contributing. Finally, the natural attempt to track that accessibility across training was not cleanly evaluable: probe eligibility is defined by behavioural arrival, so the measured population changes with the measurand. Behavioural competence, internal accessibility, and training-time development are distinct observables, and neither behaviour nor decoder accessibility identifies the computation training acquired; causal intervention is the necessary next step.

</details>


### [381] [Unifying Graph Neural Networks Through a Common Layer Equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16097)
*Sai Karthik Navuluru,Siddhartha Shankar Das,Bo Ni,Hongjie Chen,Yu Wang,Baris Coskunuzer,Nesreen K. Ahmed,Franck Dernoncourt,Mahantesh Halappanavar,Tyler Derr,Ryan A. Rossi,Lakshman Tamil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一的图神经网络层方程框架，通过七个组件来表示200多种架构，实现了组件级的比较和理论分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的图神经网络架构通过特定家族的方程描述，符号表示掩盖了共享计算和结构差异，缺乏统一的框架来理解和比较不同架构。

Method: 引入一个通用的层方程，包含七个组件：更新域、通道集、传播银行、每通道消息映射、通道融合操作符、自我/残差映射和更新映射。核心分解将信息移动的位置（传播银行）与移动的内容（消息映射）分离，通过功能值填充扩展到各种架构类型。

Result: 框架成功统一了200多种架构，提供了可验证的架构归约，获得了组件级理论见解（如操作符支持界限和全局混合条件），连接了传播选择与过平滑、过压缩、异质性和表达性等问题。

Conclusion: 统一框架为图神经网络架构提供了共同的设计空间，实现了组件级比较和结构一致性架构生成，揭示了将可测量的图和任务属性映射到验证组件选择的实证逆问题。

Abstract: Graph neural networks are commonly described through family-specific equations whose notation obscures shared computations and structural differences. We introduce a common layer equation that represents covered architectures through seven components: an update domain, channel set, propagation bank, per-channel message maps, channel-fusion operator, ego/residual map, and update map. The central factorization separates where information moves, encoded by the propagation bank, from what moves, encoded by the message maps. Function-valued fillings extend the same equation across local message passing, attention, spectral filtering, global communication, relation-specific channels, higher-order domains, and geometric messages.
  We make this unification explicit and checkable through worked reductions of canonical layers and component assignments spanning seven nonexclusive architectural families. A fixed slot discipline assigns operations by computational role and defines the framework's coverage boundary. The decomposition also yields component-level theoretical insights: under endpoint-local messages and node-local updates, operator support bounds one-layer dependencies, and one-layer global mixing requires a full effective operator row under the stated hypotheses.
  The resulting framework organizes more than 200 architectures in a common design space, enables component-wise comparison and generation of structurally consistent architectures, and connects propagation choices to oversmoothing, oversquashing, heterophily, and expressivity. It further exposes the empirical inverse problem of mapping measurable graph and task properties to validated component choices.

</details>


### [382] [AsyTO: Asymmetric Temporal Operator for Parameter-Efficient Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16098)
*Xiachong Lin,Du Yin,Hao Xue,Wen Hu,Imran Razzak,Arian Prabowo,Matthew Amos,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AsyTO方法，通过分解时序算子为共享的历史读取和未来写入模式，解决了多变量时序预测中参数效率与模型灵活性之间的权衡问题，在44个数据集-预测范围设置中的30个达到最佳轻量级精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量时序预测面临结构困境：在变量间共享时序预测器参数效率高但强制异构变量通过相同映射；为每个变量学习独立预测器恢复灵活性但参数量随变量数、上下文长度和预测范围乘积增长。作者认为一旦压缩对象是预测算子而非观测序列，这一困境即可化解。

Method: 提出AsyTO（非对称时序算子）：1) 审计发现相位锁定季节分量配合紧凑残差算子优于密集相位盲参考；2) 将每变量算子张量分解为共享但不同的历史读取和未来写入时序模式，配以每变量模式级增益；3) 补充低秩周期原型和时序模式的循环可分离分解；4) 每个预测仅读取自身变量的历史，参数和计算量随变量数线性增长。

Result: 在11个基准测试和多个预测范围上，AsyTO在44个数据集-预测范围设置中的30个达到最佳轻量级误差，位于精度-计算帕累托前沿。滞后不变的替代方案持续表现不佳，验证了非对称历史到未来映射的优势。

Conclusion: 通过将压缩对象从观测序列转向预测算子，并采用非对称分解结构，AsyTO成功解决了多变量时序预测中的参数效率与灵活性权衡问题，实现了线性参数复杂度和优越的预测性能。

Abstract: Multivariate time-series forecasting faces a structural dilemma: sharing one temporal predictor across variables is parameter-efficient but forces heterogeneous variables through an identical history-to-future map, whereas learning an independent predictor per variable restores flexibility at a cost that grows with the product of variable count, context length, and horizon. We argue that this dilemma dissolves once the object being compressed is the forecasting operator rather than the observed series. Auditing per-variable linear history-to-future maps across standard benchmarks, we find that a phase-locked seasonal component paired with a compact residual operator outperforms a dense phase-blind reference in most audited settings. The residual transport is also directional: lag-invariant alternatives consistently underperform asymmetric history-to-future maps. Guided by this structure, we propose AsyTO, an Asymmetric Temporal Operator that factorizes the tensor of per-variable operators into shared but distinct history-reading and future-writing temporal modes with per-variable mode-wise gains, complemented by a low-rank periodic prototype and a cycle-separable factorization of the temporal modes. Each forecast reads only its own variable's history, so parameters and compute grow linearly in the number of variables. Across eleven benchmarks and multiple forecast horizons, AsyTO attains the best lightweight error in 30 of 44 dataset-horizon settings, locating at the accuracy-compute Pareto frontier.

</details>


### [383] [RetroMPA: A Molecular Property-Aware Auxiliary Framework for Enhancing Retrosynthesis Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16111)
*Mianzhi Liu,Fan Xiao,Zhiliang Yu,Huayang Huang,Yuke Li,Yi Yang,Wenbo Liu,Yu Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了RetroMPA，一种即插即用的分子性质感知后处理增强模块，通过注入化学知识显著提升现有逆合成模型的预测准确率（USPTO-50K上平均提升5.50%），并经湿实验验证其实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的逆合成深度学习模型主要从大规模数据集中自主学习反应模式，但缺乏对既有化学知识的先验整合，限制了模型的性能和可解释性。

Method: RetroMPA是一种模型无关的化学过滤器，利用分子性质感知的潜在嵌入空间，对现有逆合成算法的预测路径进行重新校准和优化。该框架无需修改模型架构或重新训练，即可无缝集成到基于模板和无模板的多种逆合成方法中。

Result: 在USPTO-50K数据集上，RetroMPA在8个代表性逆合成模型上实现top-1准确率平均提升5.50%；在大规模USPTO-Full数据集上平均提升约2.03%。湿实验验证了其在Suzuki-Miyaura偶联、Bucherer反应和Friedel-Crafts酰化等经典反应中的实用性，发现了新的可行底物组合。

Conclusion: RetroMPA成功地将化学知识注入逆合成流程，作为一种通用、高效的增强模块，有效提升了现有模型的性能，并展现出超越单纯数据拟合的实际应用潜力。

Abstract: Retrosynthesis is a cornerstone of drug discovery and organic synthesis. While data-driven deep learning models have shown remarkable progress, they autonomously learn reaction patterns from extensive datasets with limited integration of established chemical knowledge as priors.
  To address this limitation, we introduce RetroMPA, a molecular property-aware, post-hoc enhancement module that injects chemical knowledge into the retrosynthesis pipeline. Rather than functioning as an independent SMILES sequence generator, RetroMPA is a broadly applicable, model-agnostic chemical filter designed to recalibrate and optimize the predictive pathways of existing algorithms.
  This plug-and-play framework integrates seamlessly with a range of data-driven retrosynthesis methods, enhancing outputs without modifying model architecture or requiring resource-intensive retraining. By leveraging a property-aware latent embedding space, RetroMPA consistently improves top-1 accuracy across eight representative retrosynthesis models by an average of 5.50% on USPTO-50K.
  Furthermore, we validate its scalability on the large-scale USPTO-Full dataset, achieving an average improvement of about 2.03% across both template-based and template-free architectures.
  Wet-lab experiments provide preliminary support for the practical utility of the framework. These syntheses confirmed viable, previously unreported substrate combinations for classic reaction paradigms---specifically, Suzuki-Miyaura coupling, Bucherer reaction, and Friedel-Crafts acylation---suggesting that RetroMPA can operate beyond mere data fitting. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/MengzhouLu/RetroMPA.

</details>


### [384] [Multi-Feature Riemannian Hypergraph for Online Test-Time Adaptation of Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16134)
*Siqi Li,Zhi Li,Tong Liu,Shuai Zhang,Yanfei Jia,Zhiqiang Yi,Jue Xie,Ni Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MRieHy框架，结合黎曼几何与超图方法解决运动想象脑机接口中的跨天迁移与在线操作难题，显著提升解码性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床运动想象脑机接口（MI-BCI）解码面临跨天迁移性和在线操作两大关键挑战。现有基于超图的在线情感识别方法虽能通过捕获高阶样本关系改善迁移性，但忽视了在EEG迁移学习中被广泛采用的黎曼几何所带来的跨天优势。因此需要一种能同时利用黎曼几何和超图优势的在线测试时自适应框架。

Method: 提出多特征黎曼超图（MRieHy）框架：首先计算跨天训练数据协方差矩阵的黎曼均值以对齐多天分布；然后基于黎曼距离在协方差矩阵上构建超图，并辅以基于余弦相似度在深度特征上构建的第二个超图；通过自适应学习的组合权重融合两个超图，与标签投影矩阵联合优化。在线测试阶段，维护近期样本的先进先出缓冲区，对缓冲数据执行黎曼对齐，利用学习的超图进行解码。

Result: 在私有四类ECoG数据集和两个公开四类EEG数据集上的大量实验验证，MRieHy相比最先进的基线方法取得了显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: MRieHy成功地将黎曼几何与超图方法相结合，有效增强了MI-BCI解码的跨天迁移能力，同时支持在线测试时自适应操作，为临床应用提供了有前景的解决方案。

Abstract: In clinical motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) decoding, cross-day transferability and online operation remain two critical challenges. Hypergraphs can improve transferability by capturing higher-order sample relationships, yet existing hypergraph-based methods for online emotion recognition neglect the cross-day benefits of Riemannian geometry widely adopted in EEG transfer learning. To bridge this gap, we propose the Multi-feature Riemannian Hypergraph (MRieHy), a framework tailored for online test-time adaptation in MI-BCI decoding that leverages Riemannian geometry to strengthen cross-day transferability. MRieHy first computes Riemannian means of covariance matrices from cross-day training data to align multi-day distributions. It then constructs a hypergraph over covariance matrices using Riemannian distance, complemented by a second hypergraph over deep features built with cosine similarity. The two hypergraphs are fused via adaptively learned combination weights, jointly optimized with the label projection matrices. During online testing, MRieHy maintains a first-in-first-out buffer of recent samples, performs Riemannian alignment on the buffered data, and decodes with the learned hypergraph. Extensive experiments on a private four-class ECoG dataset and two public four-class EEG datasets validate that MRieHy achieves notable performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [385] [REFLEX: Reflexive Equilibrium Fixed-point Learning for Endogenous eXchanges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16155)
*Vignesh Nagarajan,Shriraghav Ashok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了REFLEX框架，用于评估做市商使用机器学习进行报价时，市场在重复训练反馈循环中的稳定性，将理论稳定性条件转化为可测量的市场安全边际。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在场外交易债券市场中，做市商使用机器学习模型设定买卖报价，并在自身报价吸引的交易数据上重复训练模型，形成反馈循环。现有绩效预测理论提供了稳定性条件，但通过抽象性质表达，交易台在部署前无法测量，因此需要可测量的稳定性评估框架。

Method: 提出REFLEX框架，将不可观测的理论量替换为三个可测量的做市商行为特征：交易量对收紧报价的响应强度、目标函数在最优值附近的弯曲程度、信息交易流随利差收窄的增长速度。将这些组合成单一的重训练模量，作为部署前稳定性边际，预测重复训练是收敛还是放大。

Result: 仿真中预测与测量稳定性误差在8%以内，竞争性做市商将不稳定性提高至两方1.74倍、三方3.16倍。当重训练模量达到1.21时，普通重训练变得不稳定，而结构锚定修正方法能够收敛。在36年市场数据标定中，投资级债券的稳定性裕度从平静期到危机期下降约4.4倍，高收益债券下降约4.3倍。

Conclusion: REFLEX成功将抽象的收敛定理转化为市场层面的安全边际，为做市商机器学习报价系统提供了部署前的稳定性评估工具，能够在不同市场环境下预测系统的稳定性变化。

Abstract: In over-the-counter corporate bond markets, dealers compete for client trades by quoting bid and ask prices. Tighter quotes attract more business, but also informed customers more likely to trade ahead of adverse price moves, leaving the dealer holding the risk. As dealers increasingly use machine learning to set quotes, they retrain these models on the trades their own quotes attract, creating a feedback loop in which each model reshapes the market that generates its next training data. The question is therefore not only whether a quoting model performs well, but whether the market it creates stays stable as the model learns from it. Existing performative prediction theory gives a sharp stability condition, yet expresses it through abstract properties of the learning objective a trading desk cannot measure before deployment. We introduce REFLEX, a framework that replaces those unobservable quantities with three measurable features of dealer behavior: how strongly trading volume responds to tighter quotes, how sharply the dealer's objective bends around its optimum, and how quickly informed flow increases as spreads narrow. REFLEX combines these into a single retraining modulus, a pre-deployment stability margin estimated from a desk's own quote and execution history that predicts whether repeated retraining will converge or amplify itself. In simulation, predicted and measured stability agree within 8%, and competing dealers increase instability by 1.74x with two and 3.16x with three, as predicted. Where ordinary retraining becomes unstable at modulus 1.21, a structurally anchored correction converges as blind retraining collapses. Calibrated over 36 years of public market data, stability headroom falls roughly 4.4x for investment grade and 4.3x for high yield from calm to crisis regimes. Ultimately, REFLEX turns an abstract convergence theorem into a market-level safety margin.

</details>


### [386] [A Tree-Structured Approach for Phishing Template and Attacker Attribution Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16158)
*Unai Agirre,Imanol Jerico,Felipe Castaño,Andrea Venturi,Francesco Zola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于HTML结构指纹识别钓鱼网站模板复用的方法，通过无监督聚类分析DOM树结构特征，有效检测零日钓鱼模板和协调攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 钓鱼攻击持续增长且趋于工业化，网络犯罪分子利用钓鱼工具包和可复用模板快速部署大量欺诈网页。现有防御方法主要依赖被动阻止列表或监督分类模型，仅关注单个钓鱼实例，无法识别结构复用和检测协调的钓鱼攻击活动。

Method: 将网页建模为文档对象模型（DOM）树，提取结构特征并可选择性地结合基于HTML标签的内容信息进行丰富。使用无监督学习方法对结构相似的网页进行聚类分组。评估和比较了三种聚类算法，同时分析了提取的DOM树深度对聚类形成和整体聚类性能的影响。

Result: 网页的结构表示能有效揭示钓鱼网站之间隐藏的相似性，使检测新兴和零日钓鱼模板成为可能，并支持对协调钓鱼威胁的分析。通过定量和定性方法评估聚类质量，包括新颖的逐层Jaccard距离评分和可视化工具支持的手动检查。

Conclusion: HTML结构可以作为识别钓鱼模板复用的可靠指纹，通过无监督聚类方法能够有效发现钓鱼网站之间的结构相似性，为零日钓鱼攻击检测和协调威胁分析提供了新的技术途径。

Abstract: Phishing remains a persistent and evolving cybersecurity threat, with attack volumes reaching record levels. This growth is driven by the industrialization of phishing through widely available phishing kits and reusable templates, which enable cybercriminals to rapidly generate and deploy large numbers of fraudulent webpages. Although surface-level attributes may differ across these websites, their underlying structures often exhibit significant similarities. However, most existing defenses rely on reactive blocklists or supervised classification models that focus on individual phishing instances, limiting their ability to identify structural reuse and detect coordinated phishing campaigns. To address this limitation, this study investigates whether HTML structure can serve as a robust fingerprint for identifying phishing template reuse. We model webpages as Document Object Model (DOM) trees and extract structural features, optionally enriched with HTML tag-based content information. These representations are then clustered using unsupervised learning methods to group structurally similar webpages. Three clustering algorithms are evaluated and compared, while also analyzing how the depth of the extracted DOM-tree affects cluster formation and overall clustering performance. Finally, cluster quality is also evaluated both quantitatively and qualitatively, including a novel level-wise Jaccard Distance Score and manual inspection supported by visualization tools. Results demonstrate that structural representations of webpages can effectively reveal hidden similarities across phishing sites, enabling the detection of emerging and zero-day templates and supporting the analysis of coordinated phishing threats

</details>


### [387] [Demystifying Oversmoothing in Sheaf Neural Networks: An Index-Theoretic Criterion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16180)
*Junwen Dong,Yuhan Peng,Hao Li,Huitao Feng,Kelin Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于相对几何视角的方法来精确刻画Sheaf神经网络的反过平滑能力，建立了索引理论比较准则，并提出了GyroSheaf模型。实验验证了该准则的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Sheaf神经网络分析通过调和空间的绝对维度来衡量反过平滑能力，但绝对维度本身不是可靠的度量标准——某些sheaf配置会膨胀调和空间维度但其调和截面仍保持完全常数，无法丰富判别能力。

Method: 提出首个相对的几何方法，建立了精确刻画反过平滑能力的索引理论比较准则，在stalk传输和全局sheaf结构的自然条件下，证明一个sheaf的调和空间真正包含另一个的调和空间（超越平凡膨胀）；引入GyroSheaf（具有弯曲gyrovector空间stalk的sheaf），通过局部切空间线性化将准则扩展到非线性设置。

Result: 在十个模型上的实验证实了理论准则：违反准则的sheaf模型尽管拥有索引跳跃但仍会崩溃，而符合准则的模型能够维持深度稳定的表示。

Conclusion: 绝对维度不是反过平滑能力的可靠度量；所提出的相对几何方法和索引理论比较准则能够精确刻画Sheaf神经网络的反过平滑能力，GyroSheaf成功将准则扩展到非线性设置，为设计更有效的抗过平滑sheaf模型提供了理论指导。

Abstract: To combat oversmoothing in Graph Convolutional Networks, Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) were proposed as a generalization by equipping the graph with a sheaf structure and replacing the graph Laplacian with a sheaf Laplacian $\mathcal{L}$. Existing analyses connect sheaf diffusion to oversmoothing via the harmonic space ($\ker\mathcal{L}$), taking its absolute dimension as an indicator of anti-oversmoothing capacity. However, absolute dimension alone is not a reliable measure: certain sheaf configurations inflate $\dim \ker \mathcal{L}$ while their harmonic sections remain entirely constant, without enriching discriminative capacity. We instead introduce the first relative, geometric approach, yielding a precise characterisation of anti-oversmoothing capacity. Under natural conditions on stalk transportation and global sheaf structure, we establish an index-theoretic comparison criterion showing that one sheaf's harmonic space genuinely contains another's beyond trivial inflation. We illustrate this with a concrete instance and further introduce \textit{GyroSheaf}, a sheaf with curved gyrovector-space stalks, extending the criterion to the non-linear setting via local tangent-space linearization. Experiments across ten models confirm the theoretical criterion: sheaf models violating the criterion collapse despite possessing index jumps, while compliant models maintain depth-stable representations.

</details>


### [388] [Understanding and Stabilizing Deep Q-Learning via Controlled Bootstrapping and Regulated Value Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16182)
*Bozhou Chen,Yongyi Wang,Hanyu Liu,Xionghui Yang,Wenxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从算子、估计器和参数动力学三个角度系统分析了深度Q学习的不稳定性，发现了奖励触发的自我强化陷阱，提出了控制引导、集成分位数估计和参数调节等稳定化方法，在Atari-100K和Procgen上取得了竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度Q学习虽然在强化学习中取得了显著成功，但其训练过程存在严重的不稳定性。现有研究往往将不稳定性归因于孤立因素（如过估计偏差或表示学习问题），缺乏对不同不稳定性来源在递归值估计过程中如何相互作用的统一理解，这促使作者进行系统性分析。

Method: 从三个互补角度系统分析不稳定性：(1)算子层面的Bellman引导偏差；(2)估计器层面的贪婪动作选择对回归噪声的敏感性；(3)激进数据重用下的参数动力学失衡。识别了奖励触发的自我强化陷阱和参数尖峰动力学，并推导出稳定化原则：控制引导、集成分位数估计和基于尖峰的参数调节。

Result: 在Atari-100K和Procgen基准测试上验证了所提方法的有效性，展现出具有竞争力的性能表现和显著改善的训练稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过多视角的系统性分析，揭示了深度Q学习中不同不稳定性来源的相互作用机制，为理解和解决DQL训练不稳定问题提供了统一的理论框架和实用的稳定化技术方案。

Abstract: Deep Q-learning (DQL) has achieved remarkable empirical success in reinforcement learning, yet its training process remains notoriously unstable. Existing studies often attribute instability to isolated factors such as overestimation bias or representation learning issues, lacking a unified understanding of how different sources of instability interact during recursive value estimation. In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of instability in deep Q-learning from three complementary perspectives: operator-level bias in Bellman bootstrapping, estimator-level sensitivity of greedy action selection to regression noise, and parameter-dynamics imbalance under aggressive data reuse. We identify a reward-triggered self-reinforcing trap and characteristic parameter spike dynamics, then derive stabilization principles for controlled bootstrapping, ensemble quantile estimation, and spike-based parameter regulation. Experiments on Atari-100K and Procgen demonstrate competitive performance and improved training stability.

</details>


### [389] [Multi-Granularity Sentiment Integration for LLM-Based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16201)
*Shanshan Lin,Yuesheng Wu,Chao Chen,Yizhe Yang,Zhihao Chen,Zexian Yang,Xiangwen Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MGSI框架，通过多粒度时间建模和文本引导对齐解决LLM多模态情感分析中视听信号融合的挑战，在四个基准数据集上显著超越基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多模态情感分析方法在融合音频和视觉信号时存在关键问题：音频和视觉情感线索在不同时间尺度上演变，但许多方法通过浅层投影或粗粒度池化压缩这些信号，这会削弱跨模态对齐并丢失细粒度的情感信息。

Method: 提出MGSI（多粒度情感整合）框架：1）在短、中、长三种时间尺度上编码音频和视觉流，保留局部变化和全局情感趋势；2）通过文本引导对齐优化非文本特征；3）应用极性和强度感知增强处理模糊和近中性样本；4）将多模态表示压缩为伪标记集合以高效调节冻结的LLM。

Result: 在四个公开基准数据集上的实验表明，MGSI显著优于冻结LLM基线方法，并与强效多模态方法保持竞争力。消融实验和敏感性分析验证了多粒度时间建模、文本引导优化和自适应情感校准的有效性。

Conclusion: 多粒度时间建模和文本引导对齐能有效解决LLM多模态情感分析中的跨模态融合挑战，为冻结LLM条件化提供了高效的解决方案，证明了细粒度时间特征保留对多模态情感理解的重要性。

Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to predict sentiment polarity and intensity from heterogeneous inputs such as text, audio, and vision. While large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic priors for MSA, effectively incorporating audio and visual signals effectively remains challenging. A key challenge is that audio and visual sentiment cues evolve over different temporal scales, yet many LLM-based methods compress these signals through shallow projection or coarse pooling before fusing them with text, which can weaken cross-modal alignment and erase fine-grained affective information. We propose MGSI, a multi-granularity sentiment integration framework for LLM-based MSA. MGSI first encodes audio and visual streams at short-, medium-, and long-range temporal scales, preserving both local variations and global affective trends. It then refines non-text features through text-guided alignment, and applies polarity- and intensity-aware enhancement to better handle ambiguous and near-neutral samples. The resulting multimodal representation is finally compressed into a small set of pseudo-tokens for efficient conditioning of a frozen LLM. Experiments on four public benchmarks show that MGSI substantially outperforms frozen-LLM baselines and remains competitive with strong multimodal methods. Further ablation and sensitivity analyses support the effectiveness of multi-granularity temporal modeling, text-guided refinement, and adaptive sentiment calibration.

</details>


### [390] [Conditional Evaluation of Language Models with Cheap Auxiliary Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16210)
*Zhi Zhang,Lingfeng Lyu,Yue Kang,Doudou Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了LACE（局部增强控制变量评估），一种半监督估计器，用于解决LLM评估中聚合准确率掩盖模型具体成败表现的问题。该方法利用廉价辅助信号（如LLM判断分数、成对比较等）来降低依赖金标签评估的条件性能分析成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM评估中，聚合准确率指标掩盖了模型在特定条件下的成功与失败表现。然而，仅依赖金标签估计条件性能分布成本高昂，而廉价辅助信号（如LLM判断分数、成对比较、置信度分数等）虽可大规模收集，但往往存在偏差或校准问题。需要一种能够有效结合这两类信息的方法。

Method: 提出LACE估计器，核心步骤是局部中心化：在目标分布区域内部减去廉价信号的条件均值，使得任何线性增强都具有零条件均值。引入局部岭控制变量，结合标注子集的金标签残差均值与完整数据集的廉价信号均值。该方法实现了无需校准的识别、分组分布的无偏性，以及在中心化线性增强中的局部最优性。

Result: 在MATH-500、ScienceQA、MMLU、WinoGrande、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA、GSM8K和ARC等多个基准测试上进行了实证评估，验证了该方法的有效性。效率增益由群体局部R²决定，该指标刻画了廉价信号在不同分布值下可获得的效率变化特征。同时推导了直接配对模型差距和部署加权分数的相应估计器。

Conclusion: LACE方法为条件LLM评估提供了一种理论完备且实用的半监督估计框架，在保证无偏性的前提下有效利用廉价辅助信号提升估计效率，为精细化的模型性能分析提供了新思路。

Abstract: Aggregate accuracy hides where models succeed and fail. Estimating conditional performance profiles from gold labels alone is expensive, while cheap auxiliary signals such as LLM-judge scores, pairwise comparisons, confidence scores, and judge-disagreement features can be collected for every benchmark item but are often biased or miscalibrated. We propose LACE (Local Augmented Control-Variate Evaluation), a semi-supervised estimator for conditional LLM evaluation. The key step is local centering: after subtracting the conditional mean of a cheap signal within the target profile region, any linear augmentation has zero conditional mean and therefore cannot change the estimand. The augmentation coefficient is used only for efficiency, and a local ridge control variate combines a gold-label residual mean from the labeled subset with a cheap-signal mean from the full item pool. We prove calibration-free identification, unbiasedness for grouped profiles, local oracle optimality within centered linear augmentations, and first-order adaptivity to the estimated coefficient. The resulting gain formula is governed by a population local $R^2$, which characterizes how the efficiency attainable from the cheap signals varies across profile values. We also derive corresponding estimators for direct paired model gaps and deployment-weighted scores. We empirically evaluate the primary performance-profile estimator on MATH-500, ScienceQA, MMLU, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, GSM8K, and ARC.

</details>


### [391] [Quantifying the Gap Between Laboratory Battery Test Patterns and Field Duty Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16212)
*Chunyang Zhao,Chresten Træholt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过比较六种证据源，量化了实验室电池测试与实际现场工况之间的显著差距，揭示了电池性能指标对工况模式的依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实验室电池测试是电池性能和退化研究的主要实证基础，但其运行模式不能直接代表现场工况特征。需要量化这种差距以为应用导向研究提供指导。

Method: 比较六个证据源：受控循环、驾驶循环测试、动态循环、NMC811实验室老化、真实电动汽车充电轨迹和车队级电动汽车健康状态(SOH)数据。分析结合使用频率、使用强度、使用C-rate和基于归一化电流离散度和斜率的工况结构指数(DSI)。

Result: 代表性单段DSI从现场源轨迹的0.630到牛津的2.936，使用C-rate从0.14-0.40到2.00。长期老化也存在差异：80%容量保持区域出现在351个NASA循环、6292个牛津检查点和1019个斯坦福循环。现场运行显示中位使用强度为137.2公里/天，56.9%的充电结束于95% SOC以上。

Conclusion: 电池性能指标取决于产生它们的工况模式；应用导向研究应报告明确的工况特征描述符，同时报告化学成分、容量和老化指标。

Abstract: Laboratory battery tests provide the main empirical basis for battery performance and degradation studies, but their operating patterns do not directly represent field duty profiles. This paper quantifies the gap by comparing six accessible evidence sources covering controlled cycling, drive-cycle testing, dynamic cycling, NMC811 laboratory ageing, a real electric-vehicle charging trace, and fleet-scale electric-vehicle state-of-health (SOH) data. The analysis combines usage frequency, usage intensity, usage C-rate, and a duty-structure index (DSI) based on normalized current dispersion and ramping. The representative single-segment DSI ranges from 0.630 for the field source trace and 0.699 for NASA to 2.936 for Oxford and 2.855 for Imperial, while usage C-rate ranges from 0.14-0.40 for Imperial, NASA, Stanford, and Hyundai to 2.00 for Oxford. Long-term ageing also differs: the 80 percent retention region occurs near 351 NASA cycles, 6292 Oxford checkpoints, and 1019 Stanford cycles. In chemistry-aligned NMC/NCM evidence, Imperial retains 0.813 under standard cycling and 0.865 under drive-cycle ageing, while the field source has median SOH 0.889 with visible dispersion. Field operation further shows a median use intensity of 137.2 km/day and 56.9 percent of charges ending at or above 95 percent SOC.
