These results show that battery performance metrics are conditional on the duty pattern that generated them; application-oriented studies should report explicit duty-profile descriptors together with chemistry, capacity, and ageing metrics.

</details>


### [392] [Beyond Peak Backlog: Conditional Energy and Temporal Geometry in Capacity-Constrained Delayed Bandit Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16216)
*Anling Xiang,Yuwen Yang,Yang Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了有限跟踪容量下的在线凸优化延迟问题，提出了调度端条件能量接口，将延迟代价从O(√Tσ_max)改进至O(√E_C·d_tot)，揭示了延迟时序的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单点强盗凸优化在有限跟踪容量模型下，延迟代价为O(√Tσ_max)，而无限制跟踪可实现更优的O(√d_tot)依赖。作者旨在缩小这一理论差距，在相同半全知预言机和路径硬容量约束下，改进有限容量学习器的延迟复杂度上界。

Method: 引入调度端条件能量接口，将速率自适应与单点扰动过滤分离，处理随机准入产生的依赖重要性权重；在半全知预言机和路径硬容量契约下，设计无需调参的学习器；在强凸性下推导时间代价公式H_A(d)=∑_t σ_t/(A+t)。

Result: 延迟项复杂度改进为O(√E_C·d_tot)，其中E_C为显式重启因子，当有公开常数峰值约束时可消除该因子；识别出相同延迟多重集、总延迟、峰值积压和容量下，最小最大悔界可有多项式级差异，证明时序在曲率下的重要性；建立了将跟踪容量转化为零阶查询预算的连续硬族，给出容量饥饿下界。

Conclusion: 上界需要C≥lnT+1的跟踪容量，尚未构成完整的容量最小最大刻画；条件能量接口有效分离了速率适应与扰动过滤，为有限容量下的延迟优化提供了新理论框架。

Abstract: What is the right delay complexity when a learner can track only $C$ pending feedback items and discarded feedback is permanently lost? Existing one-point bandit convex optimization guarantees in this model pay $\sqrt{Tσ_{\max}}$, where $σ_{\max}$ is the peak backlog, although unlimited tracking admits the sharper $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ dependence on total delay. We introduce a scheduler-side conditional-energy interface that separates rate adaptation from the one-point perturbation filtration and handles the dependent importance weights created by randomized admission. Under the same semi-clairvoyant oracle and pathwise hard-capacity contract, this yields an untuned learner whose delay term scales as $O(\sqrt{E_C d_{\mathrm{tot}}})$, with only an explicit restart factor $E_C$; a public constant-factor peak bound removes this factor while $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ remains unknown. Under strong convexity, the same interface yields the temporal cost $H_A(d)=\sum_t σ_t/(A+t)$. Two delay vectors with identical delay multisets, $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$, $σ_{\max}$, and capacity can nevertheless have polynomially different minimax regret, showing that timing matters under curvature even when aggregate delay summaries agree. Finally, a continuous hard family converts tracking capacity into a zeroth-order query budget and gives a complementary capacity-starvation lower endpoint. The upper bounds require $C\ge \ln T+1$ and do not constitute a complete capacity minimax characterization.

</details>


### [393] [A Privacy Study of Sparse Collaborative Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16236)
*Maximilian Andreas Hoefler,Karsten Mueller,Wojciech Samek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了协作推理中稀疏激活的隐私风险。研究发现，稀疏化对隐私泄露的减少远小于对传输成本的降低，激活位置本身构成了严重的隐私风险，能够实现高保真重建和个体识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作推理通过分割模型来降低边缘设备的计算负担，但面临传输成本和隐私泄露的双重挑战。近期工作通过稀疏化激活来减少传输成本，并直觉认为传输更少的值会减少隐私泄露。本文旨在测试这一假设，揭示稀疏化激活的真实隐私风险。

Method: 作者将稀疏激活分解为两部分：保留值和位置集合，分别从每个组件独立重构输入。研究跨自然图像和人脸数据集进行，评估位置信息在重构和重新识别个体中的作用。

Result: 稀疏化减少隐私泄露的效果远小于其减少传输成本的效果。剩余风险转移到位置信息上，即使传输成本和任务效用较低，位置信息仍能实现高保真重建和个体重新识别。仅位置信息就构成了严重的隐私风险。

Conclusion: 稀疏激活的位置应被视为敏感传输数据，在协作推理的背景下需要进行严格审计。现有对位置信息的处理（作为解码的辅助信息）存在安全隐患。

Abstract: Collaborative inference (CI) splits a model between an edge device and a server, whereby the client computes an intermediate activation, transmits it, and the server completes the computation. This raises two concerns, the communication cost of the transmission and the risk that it reveals private information about the input. Recent work reduces this cost by sparsifying activations and entropy-coding the result. Sparsity has also been argued to improve privacy, on the intuition that transmitting fewer values reveals less about the input. We test this claim by decomposing the sparse activation into the retained values and the set of positions they occupy, and by reconstructing inputs from each component in isolation. We find that sparsification reduces the leakage far less than it reduces the transmission cost, and that the remaining risk shifts to the positions, which prior analyses treat as side information for decoding. Across natural-image and face datasets, the positions alone constitute a serious privacy risk, enabling high-fidelity reconstructions and re-identification of individuals. The leakage from the positions persists even when both the transmission cost and the task utility are low. We conclude that the positions of sparse activations should be treated as sensitive transmitted data and audited carefully in the context of collaborative inference. Code is available at https://github.com/an7123/Privacy-Study-Sparse-CI.

</details>


### [394] [Optimizing Multi-Market Participation of Battery and Electrolyser Systems Based on Field Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16238)
*Chunyang Zhao,Stoyan Trenchev,Shi You,Chresten Træholt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过实验与建模分析了电池储能系统(BESS)和电解槽在丹麦电力市场中的多市场参与表现，发现考虑实际硬件特性的优化框架可实现每日1,749.27丹麦克朗(BESS)和289.46丹麦克朗(电解槽)的利润。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可再生能源在电力系统中占比增加，系统稳定性需要快速响应和灵活资源支撑。尽管电力市场扩展和辅助服务产品为多服务收入叠加提供了机会，但现有研究往往忽视了爬坡限制、效率和设定点跟踪精度等实际硬件行为特性。

Method: 对55 kW/79 kWh电池储能系统和由三个2.4 kW单元组成的电解槽进行实验测量，识别关键性能特性，并将其嵌入价格驱动的优化框架中，利用2022-2025年丹麦电力市场和辅助服务市场的真实数据进行多市场参与优化分析。

Result: 优化后的每日多市场参与利润分别为1,749.27丹麦克朗(BESS)和289.46丹麦克朗(电解槽)，成功展示了两种灵活资源的商业案例。

Conclusion: 研究强调了在评估多年跨多市场参与时纳入实验性能特性的重要性，为Power-to-X系统和电池储能系统的商业化运营提供了有价值的参考。

Abstract: The increasing share of renewable energy in power systems creates a need for fast-response and flexible resources to maintain system stability. With the expansion of electricity markets and ancillary service products, opportunities arise to stack revenues across multiple services. Long-term Power-to-X (PTX) electrolysers and short-term battery energy storage systems (BESS) are prevalent flexible resources, yet most studies neglect real hardware behavior, such as ramp limits, efficiency, and setpoint-tracking accuracy. This work presents experimental and modeling results for a 55 kW/79 kWh BESS and an electrolyser comprising three 2.4 kW units. Key characteristics are identified through measurements and embedded into a price-driven optimization framework for participation in the Danish electricity and ancillary service markets, utilizing real market data from 2022 to 2025. The optimized daily profits for multi-market participation are 1,749.27 DKK and 289.46 DKK for the BESS and electrolyser, respectively. With the demonstrated business cases for BESS and PTX systems, this work highlights the importance of incorporating experimental performance when evaluating participation across multiple markets and years.

</details>


### [395] [The Trade-off Between Covariate Dependence and Latent Structure in Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16245)
*Małgorzata Łazęcka,Ewa Szczurek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出统一的监督解耦框架，揭示潜在独立性与潜在-协变量对齐之间的内在权衡关系，并提供闭式变换方法实现预训练模型（CLIP、DINOv2、ViT）和iFA模型的结构化潜在表示控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督方法仅追求潜在维度独立性，无法保证语义对齐；监督方法在相关协变量下无法同时实现一对一潜在-协变量对齐和潜在独立性，缺乏理论指导。

Method: 建立统一的监督框架，将潜在维度-协变量依赖性与潜在结构约束相耦合；推导理论权衡关系及不同解耦模式的闭式变换；应用于预训练模型的后验对齐和协变量信息因子分析(iFA)模型。

Result: 证明潜在独立性或独占性一对一依赖的强制要求会带来潜在-协变量对齐的可证明代价；不同解耦模式按对齐强度排序；在模拟和真实多组学数据上验证了后验对齐和iFA方法可实现结构化潜在表示的可控性。

Conclusion: 解耦表示学习中存在内在权衡，所提框架提供了理论指导和方法论工具，使预训练模型和概率模型能够实现可控的结构化潜在表示，在多组学等应用场景具有实用价值。

Abstract: Disentangled representation learning seeks latent representations whose indicidual dimensions each align with a distinct covariate. Unsupervised approaches typically target latent dimension independence, yet this gives no guarantee that the resulting dimensions align with semantically meaningful covariates. Supervised approaches structure the latent space using observed covariates, but under correlated covariates they cannot simultaneously control one-to-one latent-covariate alignment and latent independence. We introduce a unified, supervised framework that couples latent dimension-covariate dependence with constraints on the latent structure. Within this framework, we show an inherent trade-off, where enforcing latent independence or exclusive one-to-one latent-covariate dependence comes at a provable cost in latent-covariate alignment. We prove that the resulting disentanglement regimes are ordered by the strength of that alignment. Each regime admits a closed-form transformation of the latent space. We apply these transformations post-hoc to realign the representations of pretrained models such as CLIP, DINOv2, and ViT, and we fold them into the inference of informed factor analysis (iFA), a probabilistic model with covariate-informed factors. On simulated and real multi-omics data, we show that both post-hoc alignment and iFA enable controllability of structured latent representations.

</details>


### [396] [SAUL: Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16249)
*Jaewan Choi,Junyoung Yang,Sangdon Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出SAUL方法，通过将遗忘建模为显式约束来解决LLM机器遗忘中的遗忘-效用权衡问题，在多个基准上表现出优越的遗忘-效用平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM机器遗忘方法在擦除目标知识和保留通用能力之间存在关键权衡。先前方法通常通过优化目标隐式地指定遗忘程度，难以精确控制遗忘程度——既要遗忘足够，又不能过度遗忘。

Method: 提出SAUL（锐度感知增广拉格朗日遗忘）方法：1）将遗忘建模为具有预设满足标准的显式约束；2）采用增广拉格朗日控制器根据约束违反自适应调整遗忘压力，当满足预设标准时可最终停用遗忘侧更新；3）在保留和遗忘目标上应用锐度感知更新；4）采用双优化器设计维持角色分离状态以稳定遗忘动态。

Result: 在TOFU、WMDP和MUSE三个基准上评估，SAUL相比代表性的锐度感知和扰动基线方法展现出更优的遗忘-效用权衡。在TOFU上验证了增广拉格朗日控制器作为即插即用修改器应用于代表性基线方法可提升其遗忘后效用。

Conclusion: 通过显式遗忘约束和自适应控制机制，SAUL实现了"遗忘足够但不过度"的原则，有效解决了LLM机器遗忘中的遗忘-效用权衡问题，为可控机器遗忘提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Machine unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical trade-off between erasing target knowledge and preserving general utility. We propose SAUL (Sharpness-Aware Augmented-Lagrangian Unlearning), which formulates unlearning as a constrained minimization problem following the principle of "forget enough, but no more than necessary." At its core, SAUL formulates forgetting as an explicit constraint with a prescribed satisfaction criterion, whereas prior unlearning methods typically specify the desired level of forgetting implicitly through optimization objectives. An augmented Lagrangian controller adaptively adjusts forget-side pressure according to constraint violation and can eventually deactivate the forget-side update as the prescribed criterion remains satisfied. Sharpness-aware updates on both retain and forget objectives, together with a dual-optimizer design that maintains role-separated states, further stabilize the resulting unlearning dynamics. We evaluate SAUL on the TOFU, WMDP, and MUSE benchmarks, demonstrating favorable forgetting-utility trade-offs over representative sharpness- and perturbation-based baselines under benchmark-specific forgetting criteria. Beyond the complete SAUL framework, we further show on TOFU that applying the augmented-Lagrangian controller as a drop-in modifier to representative baselines improves their post-forgetting utility, demonstrating the practical value of explicit forgetting control.

</details>


### [397] [Efficient Coreset Selection via K-Nearest Neighbor Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16270)
*Yingfan Liu,Leiyu Zhang,Jiadong Xie,Mingzhe Wang,Jeffrey Xu Yu,Jiangtao Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了KNNG-CS方法，通过K近邻图进行轻量级核心集选择，在保持模型精度的同时显著降低了时间和内存成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的梯度近似核心集方法（如CRAIG和聚类变体）虽然能保持模型精度，但其选择阶段依赖密集的成对距离矩阵或大型项目-聚类绑定矩阵，导致在大规模数据集上时间和内存开销过高。

Method: 提出KNNG-CS方法，基于K近邻图构建轻量级核心集选择框架。该方法利用局部邻域结构估计每个数据项的重要性，并贪婪地选择代表性节点，无需维护二次距离矩阵，仅需线性存储空间（相对于边数）。

Result: 在四个真实数据集上的实验表明，KNNG-CS达到了与代表性梯度近似核心集方法相当的准确率，同时选择时间减少了2.3×-41.2×，峰值内存仅为基准方法的0.3%-7.5%。

Conclusion: KNNG-CS成功解决了现有梯度近似核心集方法的效率瓶颈，在保持竞争力的模型精度的同时，实现了显著的计算效率提升，为大规模数据集的核心集选择提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Coreset selection reduces the cost of model training by replacing a large training set with a small representative subset. Existing gradient-approximation coreset methods such as CRAIG and cluster-based variants can preserve model accuracy. Still, their selection stages often rely on dense pairwise distances or large item-cluster bound matrices, leading to high time and memory costs on large datasets. This paper proposes KNNG-CS, a lightweight coreset selection method based on a $K$-nearest neighbor graph. KNNG-CS exploits local neighborhood structures to estimate the importance of each data item and greedily selects representative nodes without maintaining a quadratic distance matrix. The method requires only linear storage in the number of edges. Experiments on four real-world datasets show that KNNG-CS achieves accuracy comparable to representative gradient-approximation coreset methods, while reducing selection time by $2.3\times$-$41.2\times$ and peak memory to $0.3\%$-$7.5\%$ of the baselines.

</details>


### [398] [Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16273)
*Simon Ellershaw,Christopher Tomlinson,Zeljko Kraljevic,Spiros Denaxas,Harry Hemingway,Cathie Sudlow,Angela M. Wood,Anoop D. Shah,Richard Dobson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Foresight-E，这是首个针对电子健康记录（EHR）的国家级生成式基础模型，作为COVID-19研究试点开发。该模型在NHS England安全数据环境中训练，包含2.43亿参数的transformer解码器，覆盖约6100万人的纵向EHR数据。虽然由于项目暂停无法提供定量结果，但分享了完整的建模方法论框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发首个国家级规模的电子健康记录生成式基础模型，用于评估COVID-19大流行的直接和间接影响，探索在安全数据环境内构建人口规模EHR基础模型的可行性与挑战。

Method: 采用2.43亿参数的transformer解码器架构，完全在NHS England安全数据环境内从头训练。使用约6100万人的去标识化纵向EHR数据，整合初级/二级护理、死亡登记和COVID-19数据。采用自回归方式建模患者时间线，保留ICD-10、OPCS-4和SNOMED CT编码的临床粒度，词汇表包含约40,000个代码。训练验证集为90%（5490万人，2018年11月至2022年12月），保留10%（610万人）用于评估。推理时零样本预测，无需任务特定训练。

Result: 设计了30天COVID-19住院和死亡率的评估框架，包括按人口统计学因素和疫苗接种状态的亚组分析。通过2023年数据（超出训练期）测试模型对未见未来数据的泛化能力和大流行间接影响，并与逻辑回归和XGBoost进行基准对比。但由于NHS England暂停数据访问，目前无法提供定量结果，仅作为方法学模板和案例研究。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了构建人口规模EHR基础模型的完整方法论框架，包括分词、架构、训练、推理和评估策略。尽管面临数据访问暂停的挑战，但为未来在安全数据环境内开发类似模型提供了宝贵的方法学参考和实践经验。

Abstract: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. At inference, it operates zero-shot, predicting any concept in its ~40,000-code vocabulary without task-specific training. Our tokenisation scheme retains the clinical granularity of ICD-10, OPCS-4, and SNOMED CT codes, jointly representing absolute and relative timing. We designed an evaluation framework for 30-day COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality, including subgroup analyses by demographic factors and vaccination status. To assess generalisation to unseen future data and the pandemic's indirect effects, we tested the model on medical events from 2023 (beyond its training period), benchmarking against logistic regression and XGBoost. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are currently unavailable. Instead, we share our strategy for tokenisation, architecture, training, inference, and evaluation as a methodological template and case study in the challenges of building population-scale EHR foundation models.

</details>


### [399] [SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16287)
*Jiaming Hu,Yan Zheng,Tian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SCALE方法，通过校准潜在嵌入的几何性质来改进端到端世界模型的规划性能，无需替换编码器或增加规划开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有两种非坍缩表示策略（预训练特征空间继承和端到端反坍缩学习）具有互补优势，但它们的几何性质差异影响规划效果。DINO-WM的主成分保留更多状态信息，而端到端的LeWM在欧氏规划成本中被高方差方向主导，导致状态信息对候选选择的影响较弱。

Method: 提出SCALE（状态校准潜在嵌入）方法，通过将采样的成对潜在距离与标准化任务相关状态空间中的距离相关联，诱导LeWM表示获得DINO-WM的有利几何性质。该方法仅添加轻量级训练时正则化，不替换编码器，不增加规划时开销。

Result: 在五个任务、三个规划求解器和五个计算预算的实验中，SCALE在所有任务-求解器平均上均优于LeWM基线。对比实验显示，潜在到状态回归控制虽能匹配或超越全嵌入可解码性，但无法显著改善潜在-状态距离对齐，且规划改进不稳定。

Conclusion: 规划性能不仅取决于任务相关信息是否存在于表示中，还取决于这些信息是否塑造了规划器所消费的几何结构。SCALE成功地将几何性质与状态信息对齐，证明了表示几何性质对规划的重要性。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive world models plan by scoring predicted terminal embeddings against a goal embedding using a cost defined on the representation itself. Two prominent strategies for obtaining non-collapsed representations are to inherit a pretrained feature space, as in DINO-WM, and to learn an embedding end to end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM) with SIGReg. These strategies show complementary strengths across tasks. Although task-relevant state is decodable from the full embeddings of both models, DINO-WM's leading principal components usually retain substantially more state information than LeWM's. Because Euclidean planning costs are dominated by high-variance directions, this difference affects how strongly state can influence candidate selection. We propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings) to give the end-to-end LeWM representation the favorable geometric property observed in DINO-WM. SCALE induces this property by correlating sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in a standardized task-relevant state space, without replacing LeWM's learned encoder. Across five tasks, three planning solvers, and five compute budgets, SCALE improves every task--solver average over LeWM. A latent-to-state regression control matches or exceeds SCALE's full-embedding decodability yet leaves latent--state distance alignment essentially unchanged and yields less consistent planning gains. SCALE adds a single lightweight training-time regularizer and no planning-time overhead. These results show that planning depends not only on whether task-relevant information is present, but also on whether it shapes the geometry consumed by the planner.

</details>


### [400] [Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16319)
*Adrian Hayler,Klemens Flöge,Alan Arazi,Rishabh Ranjan,Jure Leskovec,Felix Birkel,Brendan Roof,Anurag Garg,Kristina Collins,Lydia Sidhoum,Jonas Kübler,Siyuan Guo,Oscar Key,Jan Hendrik Metzen,Rylee Grace,David Salinas,Arthur Cahu,Simon Bing,Benjamin Jäger,Tuana Çelik,Mihir Manium,Vitor Monteiro,Jake Robertson,Jerry Chen,Eliott Kalfon,Tomás Pereda,Lilly Wehrhahn,Dominik Safaric,Tobias Schroeder,Georg Grab,Diana Kriuchkova,Clara Cornu,Philipp Singer,Nick Erickson,Vahid Balazadeh,Marie Salmon,Simone Alessi,Kürşat Kaya,Philipp Jund,Léo Grinsztajn,Yann LeCun,Bernhard Schölkopf,Madelon Hulsebos,Lennart Purucker,Sauraj Gambhir,Frank Hutter,Noah Hollmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prior Labs发布了关系学习领域的三个开源工具：基准框架RelArena-α、当前排名第一的模型TabPFN-Rel，以及模型无关接口RPI，旨在加速关系学习研究和实际应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关系学习领域虽然出现了多种数据集和任务，但缺乏可靠、可复现的方法来比较不同方法的性能。同时，关系学习方法在研究和产业中的采用率有待提高，需要统一的框架和易用的工具来促进发展。

Method: 开源三个软件组件：（1）RelArena-α：统一的关系学习基准框架，标准化数据加载、评估协议和调参流程；（2）TabPFN-Rel：基于TabPFN-3构建的关系学习模型，通过将关系数据库扁平化为单表进行预测；（3）RPI：模型无关的开源接口，支持用户在新数据库上定义问题并应用任意模型。

Result: TabPFN-Rel在RelArena-α上排名第一，证明了将关系数据库扁平化为单表的方法在实际任务中仍可与专门的关系架构相竞争。三个工具均已开源，为研究者和早期采用者提供了完整的解决方案。

Conclusion: Prior Labs致力于开放科学，通过开源工具推动关系学习领域向实际应用发展。未来将根据社区反馈与合作进一步改进工具，使RelArena-α成为关系学习社区进步的催化剂。

Abstract: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $α$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the community has not converged on a reliable, reproducible way to compare different methods on these tasks. Our $α$-release, RelArena-$α$, provides a unified framework for running and comparing baselines on RelBench v1 by standardizing data loading, evaluation protocols, tuning regimes, and support for systems with custom tuning, inspired by established tabular benchmarks such as TabArena. We plan to work with the research community to further develop RelArena-$α$ into a catalyst for progress in the relational learning community. We release the initial version of TabPFN-Rel, a purpose-built relational harness for TabPFN-3. Currently ranked first among models on RelArena-$α$, TabPFN-Rel makes key improvements upon RDBLearn. Beyond its ranking, TabPFN-Rel serves as a strong baseline, adding to the growing evidence that flattening a relational database into a single table remains competitive with specialized relational architectures on real-world tasks.
  To facilitate adoption of relational learning methods in research and industry, we release an initial $α$-version of our Relational Predictive Interface, RPI, an open-source, model-agnostic interface that enables early adopters to easily define problems on new databases and apply any model implemented in RelArena-$α$, including TabPFN-Rel, to these problems.

</details>


### [401] [Transfer Learning of Keystroke Dynamics for Cross-Device User Authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16334)
*Nuwan Kaluarachchi,Sevvandi Kandanaarachchi,Kristen Moore,Arathi Arakala,Conrad Sanderson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备击键动态认证系统，通过适应源设备数据并结合目标设备有限数据训练分类器，有效解决了跨设备场景下的分布漂移问题，在BBMAS数据集上取得了14.2%的等错误率，超越了现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 击键动态作为一种行为生物特征可用于用户认证，但在跨设备场景中面临挑战：由于不同设备形态因素导致打字模式变化，在源设备（如手机）上学习的模型难以直接应用于目标设备（如平板），造成分布漂移问题。

Method: 提出基于归纳迁移学习的跨设备用户认证系统：1)将源设备的击键动态适应到目标设备；2)将适应后的数据与目标设备有限的训练数据相结合；3)使用扩展的击键特征集更好地捕获判别性动态；4)基于融合数据训练鲁棒的二分类器。

Result: 在BBMAS数据集上的实验表明，该系统在跨设备场景下取得了14.2%的等错误率(EER)，超越了现有的最先进方法。

Conclusion: 归纳迁移学习能有效解决跨设备击键认证中的分布漂移问题，通过源设备知识迁移与目标设备数据结合，在有限目标设备数据条件下实现了优异的认证性能，为跨设备行为生物特征认证提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Keystroke dynamics (typing patterns) can be used as a behavioural biometric modality for user authentication, with applications such as fraud prevention. While the modality has been shown to work well for single device authentication, its application to cross-device scenarios is more challenging. Dynamics learned on one device (eg., phone) may not be directly applicable to authentication on a secondary device with a different form factor (eg., tablet) due to changes in typing patterns that can lead to distribution drifts. To address this, we propose a cross-device user authentication system based on inductive transfer learning, where keystroke dynamics learned on one device are adapted to a secondary device. The adapted data is then combined with necessarily limited training data for the secondary device, which is used to robustly train a binary classifier. Furthermore, an extended set of keystroke features is used to better capture discriminative dynamics. Experiments on the BBMAS dataset show that proposed system achieves an equal error rate of 14.2% for the cross-device scenario, surpassing state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [402] [Task-Anchored Representation Shaping for Pre-Trained Model-Based Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16345)
*Zhiming Xu,Huiyu Yi,Zhen-Hao Xie,Baile Xu,Furao Shen,Jian Zhao,Suorong Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了TAILS，一种轻量级后处理模块，通过使用固定任务锚点作为参考来纠正特征表示，从而解决持续学习中的跨任务预测瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练模型为持续学习提供了稳定表示的基础，然而对每个任务的良好适应并不能确保对所有已学习任务的可靠推理。由于任务边界通常是人为的且语义纠缠，来自未知任务的输入即使具有强PTM特征也可能保持模糊，使得跨任务预测成为关键瓶颈。

Method: 提出了任务锚定推理潜在塑造（TAILS），这是一种轻量级后PTM模块，可以集成到各种持续学习器中并通过解耦步骤进行优化。TAILS使用固定任务锚点作为累积知识的持久参考，解释每个样本相对于这些参考的特征表示，然后将跨任务的相关证据组合成潜在回忆，直接在预测之前纠正特征表示。

Result: 在多种基于PTM的持续学习范式上进行了广泛实验，表明TAILS能够以适度的参数开销和可忽略的推理成本改善分类和任务推理性能。

Conclusion: TAILS通过在表示级别解决跨任务模糊性，同时保持原始PTM、方法特定模块和分类器不变，成功改善了持续学习中的分类和任务推理性能，为PTM-based持续学习系统提供了一个有效的轻量级解决方案。

Abstract: Pre-trained models (PTMs) provide a strong foundation for continual learning by offering stable representations that facilitate lightweight adaptation to new tasks. However, adapting well to each task does not ensure reliable inference over all learned tasks. Since task boundaries are often artificial and semantically entangled, an input from an unknown task can remain ambiguous even with strong PTM features, making cross-task prediction a key bottleneck. We propose Task-Anchored Inference Latent Shaping (TAILS), a lightweight post-PTM module that can be integrated into diverse continual learners and optimized through a decoupled step. TAILS uses fixed task anchors as persistent references to accumulated knowledge. It interprets each sample's feature representation relative to these references, then composes relevant evidence across tasks into latent recall. Rather than selecting a task-specific path or adjusting classifier outputs, TAILS uses latent recall to directly correct the feature representation before prediction. It therefore resolves cross-task ambiguity at the representation level, while leaving the original PTM, method-specific modules, and classifier unchanged. Extensive experiments across multiple PTM-based continual learning paradigms show that TAILS can improve classification and task-inference performance with modest parameter overhead and negligible inference cost.

</details>


### [403] [OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16373)
*Simon Donike,Ruben Cartuyvels,Antonino Ian Ferola,Elisa Carli,Diego Fernandez Prieto,Marie-Helene Rio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了OceanDepths，这是首个开放、全球范围、重网格化的AI就绪数据集，将卫星海表数据（SST、SSS、SSH）与现场次表层温盐剖面数据配对，为海洋AI研究提供了新的基准数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球海洋占据地球表面70%以上，但与陆地表面和大气相比，海洋观测严重不足。理解全球海洋需要联合观测其表面和次表层结构，然而目前缺乏标准化的高分辨率数据集将卫星表面场与同位的现场深度剖面以AI就绪格式耦合。现有资源要么由模型重构的网格产品组成而非观测数据，要么仅覆盖单一变量或海域，或分辨率过粗无法捕捉中尺度动力学过程。

Method: 研究团队构建了OceanDepths数据集，将卫星反演的海表温度（SST）、海表盐度（SSS）和海表高度（SSH）L4产品与同位的EN4次表层温度和盐度剖面配对，并补充匹配的GLORYS12海洋再分析数据以支持比较或多阶段学习。数据集覆盖2000-2024年，空间分辨率为0.1°×0.1°，时间分辨率为周尺度，覆盖全球海表，包含超过950万配对剖面并插值到50个标准化深度层。研究还提供了可配置系统将全球划分为等大小的空间块。

Result: OceanDepths数据集具有4D多变量结构、高分辨率、长时间跨度和次表层观测极度稀疏（每深度层约0.01%）的特点，使其成为新颖AI方法的挑战性测试平台。研究团队以次表层状态重构为例展示了简单基线模型的应用效果，同时也展望了OceanDepths在基于观测的预测方法开发和其他相关任务中的应用前景。

Conclusion: OceanDepths填补了海洋观测数据AI就绪格式的空白，为海洋科学AI研究提供了首个全球范围、高分辨率的表面-次表层配对数据集。该数据集不仅可用于次表层状态重构任务，还可支持开发基于观测的预报方法及其他相关研究，对推动海洋AI方法发展具有重要意义。数据集已公开于HuggingFace平台。

Abstract: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}

</details>


### [404] [Coverage-Maximizing Multinomial Subset Routing under Operational Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16375)
*Quan Zhou,Yiyan Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了多项式子集路由（MSR）框架，通过在线镜像下降与Blackwell可接近性方法的结合，在专家路由问题中实现了O(1/√T)的遗憾和约束违反界限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的组合赌博机和子集选择方法优化确定性子集并假设可加性奖励，无法捕捉跨专业模型路由中自然出现的“仅依赖路由子集中表现最佳专家”的奖励结构，且需要在赌博反馈下满足长期双向操作约束。

Method: 提出多项式子集路由（MSR）框架，学习者维护多项式路由策略而非确定性专家子集，每轮从多项式策略中独立同分布采样M个专家，并以采样的不同专家构成路由子集；提出OMD-Approachability算法，将在线镜像下降与Blackwell可接近性方法相结合以处理奖励与约束。

Result: 在奖励与约束违反两个维度上均达到O(1/√T)的遗憾界限；在真实众包数据集上的实验验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: MSR框架成功扩展了在线路由方法以适应非可加性奖励结构与长期操作约束，理论和实证结果均支持其在实际专家路由场景中的有效性。

Abstract: We introduce Multinomial Subset Routing (MSR), a new online routing framework over $K$ experts in which the learner keeps a multinomial routing policy instead of a deterministic subset of experts. At each round, the learner samples $M$ experts i.i.d. from the multinomial policy, and the resulting set of distinct sampled experts forms the routed subset.
  The reward depends only on the best-performing expert(s) in the routed subset. This reward structure arises naturally in routing across specialized models but is not captured by standard combinatorial bandits or subset-selection methods, which optimize deterministic subsets and typically assume additive rewards. We require the selection to satisfy several long-term, two-sided operational constraints under bandit feedback, observing only the winner's reward each round. We propose OMD-Approachability, combining online mirror descent with Blackwell's Approachability, and prove it achieves $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ regret in both reward and constraint violation. We ground the framework in practical application domains and validate it empirically on a real-world crowdsourcing dataset.

</details>


### [405] [FETERS: Few-Shot Early Time-Series Classification via Effective Ratio Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16385)
*Chen-An Tai,Yujia Wu,Vincent S. Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了FETERS，一个少样本早期时间序列分类框架，通过在支持集上进行类别级留一法评估来选择数据集级停止比例，并结合Rocket特征和冻结的Chronos表示进行分类，在5-shot设置下实现了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的早期时间序列分类方法大多假设有充足的标注训练数据，但在标注受限的实际应用中，学习样本级停止模块和提取有效分类特征都面临挑战。需要在有限监督下解决停止机制和特征学习两个关键问题。

Method: 1. 提出数据集级停止比例选择机制，通过在支持集上进行类别级留一法(LOO)评估来确定停止比例；2. 使用基于惩罚的奖励函数来平衡准确性和早期性的权衡；3. 结合Rocket特征和冻结的Chronos表示进行分类，避免训练额外的停止模块。

Result: 在69个公开数据集（覆盖14个领域）上进行了广泛实验。在5-shot设置下，FETERS实现了SOTA性能，获得了最高的平均谐波均值(HM)，在38个数据集上取得了最佳HM，并在44个数据集上超越了当前的SOTA方法。在全样本设置下也保持竞争力。

Conclusion: FETERS有效解决了少样本场景下的早期时间序列分类问题，通过数据集级停止机制避免了训练额外停止模块的需求，在准确性与早期性权衡方面表现出色，为有限监督条件下的ETSC提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Early time-series classification (ETSC) aims to make accurate predictions from partially observed time series as early as possible. Although various stopping mechanisms and feature learning strategies have been developed for ETSC, most existing methods assume access to sufficient labeled training data, which may be unrealistic in applications with limited annotation. Under limited supervision, learning an additional sample-level stopping module and extracting effective classification features can both become challenging. In this paper, we propose FETERS, a few-shot ETSC framework that selects a dataset-level stopping ratio through class-wise leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation on the support set and uses a penalty-based reward function to manage the accuracy-earliness trade-off, thereby avoiding the need to train an additional stopping module. FETERS further combines Rocket-based features with frozen Chronos representations for classification. Extensive experiments on 69 public datasets spanning 14 domains show that FETERS achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the 5-shot setting, with the highest average harmonic mean (HM) and the best HM on 38 datasets, while outperforming the current SOTA method on 44 datasets. FETERS also remains competitive in the full-shot setting, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing the accuracy-earliness trade-off.

</details>


### [406] [SoftModel: A Neural Model That Grows Its Own Topology -- Governed Structural Growth for Continual In-Service Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16409)
*Zhoumin Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种完全可塑的终身学习系统，通过结构算子和治理机制实现模型的动态增长，解决了固定拓扑结构对持续学习能力的限制问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经网络系统在训练和部署两个阶段都会"冻结"（训练结束后参数冻结，拓扑结构从一开始就不是自由度），这种静态模式限制了模型在非平稳数据流上的持续学习能力。作者反其道而行之，提出"完全可塑性"公理：模型的任何部分（包括结构）都不应被冻结，从而实现真正的终身学习。

Method: 设计了一个可增长的软模型系统，包含：（1）结构算子代数（宽度、层次、组合、输入接口、生长周期、注意力头），每个算子在应用时都是精确、预算可控且可审计的；（2）统一的治理机制，通过held-out reality gate统一处理参数变化和结构变化的采纳决策；（3）由生产级LLM端到端操作的工厂表面；（4）扩展到评估信号的治理框架。

Result: （1）在标准持续学习基准测试上，治理增长机制保持了模型在长任务序列上的持续学习能力；（2）在测量环境中，新容量的边际价值在采纳前不可观测，验证了事后治理形式的有效性；（3）预注册实验程序验证了机制和价值主张，并完整报告了失败案例。

Conclusion: 通过构造证明了两个结论：（1）终身变化下的稳定性成为生命周期的可审计属性，而非来自不可变性；（2）跟随需求变化的结构消除了固定拓扑对后续能力的隐性上限。第三结论来自测量：可行的增长治理采用事后形式。正负面结果图谱共同构成了本研究的贡献。

Abstract: Today, a neural system is almost always used in two phases -- trained, then deployed -- and in that regime it freezes twice: training ends, and the topology itself was never a degree of freedom. We take the opposite premise as an axiom -- total plasticity: no part of a model, including its structure, is ever frozen -- and derive the governance a lifelong learner then requires. The design's target regime is continual, in-service learning: a long-lived model on a non-stationary stream, whose stability comes from governance rather than immobility and whose capacity follows demand. The result is a growable soft model: an algebra of structural operators (width, hierarchy, composition, input interface, grown cycles, attention heads), each exact at application, budgeted, and audited, with adoption decided solely by a held-out reality gate that treats parametric and structural change uniformly. A complete from-scratch system realizes the whole account; its factory surface is operated end-to-end by a production LLM. Two conclusions follow from the axiom by construction: stability under lifelong change becomes an audit property of the lifecycle, and structure that follows demand removes the silent cap a fixed topology places on later capability where the capacity floor binds. A third is measured: in the worlds where this was measured, the marginal value of new capacity was unobservable before adoption, so workable growth governance took its ex-post form. The same governance extends to evaluative signals, and the core method is evaluated on standard continual-learning benchmarks, where governed growth preserves the ability to keep learning along long task sequences. A pre-registered experimental program adjudicates the mechanism and value claims on the tested problems and reports its failures at full prominence; the map -- positive and negative -- is the contribution.

</details>


### [407] [TRACE-CASH: Trial-History-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Configuration Exploration in Time-Series CASH](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16410)
*Yu-Han Huang,Yujia Wu,Vincent S. Tseng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了TRACE-CASH方法，用于时间序列预测中的组合算法选择和超参数优化，在41个数据集上的比较实验中表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列预测中的CASH（组合算法选择和超参数优化）问题面临时间选择、时序验证和昂贵评估等特殊挑战，但目前缺乏在统一的TS-CASH评估协议下对不同搜索方法进行受控比较的研究。

Method: 提出TRACE-CASH，一种任务局部混合序列优化器。该方法结合了分组actor-critic候选生成与固定规则，用于模型覆盖、验证引导的利用和停滞后的探索。具体包括：一个模型actor提出初始预测模型；三个模型条件actor生成时间、架构和训练动作；一个模型特定解码器构建最终评估的配置。

Result: 在41个数据集-频率任务变体上与六种替代方法（随机、贝叶斯、进化、多目标、语言模型辅助搜索）进行比较，TRACE-CASH在MASE和WQL指标上均获得最低平均排名。描述性分析显示，在预定义的完整和后期窗口中，其窗口平均测试MASE排名也最低。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持TRACE-CASH方法在所评估方法中具有竞争力，为时间序列预测领域的算法选择和超参数优化提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Combined algorithm selection and hyperparameter optimization (CASH) searches a conditional space in which the selected model determines which hyperparameters are active. In time-series forecasting, temporal choices, chronological validation, and costly evaluations further complicate this search. Controlled comparisons of heterogeneous search methods under a shared time-series CASH (TS-CASH) evaluation protocol remain limited. Within this setting, we study TRACECASH, a task-local hybrid sequential optimizer combining grouped actor-critic candidate generation with fixed rules for model coverage, validation-guided exploitation, and exploration after stalled progress. A model actor proposes an initial forecasting model; three model-conditioned actors generate temporal, architectural, and training actions; and a modelspecific decoder constructs the configuration ultimately evaluated. We compare TRACE-CASH with six alternatives spanning random, Bayesian, evolutionary, multi-objective, and language-model-assisted search across 41 dataset-frequency task variants. TRACE-CASH has the lowest mean rank on both MASE and WQL. Descriptively, it also has the lowest window-averaged test-MASE rank in the predefined full and late windows. These results support the complete TRACECASH procedure as competitive among the evaluated methods.

</details>


### [408] [Evolving Executable Pipeline Programs for AutoML with Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16416)
*Sofoklis Kitharidis,Cor J. Veenman,Jan N. van Rijn,Thomas Bäck,Niki van Stein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LACE是一个新颖的AutoML框架，通过演化循环维护scikit-learn兼容的Python类种群，并使用大语言模型作为变异算子，在完整的可执行管道程序空间中进行搜索，在68个OpenML分类任务上显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O和固定XGBoost基线，与最强的搜索型系统AutoGluon持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AutoML系统仅在预定义的预处理算子、学习器和超参数空间内搜索管道，虽然可以选择和调整已知组件，但无法产生该空间之外的结构，这限制了AutoML的搜索范围和灵活性。

Method: 提出LACE框架，采用演化循环维护scikit-learn兼容的Python类种群，使用大语言模型作为变异算子来搜索完整的可执行管道程序；在泄露控制的协议下评估，对生成器隐藏数据集身份，确保公平性。

Result: 在68个OpenML分类任务上，使用GPT-5.4-mini的LACE显著优于auto-sklearn、H2O和固定XGBoost基线，与最强的搜索型系统AutoGluon无显著差异，同时覆盖了完整基准测试；较新的表格基础模型在支持的子集上更准确，但应用固定的预训练预测器而非返回可编辑的任务特定程序。

Conclusion: LACE的核心贡献不是原始精度，而是以代码定义的搜索空间：提供完整覆盖、从业者可直接复用的管道、以及通过编辑提示而非框架来扩展组件集的能力，实现了可检查、可编辑的AutoML管道生成。

Abstract: Automated machine learning (AutoML) systems search for pipelines within a space of preprocessing operators, learners, and hyper-parameters specified in advance: they can select and tune known components, but cannot produce structure outside that space. We present LACE, an AutoML framework that instead searches over complete executable pipeline programs: an evolutionary loop maintains a population of scikit-learn-compatible Python classes, and a large language model acts as the variation operator. To our knowledge, LACE is the first to formulate general tabular pipeline AutoML this way, evaluated on standardized OpenML tasks under a leakage-controlled protocol that withholds dataset identity from the generator. Because every candidate is ordinary Python, the returned pipeline and the search that produced it can be inspected and edited directly, rather than only through a framework's model objects. On 68 OpenML classification tasks, LACE with GPT-5.4-mini significantly outperforms auto-sklearn, H2O, and a fixed XGBoost baseline, with no detectable difference against AutoGluon, the strongest search-based system evaluated, while covering the full benchmark. Newer tabular foundation models are more accurate on the subset of tasks they support, but apply a fixed pretrained predictor rather than returning an editable task-specific program. LACE's contribution is therefore not raw accuracy but a search space defined by code: complete coverage, pipelines practitioners can reuse directly, and a component set extended by editing the prompt rather than the framework.

</details>


### [409] [PertMind: Eliciting Emergent Biological Reasoning in LLM via Reinforcement Learning on Cellular Perturbation Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16419)
*Zhenchao Tang,Xiaogang Xu,Tianxu Lv,Jiahui Guan,Jiale Zhou,Haohuai He,Zhi Song,Hanbo Huang,Jiehui Huang,Jiafei Wu,Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了PertMind框架，将细胞扰动图谱转化为强化学习环境，仅通过前向扰动-响应预测训练，即可在多种生物推理任务上实现零样本迁移，为利用实验数据规模化训练生物推理模型提供了新范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模语言模型虽能描述生物学机制，但其可扩展的后训练仍依赖于昂贵的人工标注生物学推理轨迹。现有的生物语言模型训练方法成本高昂、难以规模化，限制了模型在生物推理任务上的发展。

Method: 提出PertMind框架：1) 将细胞扰动图谱转化为强化学习环境，利用实测基因响应作为可计算的奖励信号；2) 结合可信轨迹监督初始化与基因、通路、格式三个层级的强化信号；3) 仅在前向扰动-响应预测任务上进行训练。

Result: PertMind在未见过的细胞环境中响应推断能力提升，同时保留通用语言能力；无需任务特定后训练即可迁移至反向扰动识别、双扰动推理、表型筛选优先级排序和生物过程解释等任务；生成的生物学特征表示在多尺度下游任务中表现优异。

Conclusion: 实验终点上的强化学习能够浓缩预训练模型中已有的可复用生物策略；基于扰动的强化学习为将不断扩展的实验图谱转化为通用生物推理的训练环境提供了可扩展的途径。

Abstract: Large language models can describe mechanisms, yet scalable post-training still depends on costly, manually curated biological reasoning traces. Here we show that cellular perturbation atlases can instead become reinforcement-learning environments, where measured gene responses provide computable rewards for biological reasoning. We introduce PertMind, which combines trusted-trajectory supervised initialization with gene-, pathway-, and format-level reinforcement signals. Trained only on forward perturbation-response prediction, PertMind improved response inference in unseen cellular contexts while retaining general language capabilities. It also transferred without task-specific post-training to reverse perturbation identification, double-perturbation reasoning, phenotypic-screen prioritization, and biological-process interpretation. PertMind further generated biological profiles that supported competitive gene, cell, and donor representations across multiscale downstream tasks. These results support the hypothesis that reinforcement on experimental endpoints can concentrate reusable biological strategies already accessible to pretrained models. More broadly, perturbation-derived reinforcement learning offers a scalable route for transforming expanding experimental atlases into training environments for general-purpose biological reasoning.

</details>


### [410] [Localized TabICLv2: Scaling Tabular In-Context Learning through k-NN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16429)
*Beimnet Bekele Guta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Localized TabICLv2方法，通过检索k个最近邻来替代全训练上下文，在保持98.64%准确率的同时实现2.18×到249×的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全上下文表格ICL（TabICLv2）虽然在分类任务上达到SOTA性能，但其注意力成本随训练上下文规模增长而急剧增加，难以高效处理大规模数据集。

Method: 提出Localized TabICLv2：在模型Stage 2行表示空间中基于相似性检索，仅为每个测试点选择k个最近训练邻居，替代全训练上下文；无需架构改动，并通过额外的Stage 2和Stage 3微调提升精度保持率。

Result: 在TabArena分类任务上，微调后的localized模型保留Full TabICLv2 98.64%的准确率，批量推理实现中位2.18×加速，单查询服务场景达到约249×中位加速。

Conclusion: Localized TabICLv2成功解决了全上下文表格ICL的计算效率瓶颈，以极小的精度损失换取显著的推理加速，为大规模表格数据处理提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Foundational models for tabular data have made significant progress in recent years, with TabICLv2 reporting state-of-the-art performance on several tabular classification tasks. However, full-context tabular ICL still suffers from attention cost that grows with the training-context size, which limits its ability to handle large datasets efficiently. Localized TabICLv2 introduces a method that reduces the inference cost of TabICLv2 by retrieving only the k nearest training neighbours for each test point, measured by similarity in the model's Stage 2 row-representation space, rather than using the full training context. This requires no architectural changes, and we show that accuracy retention can be improved through additional Stage 2 and Stage 3 fine-tuning. On TabArena classification tasks, the fine-tuned localized model retains 98.64% of Full TabICLv2 accuracy and it achieves a median 2.18$\times$ speedup in batch inference, and reaches approximately 249$\times$ median speedup in the single-query serving setting.

</details>


### [411] [Reference-free logged energy-oracle recovery for neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems: conforming Riesz reconstruction and archive-level selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16473)
*Karim Bounja,Lahcen Laayouni,Boujemaa Achchab,Abdeljalil Sakat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于可计算Riesz监控器的无参考选择规则，用于从神经PDE训练的有限检查点档案中选择最优近似解，替代了不可获取的精确误差最小化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经PDE训练产生的有限检查点档案的能量误差需要精确解才能获得，而基于损失的选择不一定能恢复能量最优解。缺乏有效的无参考选择方法来识别最优的神经网络近似。

Method: 针对对称强制变分问题的可容许神经近似，引入基于可计算共形Riesz监控器的无参考选择规则。利用精确残差-能量恒等式和共形投影，通过嵌套共形细化和分层丰富化构建可计算的上下界。

Result: 证明了档案选择的顺序敏感性，建立了有限档案的一致恢复性，在饱和条件下提供了可计算的近神谕界限，并能认证唯一的神谕选择。实验显示能量尺度校准、神谕级选择和适度的后处理成本。

Conclusion: 该准则用可计算的、训练无关的后训练选择替代了不可获取的精确误差最小化，仅需计算候选者和变分问题，在扩散和弹性问题（包括非制造穿孔板）中验证了有效性。

Abstract: Neural PDE training yields a finite checkpoint archive, yet its logged energy errors are inaccessible without the exact solution, while loss-based selection does not necessarily recover the logged energy oracle. For admissible neural approximations of symmetric coercive variational problems, we introduce a reference-free selection rule based on minimizing a computable conforming Riesz monitor. The exact residual-energy identity and conforming projection make the monitor an unconditional lower bound converging monotonically to each logged energy error under nested conforming refinement; under saturation, hierarchical enrichment yields a computable upper estimate and hence a lower-upper bracket. A key finding is that archive selection is order-sensitive: unresolved checkpoint-dependent components can reverse the oracle-non-oracle ranking at finite resolution, so checkpointwise recovery alone is insufficient. For finite archives, we prove uniform recovery, yielding convergence to the logged-oracle error and, without saturation, logged-oracle selection at sufficiently fine auxiliary resolution. Under saturation, the bracket gives a computable near-oracle bound and certifies unique logged-oracle selection upon interval separation. We also bound logging-resolution loss and certify oracle inclusion over prescribed comparison trajectories. The resulting criterion replaces inaccessible exact-error minimization by computable, training-independent post-training selection on the intrinsic energy-error scale, requiring only the computed candidates and the variational problem. Experiments on diffusion and elasticity, including a non-manufactured perforated plate, demonstrate energy-scale calibration, oracle-level selection, and modest post-processing cost.

</details>


### [412] [Pallas: A Proactive KV Cache Migration Framework for LLM Inference in AI-RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16477)
*Tianhang Ding,Jianchun Liu,Hongli Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Pallas框架，通过在切换前预迁移KV缓存，显著降低AI-RAN场景下的服务中断时间和推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在AI-RAN架构中，LLM服务部署在靠近移动用户的基站，但蜂窝切换会导致活跃请求与其推理状态分离：用户接入目标基站，而大量且增长的KV缓存仍保留在源基站。源基站保留推理会持续增加token间延迟(ITL)，而目标基站恢复状态则需要切换后进行KV缓存传输或重新计算，直接延长服务中断时间(SIT)。

Method: 提出Pallas主动KV缓存迁移框架，在切换前将推理状态预迁移到预测目标基站。主要策略包括：(1)将token序列划分为稳定的历史前缀和演进的后缀；(2)目标基站通过本地预填充重建前缀；(3)源基站流式传输后缀的KV块；(4)切换时目标基站组装两部分形成最新KV缓存并恢复本地解码；(5)在线调度器基于移动预测和运行时遥测选择预取窗口。

Result: 在三种LLM和100-500 Mbps基站间链路条件下，基于vLLM的原型系统相比目标侧恢复方法将平均SIT降低2.28-89.68倍，相比源侧转发将平均ITL降低16.0%-50.0%。

Conclusion: Pallas通过主动预测和并行准备机制，有效解决了AI-RAN中蜂窝切换导致的推理状态迁移问题，在服务连续性和服务本地性之间实现了良好平衡，显著降低了服务中断时间和推理延迟。

Abstract: AI-RAN brings large language model (LLM) serving close to mobile users, but cellular handover can separate an active request from its inference state: the user attaches to a target base station (gNB) while the large and growing key-value (KV) cache remains at the source. Retaining inference at the source preserves service continuity but persistently increases inter-token latency (ITL), whereas recovering the state at the target restores serving locality but requires KV-cache transfer, recomputation, or a combination of both only after handover, directly prolonging service interruption time (SIT).
  This work presents Pallas, a \textit{proactive} KV-cache migration framework that prepares the inference state at the predicted target before handover, in parallel with ongoing source-side inference and token delivery. At the preparation trigger, Pallas partitions the token sequence into a stable historical prefix and an evolving suffix. The target reconstructs the prefix through local prefill, while the source streams the KV blocks generated for the suffix. At handover, the target assembles both portions into an up-to-date KV cache and resumes decoding locally, leaving only unfinished preparation to contribute to SIT. An online scheduler selects the \textit{prefetching window}, which determines how early preparation begins before handover, based on mobility predictions and runtime telemetry. Across three LLMs and $100$--$500~\mathrm{Mbps}$ inter-gNB links, our vLLM-based prototype reduces average SIT by factors of $2.28$--$89.68$ over target-side recovery approaches and lowers average ITL by $16.0\%$--$50.0\%$ compared with source-side forwarding.

</details>


### [413] [Graph Machine Learning: An Opportunity for Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16494)
*Martin Sadric,Sebastian Pütz,Christian Nauck,Veit Hagenmeyer,Frank Hellmann,Dirk Witthaut,Benjamin Schäfer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了近800篇图机器学习（GML）在电力系统中应用的论文，涵盖预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全等领域，指出现实部署有限、可解释性不足及基准数据集缺乏等挑战，并提出了ML就绪的电网基准需求目录以推动未来研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代电力系统面临可再生能源集成、去中心化和实时决策需求带来的运行复杂性挑战。传统基于模型的方法虽然准确但计算速度慢，难以满足实时性要求。机器学习作为数据驱动的替代方案应运而生，而电网拓扑在系统运行中起核心作用，因此图机器学习方法能够自然地引入拓扑依赖性作为归纳偏置，为解决这些挑战提供了新途径。

Method: 对近800篇图机器学习与电力系统交叉领域的论文进行系统性综述，覆盖预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全等应用领域。分析电力系统作为GML基准测试环境的独特价值（包含硬物理约束、多尺度动态、安全关键要求和稀缺标注数据），并提出了一个结构化的ML就绪电网基准需求目录，用于指导未来数据集开发。

Result: 识别出当前领域的主要开放性挑战：现实世界部署有限、安全关键场景下模型可解释性需求、标准化基准和开放数据集稀缺导致结果难以复现。尽管论文数量快速增长，但缺乏统一的基准研究和开源数据集模型，影响了该领域的长期科学可信度。电力系统与GML形成双向受益关系：GML为电力系统提供可扩展、拓扑感知的近似方法，而电力系统为GML提供丰富的基准测试环境。

Conclusion: 呼吁学术界优先开展专门的基准研究，发布开放数据集和模型以提高研究的可复现性和可信度。提出的ML就绪电网基准需求目录旨在指导未来数据集开发，推动GML在电力系统中的实际应用和科学研究的规范化发展。

Abstract: Modern power systems face growing operational complexity driven by the integration of renewable energy sources, decentralization, and the need for real-time decision-making across a wide range of timescales. Addressing these challenges traditionally relies on model-based methods that, while accurate, can be too slow for operational demands. Machine learning (ML) has therefore emerged as a faster, data-driven alternative. As grid topology plays a central role in power system operation, graph machine learning (GML) methods offer a natural framework for incorporating topological dependencies as an inductive bias. We survey nearly 800 papers at the intersection of GML and power systems, covering forecasting, state estimation, optimization, control, fault diagnosis, and cybersecurity. Power systems constitute an unusually rich benchmark setting for GML, as they combine hard physical constraints, multi-scale dynamics, safety-critical requirements, and scarce labeled data within a single, well-defined domain. Conversely, power systems can benefit from utilizing GML to complement classical solvers, as GML provide scalable, topology-aware approximations with promising generalization and computational efficiency. We identify open challenges, including limited real-world deployment and the need for interpretable models in safety-critical settings. Despite the rapidly growing number of publications, standardized benchmarks and open datasets remain scarce, leaving many results difficult to reproduce and undermining the long-term scientific credibility of the field. We further derive a structured requirements catalog for ML-ready power grid benchmarks, intended to guide future dataset development and improve reproducibility across studies. We call on the community to prioritize dedicated benchmark studies and the release of open datasets and models.

</details>


### [414] [When Tool-Backed Skill Retrieval Fails: Source-Style Collapse in Executable Capability Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16502)
*Yiqi Liu,Joseph James,Yang Wang,Chenghao Xiao,Chenghua Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究大规模智能体检索工具/API时的"源风格崩塌"问题（在特定数据源上微调的检索器在其他数据源上性能严重下降），提出基于TF-IDF的源感知路由方法ToolScout，将检索覆盖率从22.3%提升至86.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模智能体越来越依赖检索来访问外部工具和API能力。然而研究发现检索层存在一种隐蔽的失败模式：在特定数据源上微调的检索器在同一基准测试的其他数据源特定切片上会发生性能崩塌，即使这些切片与金标准工具有更高的词汇重叠。这种"源风格崩塌"现象在固定的能力语料库上也会发生，严重影响智能体的工具检索能力。

Method: 提出ToolScout方法，一种源感知路由机制：1)使用查询端TF-IDF指纹来标记源风格，比语义或长度代理更能有效预测微调检索器可能失败的情况；2)将该信号作为路由守卫，检测固定工具语料库上的不匹配问题；3)针对崩塌源，使用少量匹配示例进行路由调整。该方法适用于原始API schema和可执行技能卡两种表示形式。

Result: 在包含4,996个查询的混合数据流上：1)基于TF-IDF的路由将覆盖率从22.3%提升至86.1%；2)在五个崩塌源上，仅用20个匹配示例就将覆盖率加权的全局top-1代理从1.3%提升至53.9%；3)当工具重新渲染为可执行技能卡时，相同的失败和路由行为仍然存在，排除了原始API schema格式是唯一原因的可能性。

Conclusion: 源风格崩塌是工具检索中的关键问题，查询端TF-IDF指纹能有效检测检索器可能失败的数据源，为固定工具语料库上的不匹配提供了廉价的信号。ToolScout通过源感知路由显著提升了检索覆盖率和性能，证明了在构建大规模智能体检索系统时需要考虑数据源特性。该方法的有效性在不同工具表示格式下保持稳定。

Abstract: Large-scale agents increasingly rely on retrieval to access external capabilities. We study this retrieval gate in structured tools and APIs, a measurable class of tool-backed executable skills that must be surfaced before an agent can plan, incorporate, or act. In this setting the retrieval layer can silently fail even when the capability corpus is fixed: on ToolRet, a retriever fine-tuned on one source-specific slice collapses on another source-specific slice of the same benchmark, with FT-1100 despite its higher lexical overlap with the gold tools. We call this failure mode source-style collapse. Query-side TF-IDF fingerprints flag source styles on which the fine-tuned retriever is likely to fail better than semantic or length-based proxies, giving a cheap signal for mismatch over a fixed tool corpus. We propose ToolScout, a source-aware routing method that uses this signal as a routing guard: on the mixed 4,996-query stream, TF-IDF-based routing raises coverage from 22.3% to 86.1%, and across five collapsed sources 20 matched examples raise the coverage-weighted global top-1 proxy from 1.3% to 53.9%. The same failure and routing behaviors persist when tools are rerendered as executable skill cards, which rules out raw API-schema format as the sole cause.

</details>


### [415] [Learning Generalizable Reconstruction of High-Dimensional Neural Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16569)
*Anima Kujur,Zahra Monfared*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了PCA-DMD框架，通过结合PCA降维和Koopman算子理论，实现了长时程神经记录的高精度重建和跨被试零样本泛化，在多个数据集上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程神经记录（局部场电位LFP）的准确重建面临重大挑战，因为LFP信号具有高分辨率、多通道、瞬态性以及跨被试变异性等复杂特征，传统方法难以有效处理这些特性。

Method: 提出PCA-DMD框架，将LFP记录分割为重叠窗口，投影到紧凑的PCA空间中，在潜空间学习线性Koopman演化，最后通过逆投影和重叠相加聚合重建连续信号。

Result: 在20万样本海马记录上，PCA-DMD在KLD（0.0761）和HD（0.0847）指标上超越Classical DMD、SpDMD、MrDMD和HODMD；在30万样本跨被试零样本泛化中，相关系数达0.9504-0.9800；在40-90万样本规模下保持稳定重建（相关系数约0.965-0.968）；在独立93通道Allen Neuropixels数据上，平均和中位通道相关系数分别为0.7427和0.7990。

Conclusion: PCA-DMD为高维神经动力学重建提供了一个可解释、可泛化且计算可扩展的框架，Koopman谱分析显示主导特征值集中在单位圆附近，证明了该方法的有效性和实用性。

Abstract: Accurate reconstruction of long-duration neural recordings is challenging because local field potentials (LFPs) are high-resolution, multichannel, transient, and variable across subjects. We present PCA-DMD, a scalable operator-theoretic framework that segments LFP recordings into overlapping windows, projects them into a compact PCA space, learns linear Koopman evolution in the latent space, and reconstructs continuous signals through inverse projection and overlap-add aggregation. On 200,000-sample hippocampal recordings, PCA-DMD outperformed Classical DMD, SpDMD, MrDMD, and HODMD, achieving KLD=0.0761 and HD=0.0847. In all-pair cross-subject zero-shot generalization at 300,000 samples, correlations were 0.9504-0.9800, with HD=0.0010-0.0072 and KLD=0.0005-0.0022, without target-subject fine-tuning. Out-of-sample temporal prediction showed close one-step agreement on temporally held-out LFP segments across the unseen interval and multiple channels. Scalability analysis from 400,000 to 900,000 samples showed stable zero-shot reconstruction, with mean correlation remaining about 0.965-0.968 while computational cost increased predictably. External validation on an independent 93-channel Allen Neuropixels recording yielded mean and median channel-wise correlations of 0.7427 and 0.7990, respectively. Koopman spectral and mode analyses revealed dominant eigenvalues concentrated near the unit circle. PCA-DMD therefore provides an interpretable, generalizable, and computationally scalable framework for reconstructing high-dimensional neural dynamics.

</details>


### [416] [Variational Outlier-Robust Gaussian Process Regression with Generative Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16606)
*Arslan Majal,Aamir Hussain Chughtai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种生成式高斯过程回归模型，通过变分广义期望最大化算法有效处理异常值，在预测精度上优于现有鲁棒方法且保持相同的计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统高斯过程回归（GPR）采用高斯观测似然，对异常值极其敏感，异常值会显著扭曲模型学习和预测精度。为了解决这一关键局限性，需要开发能够自适应检测和抑制异常值影响的鲁棒GPR方法。

Method: 提出了一种生成式GPR模型，能够捕获特定于观测的污染（observation-specific contamination），从而自适应地缓解异常值的影响。采用变分广义期望最大化（variational generalized expectation-maximization）程序来学习潜变量和GPR模型参数。

Result: 在不同污染设置的合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在预测精度方面与鲁棒GPR基线方法保持竞争力，且在多种情况下优于这些基线方法。同时，该方法保持了与传统GPR方法相同的立方计算复杂度。

Conclusion: 该研究生成的GPR模型成功解决了传统GPR对异常值敏感的问题，在保持计算效率的同时提升了预测鲁棒性，为实际应用中的异常值处理提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Outliers can substantially distort Gaussian process regression (GPR) due to its conventional Gaussian observation likelihood, leading to inaccurate model learning and prediction. To address this limitation, this article introduces a generative GPR model that captures observation-specific contamination and adaptively mitigates the influence of outliers. Subsequently, a variational generalized expectation-maximization procedure is used to learn the latent variables and GPR model parameters. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets under different contamination settings demonstrate that the proposed method remains competitive with-and in several cases outperforms-robust GPR baselines in prediction accuracy. Moreover, the proposed method shares the cubic computational scaling of the compared GPR methods.

</details>


### [417] [Hoeffding adaptive splitting trees for data stream classification with concept drift and ensemble learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16659)
*Daniel Nowak Assis,Jean Paul Barddal,Fabrício Enembreck*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了霍夫丁自适应分裂树(HAST)，结合周期性分裂与自适应分裂机制，解决了自适应分裂树作为集成学习基学习器时多样性不足的问题，在数据流分类任务中实现了最先进的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 霍夫丁树作为集成学习的基学习器采用周期性分裂机制，但缺乏自适应性；而自适应树虽然能响应性能下降触发分裂，但作为基学习器时变化检测器往往无法在集成中促进足够的多样性。这一局限性促使研究者设计新的决策树模型来兼顾两者优势。

Method: 提出两种新的决策树模型——霍夫丁自适应分裂树(HAST)，将霍夫丁树的周期性分裂策略(促进集成多样性)与自适应分裂机制(使用变化检测算法识别性能衰减并确定分裂点)相结合。

Result: 实验结果表明，霍夫丁自适应分裂树提升了集成性能，在基准比较、计算成本分析和概念漂移适应性的综合评估中均达到了最先进的结果。

Conclusion: 霍夫丁自适应分裂树成功解决了自适应分裂决策树作为集成基学习器时多样性不足的问题，通过融合两种分裂策略的优势，在数据流分类领域实现了性能突破。

Abstract: Ensembles of decision trees are well-established methods for data stream classification. In ensemble learning, Hoeffding Trees are widely adopted as base learners, performing periodic split attempts according to the Hoeffding bound. Recent studies, however, indicate that this standard splitting mechanism lacks adaptability, while adaptive trees that trigger splits in response to performance degradation have achieved superior results. In this paper, we identify limitations in the use of adaptive-splitting decision trees as ensemble base learners, showing that change detectors often fail to promote sufficient diversity within ensembles. To address this issue, we propose two novel decision tree models, termed Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees. These models combine the periodic splitting strategy of Hoeffding Trees, which fosters ensemble diversity, with adaptive splitting mechanisms that employ change detection algorithms to identify performance decay and determine split points. Experimental results demonstrate that Hoeffding Adaptive Splitting Trees enhance ensemble performance and achieve state-of-the-art results across a comprehensive evaluation, including benchmark comparisons, computational cost analysis, and concept drift adaptation.

</details>


### [418] [UniTAC: Universal Task-Aware Compression via Weighted Distortion Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16696)
*Homa Esfahanizadeh,Matin Mortaheb,Jinfeng Du,Harish Viswanathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需重训练即可在运行时适配不同任务的通用图像编解码器UniTAC，在极低码率下显著优于通用编解码器，性能接近专用编解码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理AI系统（如自动驾驶车辆、机器人）需要在严格的带宽、延迟和能耗约束下传输高维感知信号。现有任务专用编解码器在面对随时间演变的任务时表现脆弱，而在现场为每个任务重新训练编解码器是不切实际的。

Method: 提出UniTAC，一种从通用（任务无关）到任务专用操作的单一学习图像编解码器，可在运行时通过注入任务重要性向量重新定向目标，无需重训练。该方法将任务抽象为逐组件重要性向量（如从下游模型的梯度归因中导出），作为低开销的边信息传输，并条件化编码器和解码器。基于加权率失真理论分析，设计了Vision Transformer (ViT) 编解码器，其令牌级条件化原生实现权重驱动编码。

Result: 在0.034 bpp的极低码率下，单一UniTAC模型在定位任务上达到91.4%准确率，仅比任务专用编解码器（93.3%）低1.9%，显著高于通用编解码器（76.9%）。

Conclusion: UniTAC成功实现了无需重训练的运行时任务适配，在保持固定骨干网络和单一人类可观察重建的同时，通过权重向量引导保真度至活动任务，为物理AI系统的感知信号传输提供了高效灵活的解决方案。

Abstract: Physical AI systems such as autonomous vehicles and robots rely on timely exchange of high-dimensional sensory signals under tight bandwidth, latency, and energy budgets. Because the task driving downstream decisions evolves over time, a task-specific codec is brittle and retraining one per task is infeasible in the field. We propose UniTAC, a single learned image codec spanning universal (task-agnostic) to task-specialized operation, re-targeted at runtime without retraining. The task is abstracted as a per-component importance vector, derived, e.g., from gradient attribution of any downstream model, and transmitted as low-overhead side information that conditions both encoder and decoder. Trained once over a broad, randomized family of such vectors against weighted-reconstruction distortion, UniTAC keeps a fixed backbone and a single human-viewable reconstruction whose fidelity is steered to the active task by swapping the injected vector. We analyze the underlying weighted rate-distortion problem, characterizing when a diagonal weighted distortion is task-consistent and how weights relate to task sensitivity. Guided by this, we design a Vision Transformer (ViT) codec whose token-level conditioning natively realizes this weight-driven code. On a localized task at 0.034 bpp, a single UniTAC model reaches 91.4% accuracy, only 1.9% below a task-based codec (93.3%) and above universal codecs (76.9%).

</details>


### [419] [Learning to Unlearn: Machine Unlearning via Learning the Unlearning Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16700)
*Hang Zhang,Kaifeng Zhang,Yixiao Ma,Weijie Xu,Ye Zhu,Kai Ming Ting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了首个基于学习的模型无关的机器遗忘方法（L2UL），通过从分布角度学习遗忘行为，实现了与重新训练相当的准确率，同时在计算效率上表现优异，特别是在大规模训练数据场景下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘技术依赖手工设计复杂的遗忘函数U来从已训练模型中移除数据D_f，但这导致在大规模训练数据场景下计算成本过高，复杂结构U成为计算瓶颈。

Method: 受Learning to Optimize启发，提出Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL)方法。核心创新在于从手工设计遗忘函数U转变为从分布角度学习遗忘行为，通过学习获得简单高效的遗忘函数U，实现模型无关的机器遗忘。

Result: 实验结果表明L2UL在准确率方面与重新训练方法相当，同时展现出显著的计算效率优势，特别是在数据密集型场景下表现突出。在ResNet等更大规模模型上验证了方法的性能和可扩展性。

Conclusion: L2UL成功实现了高效且准确的机器遗忘，避免了复杂遗忘函数设计的计算瓶颈，为大规模数据和模型的机器遗忘提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Various machine unlearning techniques have been developed in response to privacy legislation requirements, enabling individuals to exercise their legal right to have their data $D_f$ removed from a machine learning model. This process is typically accomplished via the use of an unlearning function denoted as $U$. Existing methods focus on designing an intricate $U$ to unlearn $D_f \subset D$ from a previous model $A(D)$, so that the unlearned model performs as closely as possible to the retrained model $A(D \setminus D_f)$. However, these methods often suffer from high computational costs when dealing with massive training data, as the complex structures of $U$ become a bottleneck even for models with fewer parameters.
  Inspired by Learning to Optimize, we introduce the first learning-based model-agnostic approach, Learning-to-UnLearn (L2UL). Our core insight is to shift from manually designing $U$ to learning the unlearning behaviors from a distribution perspective, thereby acquiring a simple and efficient $U$ via learning. Our experimental results demonstrate that the accuracy achieved by L2UL is comparable to that of retraining while exhibiting impressive efficiency, particularly in data-intensive scenarios. Furthermore, we validate the performance and scalability of our method on larger models ResNet.

</details>


### [420] [The Ethical Decision Head: Operationalizing Normative Ethics in Autonomous Vehicles via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16710)
*Thomas Mbrice,Ammar Ali,Sami Mian,Khai Hern Low,Eric Chen,Arshia Aghajani,Wolf Schäfer,Amin Shirangi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了伦理决策头（EDH）框架，用于训练自动驾驶车辆做出符合伦理的决策。研究发现功利主义智能体学会了人类偏好中的自我牺牲行为，而非理论上的伤亡最小化，揭示了基于人类反馈的强化学习学习的是人类实际生活中的伦理而非哲学定义的伦理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自动驾驶车辆接近L4和L5级别的操作能力，其车载决策系统不仅需要处理安全关键的运动控制，还需要处理随之而来的道德责任。现有的自动驾驶系统缺乏对伦理决策的考量，因此需要开发能够学习符合人类道德价值观的决策框架。

Method: 提出了伦理决策头（EDH）深度强化学习框架，将伦理推理编码为可微分的奖励信号。在CARLA仿真环境中实现，使用近端策略优化（PPO）算法训练，基于Bradley-Terry奖励模型学习来自200个碰撞迫近场景的成对人类偏好标注。实例化并评估了两种规范框架：最小化总伤亡的功利主义框架和将路线维持作为绝对命令的康德主义框架。

Result: 发现规范伦理框架在人类监督下的可学习性存在不对称性。康德主义条件作为管道控制确认了训练稳定性。功利主义智能体发现人类评估者奖励自我牺牲行为而非伤亡最小化，模型忠实地学习了这种偏好。人类在理论上规定的与实践中奖励的行为存在分歧。

Conclusion: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）学习的不是哲学家定义的伦理，而是人类实际生活中实践的伦理。这一发现对自动驾驶伦理决策系统的设计具有重要意义，揭示了理论伦理原则与人类实际行为偏好之间的差异。

Abstract: As autonomous vehicles (AVs) approach Level 4 and Level 5 operational capability [SAE International, 2018], their on- board decision systems must handle not only safety-critical locomotion but also their subsequent moral weight. This paper details the Ethical Decision Head (EDH), a deep re- inforcement learning (RL) framework that encodes ethical reasoning as a differentiable reward signal, enabling a pol- icy gradient agent to learn morally-aligned driving behavior in scenarios whose state representation is aligned with the CARLA simulation environment [Dosovitskiy et al., 2017]. Two normative frameworks are instantiated and evaluated: a Utilitarian framework minimizing total casualties and a Kan- tian framework enforcing course maintenance as a categori- cal imperative. The EDH is trained via Proximal Policy Op- timization (PPO) [Schulman et al., 2017] against a Bradley- Terry reward model [Bradley and Terry, 1952] learned from pairwise human preference annotations over 200 collision- imminent scenarios. Results reveal an asymmetry in the learnability of normative ethical frameworks under human su- pervision. The Kantian condition, which reduces to a con- stant prediction task under the codebook, serves as a pipeline control: it confirms training stability and rules out infrastruc- ture failure as an explanation for the utilitarian result. The Utilitarian agent learned something more unsettling: human raters rewarded self-sacrifice over casualty minimization, and the model learned that preference faithfully. This divergence between what humans prescribe in theory and what they re- ward in practice suggests that RLHF does not learn ethics as philosophers define it, but as humans live it.

</details>


### [421] [Le Critique: Privileged Value Functions for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16739)
*Siddarth Venkatraman,Matthieu Dinot,Laurence Aitchison*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种改进价值函数强化学习的方法：特权价值函数（PVF）和自适应基线TETHER，在推理任务上表现优于标准价值函数基线，与或优于GRPO方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM强化学习方法面临权衡：群组相对方法（如GRPO）通过多样本降低梯度方差，但只能提供序列级信用分配，且受延迟样本影响；基于价值函数的方法理论上可提供词元级优势且无需大样本群，但面临基础设施工程挑战且实用性存疑。

Method: 提出两种互补策略：1）特权价值函数（PVF）：优雅地注入额外任务相关的词元级信号而不偏置策略目标；2）TETHER基线：根据价值函数准确性自适应插值群组相对基线和价值基线。

Result: 在多个推理任务上，两种策略均一致优于标准价值函数基线，且与均值基线GRPO表现相当或更优。

Conclusion: 通过PVF和TETHER两种策略，成功解决了价值函数强化学习中的实际挑战，证明了价值函数方法在LLM训练中的有效性，为RL管道中引入价值函数提供了理论和实践支撑。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning algorithms for Large Language Models (LLMs) are largely distinguished by their variance reduction strategy. Group-relative methods like GRPO reduce gradient variance by sampling multiple rollouts per prompt, but provide only sequence-level credit. Training is also blocked by straggler rollouts, reducing throughput and increasing off-policyness. Learned value functions theoretically address both problems, providing token-level advantages without requiring large groups. However, additional infrastructure engineering challenges combined with the practical success of critic-free methods have made it difficult to justify their inclusion in RL pipelines. We propose two complementary strategies to improve the performance of value function RL: 1) Privileged Value Functions (PVF) which provide an elegant mechanism to inject additional task-relevant token-level signal without biasing the policy objective; 2) TETHER, a baseline that adaptively interpolates between group-relative and value baselines depending on the value function accuracy. Across several reasoning tasks, both strategies consistently improve over the standard value function baseline, and are competitive with or outperform mean-baseline GRPO.

</details>


### [422] [Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16747)
*Adam Karvonen,Euan Ong,Subhash Kantamneni,Samuel Marks*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了CHIVE框架，通过反事实可模拟性评估LLM解释质量，发现现有可解释性技术未能提升预测能力，但利用CHIVE生成的数据训练模型可泛化到多种分布外场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI研究中有许多方法试图解释模型行为，但缺乏对“什么是好的解释”的明确标准。现有解释方法的评估缺乏统一框架，需要一种能够定量评估解释质量的方法，以推动语言模型可解释性研究的发展。

Method: 提出CHIVE（Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits）智能体流程，包含两个核心步骤：(1)自动识别真实场景中模型的异常行为；(2)通过反事实提示编辑来调查这些行为。该框架生成大量高质量解释及其支持性反事实证据，用于评估解释的反事实可模拟性——即解释是否有助于预测相关反事实输入的模型行为。

Result: 实验揭示了两个关键发现：(1)评估常见LLM可解释性技术时，发现这些技术均未能提升智能体预测反事实模型行为的能力，令人惊讶；(2)利用CHIVE生成的数据进行训练，模型能够泛化到多种分布外设置，展现出良好的迁移能力。

Conclusion: CHIVE框架成功实现了对自然发生的LLM行为的自动解释发现，为评估和改进LLM行为解释方法提供了有效工具。研究结果表明需要重新审视现有可解释性技术的实际效用，同时展示了反事实实验数据在模型训练中的价值。

Abstract: Many areas of AI research, such as language model interpretability and chain of thought faithfulness, seek to explain model behaviors. But what constitutes a "good" explanation? In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpected model behaviors in the wild and investigates them with counterfactual prompt edits. This yields thousands of high-quality explanations for naturally-occurring model behaviors along with supporting counterfactual evidence. We apply CHIVE in two ways. First, we evaluate whether common LLM interpretability techniques improve an agent's ability to predict counterfactual model behaviors. Surprisingly, we find no uplift from any of the interpretability techniques studied. Second, we use CHIVE to generate training data. We find that training models to predict outcomes of CHIVE-generated counterfactual experiments generalizes to various out-of-distribution settings. Overall, CHIVE automatically discovers explanations of naturally-occurring LLM behaviors, enabling us to evaluate and improve methods for explaining LLM behaviors.

</details>


### [423] [On the Principles Behind Neural Network Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16760)
*Yushun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了Adam优化器的理论基础，发现了其收敛性依赖于批次大小的相位转变，解释了Adam在Transformer上优于SGD的Hessian结构原因，并提出了内存占用减少50%的新优化器Adam-mini。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam作为现代大语言模型的默认优化器，其理论基础却较为脆弱。本文旨在为Adam建立有原则的理论基础，理解其在Transformer上优异表现的原因，并基于这些理论洞见设计新的优化器。

Method: 1) 重新审视Adam的收敛性争论，证明存在依赖于问题的相变现象；2) 通过Hessian结构分析研究Adam在Transformer上的优势，发现Hessian演化为近似块对角形式且具有强块异质性；3) 利用随机矩阵理论严格分析这种特殊Hessian结构源于大矩阵变量的连续乘法；4) 基于理论洞察设计新的优化器Adam-mini。

Result: 1) 发现Adam存在相变：使用合适的批次大小相关超参数时收敛，而在小β₂机制下可能发散；2) 证明了Transformer训练过程中Hessian的近块对角结构使Adam的对角预调节器有效；3) 揭示了这种Hessian结构源于矩阵变量的连续乘法；4) 提出的Adam-mini优化器在保持性能的同时将内存占用减少50%。

Conclusion: 本研究为Adam优化器提供了坚实的理论基础，不仅解释了其在Transformer上的成功，还启发了新优化器的设计。这些发现对理解基于矩阵的非凸问题的新局部结构以及改进其他神经网络优化器（如Muon）具有更广泛的意义。

Abstract: Reliable optimization is central to neural network (NN) training, yet Adam, the default optimizer for modern LLMs, rests on a fragile foundation. This thesis develops a principled grounding for Adam and motivates new designs. First, we revisit Adam's divergence--convergence debate and show the existence of a problem-dependent phase transition: with properly chosen, batch-size-dependent hyperparameters, Adam converges, whereas under small-$β_2$ regimes it can diverge. Second, we investigate why Adam substantially outperforms SGD on Transformers through Hessian structure. We find that the Hessian evolves toward a near-block-diagonal form along training, accompanied by strong block heterogeneity. We prove that this structure makes Adam's diagonal preconditioner effective. We further show that this special Hessian structure originates from consecutive multiplications of large matrix variables, and we provide a rigorous analysis based on random matrix theory. Finally, these insights motivate Adam-mini, a new optimizer that reduces Adam's memory footprint by 50\% while preserving its performance. Our results also have broader implications beyond Adam: they reveal new local structures in matrix-based nonconvex problems, and also help understand and improve recent NN optimizers, such as Muon.

</details>


### [424] [Beyond $L_2$: Generalizing Abductive Latent Explanations to Diverse Prototype-Based Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16773)
*Jules Soria,Alban Grastien,Romain Xu-Darme,Julien Girard-Satabin,Zakaria Chihani,Daniela Cancila*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将ALE（溯因潜在解释）框架从欧几里得潜在空间扩展到非欧几里得原型架构，使其能够为现代最先进的神经网络提供形式化解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的ALE框架仅适用于欧几里得潜在空间，无法处理现代最先进架构中常用的非欧几里得表示（如球面度量、高斯密度和维度投影），导致形式化解释方法与这些架构不兼容。

Method: 针对每种几何变体，系统地推导如何将架构映射到现有边界，或构建新的架构特定边界算法；通过在完全训练的图像分类器上计算子集最小形式化解释来验证理论构造。

Result: 成功将ALE框架泛化以支持非欧几里得原型架构，实现了首次严格的跨架构可解释性比较。

Conclusion: 通过将多种不同的模型统一在单一的形式化框架下，为现代非欧几里得神经网络架构提供了数学保证的解释，填补了形式化解释方法与现代架构之间的关键差距。

Abstract: Prototype-based neural networks are hailed as interpretable-by-design architectures. Recently, Abductive Latent Explanations (ALE) were introduced to provide formal, mathematically guaranteed explanations that leverage the intrinsic structure of these networks to ensure both predictive safety and human readability. ALEs rely on computing tight bounds on latent space distances to produce formal explanations. However, existing ALE formulations are rigidly confined to Euclidean latent spaces. This leaves a critical gap: modern state-of-the-art architectures increasingly rely on non-Euclidean representations - such as spherical metrics, Gaussian densities, and dimensional projections - rendering current formal explanation methods incompatible. In this work, we generalize the ALE framework to support non-Euclidean prototype architectures. For each geometric variant, we systematically derive how to either map the architecture to existing bounds or construct novel, architecture-specific bounding algorithms. We validate our theoretical constructions by computing subset-minimal formal explanations on fully trained image classifiers. By unifying these diverse models under a single formal framework, we enable the first rigorous, cross-architecture comparison of their interpretability.

</details>


### [425] [GEO-Flag: Detecting and Measuring GEO-Optimized Web Content](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16824)
*Junjie Chu,Ye Leng,Mingjie Li,Yun Shen,Xinyue Shen,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了GEOFlagBench基准和IPT训练方法来检测生成式搜索引擎优化（GEO）网页，在真实搜索生态中发现8.90%的GEO prevalence。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式搜索引擎优化（GEO）可使低质量或虚假信息获得与其权威性不匹配的可见度，由于生成式搜索直接合成答案而非展示竞争源，这种风险被放大，但目前缺乏系统性的GEO网页检测方法。

Method: 构建包含3,200个网页的GEOFlagBench基准，覆盖400个查询、四个领域和八个GEO优化器家族；提出干预配对训练（IPT）方法，监督检测器对GEO干预和非GEO AI润色的响应；开发GEO门控智能体系统用于审计检测到的GEO页面的Source Tier和引用URL可验证性。

Result: 最强基线方法达到F1值0.880，但存在方法层面和作者ship相关的弱点；IPT方法在ModernBERT上将F1从0.862提升至0.944，最差组准确率从0.725提升至0.883；在10,095个真实用户查询页面中，GEO prevalence估计为8.90%，2026年修改的页面中达到16.36%。

Conclusion: 本研究为系统性检测、审计和测量真实搜索生态中的GEO奠定了基础，揭示了GEO在现实搜索系统中的普遍性，为后续研究提供了基准和方法支持。

Abstract: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) modifies web content to increase its likelihood of being selected and cited by generative search engines. This can give strategically optimized pages visibility disproportionate to their authority or relevance and even make weak or false information appear well supported. Unlike conventional search, generative search synthesizes information into direct answers rather than presenting competing sources, which can further amplify these risks, as assessing source provenance and authority requires additional user interaction. Despite these concerns, systematic methods for detecting GEO-optimized webpages remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{GEOFlagBench}, a benchmark of 3,200 webpages spanning 400 queries, four domains, and eight GEO optimizer families, and use it to systematically evaluate existing GEO detection methods. Although the strongest baseline achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.880, method-level and authorship-conditioned evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses and potential reliance on authorship-related shortcuts. We therefore propose \emph{Intervention-Paired Training} (IPT), which supervises detector responses to GEO interventions and non-GEO AI polishing; on ModernBERT, IPT improves F1 from 0.862 to 0.944 and worst-group accuracy from 0.725 to 0.883. We develop a GEO-gated Agent system for auditing the Source Tier and verifiability of Citation URLs in detected GEO pages. Finally, we deploy the complete pipeline on released Google Search and Gemini-grounded retrieval results for 1,000 real-user queries. Across 10,095 available pages, we estimate an overall GEO prevalence of 8.90\%, reaching 16.36\% among pages modified in 2026. Our results establish a foundation for systematically detecting, auditing, and measuring GEO in real-world search ecosystems.

</details>


### [426] [CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.16829)
*Jonathan Sadeghi,Jenny Seidenschwarz,Jesse Allardice,Sirish Srinivasan,Benjamin Graham,Jeffrey Hawke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CaliBench基准，用于精确评估视频世界模型的细粒度随机不确定性，发现现有模型存在严重的校准偏差，倾向于将概率集中在少数结果上而非还原真实分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型基准要么评分单一生成样本，要么在整个数据集上粗粒度比较分布，无法测试特定现象的细粒度随机不确定性（认知不确定性）。

Method: 构建CaliBench基准，在物理可解释的离散空间（如二项分布高尔顿板、伯努利分叉、均匀骰子/纸牌/彩票、偏斜轮盘颜色）中对结果评分，直接测量与已知参考分布的距离。将性能分解为两个正交维度：可评分性和校准度（用总变差距离衡量），通过卡方检验评估显著性。

Result: 对9个场景和6个图生视频模型（WAN-2.7、SeeDance-2.0、HappyHorse-1.0、Veo 3.1、Runway Gen-4.5、Cosmos3-Super）测试发现：模型一致地将概率集中在少数结果上，大多数场景-模型组合显著校准不良，极端情况（如Veo 3.1在骰子上）坍缩到单一结果；轮盘生成常使球位置模糊导致可评分性低；无模型在所有9个场景中占优。

Conclusion: 现有视频世界模型在物理结果的随机性建模上存在系统性偏差，无法准确重现已知概率分布；发布协议和mnTV指标以支持新模型对比评估。
